目的: ...

方法: ...

主要发现: ...

结论: ...

翻译: ...

Abstract

The tracking-by-detection paradigm in multi-object tracking (MOT) typically relies on static appearance descriptors to complement motion estimation. However, these descriptors are frame-independent, limiting their robustness as visual cues. Since such descriptors are often obtained from computationally intensive pretrained backbones, real-time MOT systems frequently abandon appearance cues altogether and rely solely on motion prediction and geometric association. In this work, we introduce Polycepta, an object-centric appearance state estimation framework that reformulates appearance modeling as a recursive estimation problem rather than a frame-wise matching task. Polycepta constructs and continuously updates an independent appearance state for each tracked object, enabling future appearance representations to be estimated from accumulated observations. Polycepta is encouraged to learn the appearance-state construction of object-specific representations rather than memorize them through a proposed learning strategy, enabling appearance estimation for unseen classes. A key property of Polycepta is that the quality of appearance estimation improves as object states evolve during inference. While conventional appearance descriptors remain static or degrade over time, Polycepta progressively refines appearance estimates as additional observations are accumulated. Extensive experiments on KITTI, the Waymo Open Dataset, and MOT17 demonstrate consistent reductions in identity switches and improvements in tracking performance when integrated into the tracking-by-detection pipelines. Polycepta operates at 90.57 Hz and delivers state-of-the-art performance on the KITTI benchmark when integrated into the RobMOT framework, achieving a MOTA of 92.27\%.

背景: unknown

目的: 评估机器学习模型在遥感数据上绘制树篱地图的能力，并检验模型在空间距离与气候区之间的泛化性能。

方法: 整合并协调多种遥感数据产品与源自法国树篱清单的地面真实标签；测试三种基线模型，涵盖监督学习与自监督学习方法。

主要发现: unknown

翻译: 我们提出了Hedgementation：一个用于在国家尺度和十平方米空间分辨率下，利用遥感数据评估机器学习模型绘制树篱地图能力的新基准。我们结合并协调了多种遥感数据产品以及源自法国树篱清单的地面真实标签。我们测量了三种基线模型在空间距离和气候区之间泛化的能力，这是一项更具挑战性的任务。我们的基准测试了应用于追踪具有高农业价值细尺度特征的遥感监督与自监督学习方法。用于复现基准和基线结果的代码可在指定网址获取。

Abstract

We propose Hedgementation: a new benchmark to evaluate machine learning models for hedgerow mapping from remote sensing data at country scale and 10m$^2$ spatial resolution. We combine and harmonize multiple remote sensing data products and ground truth labels sourced from a hedgerow inventory in France. We measure the ability of three baseline models to generalize across spatial distance, and across climatic zones, a more explicitly challenging task. Our benchmark tests both supervised and self-supervised learning approaches for remote sensing, applied to tracking fine-scale features of high agricultural importance. The code to reproduce the benchmark and baselines results is available at https://github.com/hedgementation/hedgementation.

item.title: DiT-Reward: Generative Representations for Text-to-Image Reward Modeling
item.author: Yuanming Yang, Guoqing Ma, Bo Wang, Yuan Zhang, Wei Tang, Chenyi Li, Haoyang Huang, Nan Duan
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: ...

背景: ...

目的: ...

方法: ...

主要发现: ...

结论: ...

翻译: ...

Abstract

Can representations learned for image generation also support the evaluation of generated images? We study text-to-image reward prediction as a downstream task of generative representation learning. To this end, we introduce DiT-Reward, which converts a pretrained text-to-image Diffusion Transformer into a reward model by processing near-clean image latents and aggregating text-conditioned image representations across transformer layers. Under the same training data mixture as HPSv3, DiT-Reward outperforms HPSv3 on all four evaluated preference benchmarks, reaching 85.6% on HPDv2 and 77.6% on HPDv3. When the generative backbone is frozen, a lightweight learned head can still extract meaningful preference predictions from its representations. Probing across depth further reveals that downstream reward performance is strongest in the middle-to-late layers and benefits from combining representations across different stages. We also observe consistent positive scaling with generative backbone capacity. Finally, when used to optimize Stable Diffusion 3.5 Large with Flow-GRPO, DiT-Reward outperforms HPSv3 along the matched training trajectory, with particularly clear gains in realism. Direct latent scoring also achieves a 1.65x inference speedup over HPSv3 with comparable peak memory. These results show that pretrained generative DiTs provide transferable representations for reward modeling and policy optimization.

item.title: EnterpriseClawBench: Benchmarking Agents from Real Workplace Sessions
item.author: Zhong, Jincheng, Wang, Weizhi, Jiang, Che, Tian, Kai, Yuan, Zhenzhao, Yang, Junlin, Lei, Dianqiao, Zhang, Kaiyan
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了基于真实企业会话构建的EnterpriseClawBench基准测试，包含八百五十二个可复现任务及评估协议，揭示了当前企业智能体在复杂任务中的性能瓶颈，并提出了多维度的评估标准。

背景: 企业智能体日益在工作空间内运行，需读取异构文件、调用工具并交付业务成果。

目的: 构建并引入一个基于真实企业会话的企业智能体基准测试，以推动相关评估与研究。

方法: 从大型工作场所会话档案中构建基准，生成八百五十二个可复现任务，并为每个任务配套恢复的固定设置、重写提示词、角色类别、技能子类、硬性规则与语义评分标准。因涉及内部企业内容未公开原始数据，仅公开构建与评估协议。

主要发现: 在该基准测试上，表现最佳的配置得分仅为零点六六三。

结论: 企业智能体评估不应仅依赖单一分数，而应详细报告工具链与模型组合、成果交付质量、视觉质量、成本、运行时间及技能迁移行为等多维度指标。

翻译: Enterprise agents increasingly operate inside workspaces: they read heterogeneous files, invoke tools, and deliver business artifacts. We introduce EnterpriseClawBench, an enterprise agent benchmark constructed from proprietary, real-world agent sessions. Starting from a large archive of workplace sessions, the EnterpriseClawBench produces 852 reproducible tasks, each paired with recovered fixtures, rewritten prompts, role classes, skill subclasses, hard rules, and semantic rubrics. Because the sessions contain internal enterprise content, we do not release the benchmark data; instead, our reusable contribution is the construction and evaluation protocol. On EnterpriseClawBench, the best configuration reaches only 0.663 (Codex with GPT-5.5). These results show that enterprise agent evaluation must report harness--model combinations, artifact delivery, visual quality, cost, runtime, and skill-transfer behavior, rather than collapsing performance into a single score. 深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决现有企业智能体评测基准缺乏真实工作场景数据、评估维度单一以及难以衡量技能迁移能力的问题。该问题在现实和研究中非常重要，因为企业智能体在实际办公中需要处理复杂文件、调用工具并交付业务成果，仅靠单一模型分数无法反映其在真实环境中的可靠性、成本效益和实际工作表现。建立基于真实会话的基准有助于更准确地指导企业级智能体的开发与部署。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者针对现有基准测试在真实企业场景还原度、多维度综合评估以及技能泛化能力检验方面的不足，设计了从真实工作会话中提取任务、构建多维评分框架并支持技能迁移评估的完整流程。该方法明确借鉴了现有的智能体基准测试系列及相关开源框架，并在此基础上补充了企业级真实数据源、复杂工件交付评估及成本时间等综合指标。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是从真实企业工作会话中提取数据，构建可复现的基准测试集，以全面评估智能体在真实办公场景下的综合执行能力。整体实现流程首先从海量内部会话中恢复原始任务实例，随后通过长度过滤、隐私脱敏和网络依赖检查等硬性关卡进行筛选。通过筛选的候选任务会被改写为单轮提示词，并自动分配角色与技能分类，同时生成硬性规则与多维度的语义评分标准。最后经过沙箱预运行验证后，正式纳入基准测试集供后续评估使用。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于构建了一个基于真实企业内部会话的自动化基准测试框架，并提出了多维度的评估体系。与以往依赖人工编写或公开环境数据的工作不同，本基准直接来源于真实的职场交互记录，保证了任务的企业级现实性。此外，它突破了以往仅用单一分数评价模型的做法，将执行框架与模型的组合效果、多模态交付物质量、成本耗时以及任务级技能迁移能力纳入统一评估，从而更全面地反映企业智能体的实际表现。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一套将真实企业会话自动转化为可复现基准任务的构建协议、一个综合评估代理性能与交付质量的多元评估框架，以及支持在同一企业任务类别内评估技能泛化能力的原生机制。

Abstract

Enterprise agents increasingly operate inside workspaces: they read heterogeneous files, invoke tools, and deliver business artifacts. We introduce EnterpriseClawBench, an enterprise agent benchmark constructed from proprietary, real-world agent sessions. Starting from a large archive of workplace sessions, the EnterpriseClawBench produces 852 reproducible tasks, each paired with recovered fixtures, rewritten prompts, role classes, skill subclasses, hard rules, and semantic rubrics. Because the sessions contain internal enterprise content, we do not release the benchmark data; instead, our reusable contribution is the construction and evaluation protocol. On EnterpriseClawBench, the best configuration reaches only 0.663 (Codex with GPT-5.5). These results show that enterprise agent evaluation must report harness--model combinations, artifact delivery, visual quality, cost, runtime, and skill-transfer behavior, rather than collapsing performance into a single score. item.title: Duration Aware Scheduling for ASR Serving Under Workload Drift
item.author: Makwana, Darshan, Jogi, Yash, Kotta, Harsh, Kubba, Aayush
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文针对大规模语音识别服务中的调度策略问题，提出并评估了基于音频时长的调度算法，显著优化了端到端延迟。

背景: 大规模语音识别服务管道的调度策略对端到端延迟至关重要，但广泛使用的服务引擎多采用先来先服务策略，该策略忽略请求时长差异，在负载波动时会导致队头阻塞。

目的: 利用音频时长作为作业处理时间的准确代理，实现感知时长的调度策略，以优化服务延迟并解决先来先服务策略的缺陷。

方法: 将最短作业优先和最高响应比优先两种经典算法集成到vLLM框架中，并在真实及负载波动的数据集上进行评估。

主要发现: 最短作业优先策略在高负载下可将中位端到端延迟降低最多百分之七十三，但会导致长请求饥饿，使第九十百分位尾部延迟增加最多百分之九十七；最高响应比优先策略有效平衡了该权衡，将中位延迟降低最多百分之二十八，同时将尾部延迟恶化限制在最多百分之二十四以内。

结论: 所提调度策略在负载波动下依然有效，且未造成吞吐量下降，每次请求的调度开销低于零点一毫秒。

翻译: 调度策略在大规模自动语音识别服务管道中起着决定端到端延迟的关键作用。然而，广泛使用的服务引擎依赖于先来先服务调度，它忽略了请求时长的变化，并在负载漂移时导致队头阻塞。我们表明，音频时长是诸如Whisper等语音识别模型中作业处理时间的准确代理，并利用这一见解实现了感知时长的调度。我们将两种经典算法——最短作业优先和最高响应比优先——集成到vLLM中，并在真实和负载漂移的工作负载下对其进行了评估。在LibriSpeech测试集清理版上，与基线相比，最短作业优先策略在高负载下可将中位端到端延迟降低最多百分之七十三，但由于长请求饥饿，会使第九十百分位尾部延迟增加最多百分之九十七。最高响应比优先策略解决了这一权衡：它将中位端到端延迟降低最多百分之二十八，同时将尾部延迟的恶化限制在最多百分之二十四以内。这些收益在负载漂移下依然持续，且没有吞吐量惩罚，每次请求的调度开销低于零点一毫秒。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决语音识别服务中传统先来先服务调度策略在请求时长不一或负载波动时导致的排队延迟高和队头阻塞问题。该问题在现实中非常重要，因为语音助手和实时字幕等交互应用对响应速度要求极高，明显的延迟会直接降低用户满意度和系统可用性。通过利用音频时长预估处理时间并优化任务执行顺序，可以在不增加硬件成本的情况下显著提升系统的整体响应效率。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者观察到传统先进先出调度策略在请求时长差异大时会导致排队阻塞，因此提出利用音频时长作为任务处理时间的代理指标。该方法借鉴了操作系统中的经典调度算法最短作业优先与最高响应比优先，并结合语音识别模型中音频时长与输出长度呈强线性相关的特性进行设计。与现有依赖额外预测模型的工作不同，作者直接利用请求到达时即可获取的音频时长信息，实现了零额外开销的调度优化。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是利用音频时长与语音识别模型处理时间的高度相关性，将音频时长直接作为任务处理时长的代理指标，以此优化传统先到先服务策略的缺陷。整体实现流程为：在推理引擎中集成最短作业优先与最高响应比优先两种调度算法，系统根据请求到达时的音频时长预估处理时间，并据此动态调整请求的执行顺序。最短作业优先策略通过优先处理短音频来降低平均延迟，而最高响应比优先策略则综合考量请求等待时间与预估时长，有效避免长音频请求被无限期推迟。该流程在保持系统吞吐量的同时显著降低了端到端延迟，且单次调度的额外开销极低。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于直接利用语音输入时长与模型处理时间的高度相关性，将其作为作业处理时长的免费代理信号，从而避免了传统方法中依赖辅助模型预测输出长度的开销。论文将最短作业优先和最高响应比优先两种经典调度算法集成到主流语音识别推理引擎中，并验证了其在负载分布变化场景下的稳定性。与以往针对文本大语言模型的调度工作相比，本方法无需额外的长度预测模块或自预测步骤，实现了零额外开销的调度信号获取，在显著降低平均延迟的同时有效缓解了长请求的排队饥饿问题。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出利用音频时长作为处理时间代理，将最短作业优先和最高响应比优先调度算法集成到语音识别推理系统中，显著降低了中位响应时间并有效控制了尾部延迟恶化，且在工作负载变化时仍能保持高效稳定。

Abstract

Scheduling policies in large-scale Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) serving pipelines play a key role in determining end-to-end (E2E) latency. Yet, widely used serving engines rely on first-come-first-served (FCFS) scheduling, which ignores variability in request duration and leads to head-of-line blocking under workload drift. We show that audio duration is an accurate proxy for job processing time in ASR models such as Whisper, and use this insight to enable duration-aware scheduling. We integrate two classical algorithms, Shortest Job First (SJF) and Highest Response Ratio Next (HRRN), into vLLM and evaluate them under realistic and drifted workloads. On LibriSpeech test-clean, compared to baseline, SJF reduces median E2E latency by up to $73\%$ at high load, but increases $90$th-percentile tail latency by up to $97\%$ due to starvation of long requests. HRRN addresses this trade-off: it reduces median E2E latency by up to $28\%$ while bounding tail-latency degradation to at most $24\%$. These gains persist under workload drift, with no throughput penalty and $<0.1$\,ms scheduling overhead per request.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决当前大语言模型内部机制研究依赖额外训练、计算成本高且流程复杂的问题。它提出了一种无需训练的框架，直接通过模型隐藏层数值的正负符号来读取语义特征。该问题在现实中非常重要，因为随着模型在安全关键领域的应用，快速且低成本地理解模型内部计算逻辑对于保障系统安全、调试和建立信任至关重要。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者通过可视化观察发现Transformer隐藏状态的各个维度轨迹相互独立，且其正负号能稳定编码语义内容，幅度仅表示置信度。基于这一实证发现，他们借鉴自然语言处理中词袋模型的思想，将隐藏状态视为独立二进制寄存器的集合，直接通过统计维度符号的一致性来读取特征，从而设计出无需训练的方法。文中未明确提及借鉴其他具体的可解释性研究。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是将Transformer隐藏状态的各个维度视为独立的二进制寄存器，认为维度的正负号直接编码语义内容，数值大小表示置信度，通过维度符号的一致性即可直接读取特征，无需任何训练或参数学习。整体流程分为三步：首先让词表中每个词单独输入模型一次以构建状态缓存；接着为每个语义类别挑选少量锚点词，计算各维度符号区分锚点词与全词表的能力，筛选出高区分度维度及其符号倾向组成特征原型；最后对新词进行分类时，仅统计其维度符号与原型的一致性比例即可完成识别。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于提出一种免训练的可解释性框架，将模型隐藏状态视为相互独立的通道，仅通过各维度的正负符号即可直接提取语义特征与预测内容。与以往需要消耗大量算力训练专用可解释性模型的方法不同，该方法完全无需参数优化，仅依赖单次前向传播和简单的符号匹配，即可在标准基上直接读取特征，大幅降低了分析成本。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了一种无需训练的“维度袋”可解释性框架，证明Transformer隐藏状态的各个维度可视为独立的二进制寄存器，其正负符号直接编码语义内容，从而无需任何训练或优化即可直接读取模型内部特征。

Abstract

We show the standard basis of transformer hidden states already provides a training-free, architecture-general feature basis. Individual dimensions encode semantic content via their signs (+/-1) and confidence via their magnitudes, acting as independent binary registers; a feature is a subset of dimensions with a consistent sign pattern, read by counting sign agreements with no learned rotation. We validate this Bag of Dims framework across seven models spanning language (Qwen 3.5-4B, Gemma 3-4B, Mistral 7B, Qwen3-32B), vision (DINOv2, ViT-Base), and audio (AST). Signs alone carry predictive content: unit-magnitude sign patterns preserve 60-93% top-5 next-token accuracy through the LM head, and decoder-free Hamming scoring reaches 80-90% top-4096. From a single-token cache (one forward pass per token, no context, no labels), we detect 175 categories at AUC 0.97-0.99 by sign agreement; a trained probe adds only +0.018 AUC and converges to axis-aligned weights. These features are causally operative: they survive the K/V attention projections, trace to the FFN neuron coalitions that write them (random-weight controls never reproduce this), and flipping a feature's signs during the live forward pass suppresses its concept across four language models, magnitude-matched and concept-specific. Dimensions stay independent throughout (pairwise mutual information below 0.006 bits). The structure is not specific to language: the same per-dimension signs appear in self-supervised vision (DINOv2, 9/12 ImageNet superclasses), supervised vision (ViT-Base, 11/12), and audio (AST, 50/50 ESC-50 categories), so it reflects transformer training in general, not the language-modeling objective. The standard basis already suffices for feature reading at one forward pass, no optimization, no GPU-days. The open problem shifts from finding the right rotation to cataloging what each dimension encodes.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 该论文主要解决灵巧手在操作抽屉、门等铰链物体时，因接触负载变化导致物理接触不稳定和控制失效的问题。现有方法多依赖固定动力学假设或开环轨迹回放，难以在真实物理接触中维持稳定的抓取与拉动。该问题在现实和研究中至关重要，因为家庭服务、辅助机器人和仿人机器人需要灵巧手与日常物体进行自然交互，而真实环境中物体的物理特性往往存在不确定性，解决此问题能显著提升机器人在复杂场景下的操作可靠性。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者发现传统方法在接触负载变化时容易失效，因此设计出仅控制手部、依靠持续物理接触来驱动铰接物体运动的方法。他们通过引入物理感知训练机制，将接触维持、脱离风险和动作边界等物理信号融入策略学习，从而提升系统在动态变化环境中的鲁棒性。该方法借鉴了前期铰接物体交互研究、经典灵巧手操作理论以及约束强化学习等现有工作，并在其基础上进行了扩展。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是将铰接物体的操作转化为完全依赖手部与物体持续物理接触的接触驱动任务，并通过注入可观测的物理信号来提升策略在接触负载变化时的鲁棒性。整体实现流程首先基于几何信息生成参考轨迹以初始化抓取状态和运动尺度，随后在强化学习框架中结合环境奖励与辅助预测损失，将接触维持、脱离风险及动作边界等物理约束融入策略训练，使机械手仅通过闭环接触控制即可稳定完成铰接部件的拉动操作。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于提出了一个以物理接触为核心的灵巧操作框架，策略仅控制机械手，目标部件的运动完全依赖手与物体的持续物理接触自然产生。同时引入了物理信息接触感知训练机制，在不依赖力觉传感器的情况下，通过注入接触维持、脱离风险等物理信号提升策略在接触负载变化时的鲁棒性。与以往依赖几何轨迹回放或固定动力学训练的方法不同，该工作将优化目标从单纯的任务进度转向接触条件约束，有效解决了传统方法在负载变化时容易失效的问题。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了一种接触驱动的灵巧手交互框架及物理感知训练机制，通过引入接触状态与动力学信号引导策略学习，实现了无需力反馈即可在接触负载变化下稳定操控铰接物体的能力。

Abstract

Dexterous interaction with articulated objects is important for household, assistive, and humanoid manipulation, where multi-finger hands can provide compliant contact patterns beyond parallel-jaw grasping. However, articulated-object manipulation differs from static-object manipulation: the target part cannot be directly actuated, and its motion must emerge through sustained physical hand--handle contact. This makes the transition from object-centric articulated generation to hand-driven dexterous hand--object interaction non-trivial, since geometric trajectory replay or open-loop execution does not model the contact dynamics required to move the articulated part. Moreover, policies trained only for task completion under fixed dynamics can overfit nominal contact loads, especially without tactile or force feedback, and may degrade when the contact load changes. To address these challenges, we present DragMesh-2, a contact-driven framework for dexterous interaction with articulated objects that extends articulated interaction from object-centric generation to hand-driven dexterous hand--object interaction, where articulated motion must arise through physical contact. We further propose PICA, a physically informed contact-aware training mechanism that injects physical signals into policy learning without tactile or force feedback, improving robustness and task success under changing contact loads. Finally, we conduct systematic evaluation across multiple damping conditions and articulated-object categories to study robustness under contact-load variation, and provide a pure-geometry dexterous interaction resource to support future loco-manipulation and humanoid hand--object interaction research. Across seven GAPartNet objects, DragMesh-2 achieves stronger robustness under contact-load variation than the compared methods while maintaining high task success across damping conditions.

Abstract

Soil Moisture (SM) modelling constitutes a complex spatiotemporal learning problem characterised by nonlinear environmental interactions, heterogeneous data sources, and limited ground observations. Physics-based approaches, such as water balance models, rely on explicit hydrological equations and high-quality inputs, but their computational cost and scalability limitations restrict large-scale deployment. Data-driven artificial intelligence (AI) methods have emerged as flexible alternatives, enabling the extraction of empirical relationships between soil moisture and environmental variables with reduced modelling assumptions. This work presents a structured survey of AI-based models for soil moisture estimation and classification. Existing approaches are organized into five categories: (a) statistical time-series models, (b) geostatistical methods (c) classical machine learning (ML) models, (d) Deep Learning (DL) models and (e) Probabilistic/Bayesian methods. These models leverage historical soil moisture records, meteorological variables, vegetation indices, topography, soil characteristics, and geolocation data to perform regression or classification tasks.

Abstract

Motivation: Noisy labels are a common challenge in molecular property prediction because molecular annotations are often obtained from assays, curated databases, or weak annotation pipelines rather than directly observed clean biological states. Treating recorded labels as reliable supervision can cause models to memorize corrupted observations and learn misleading molecular evidence. In multimodal molecular representation learning, this issue can be amplified by graph-text fusion or alignment, which may propagate label-induced errors across modalities. Results: We propose MOLAR, a noise-aware framework for learning multimodal molecular representations from noisy labels. MOLAR separates latent clean-property inference from recorded-label observation: graph and text views contribute residual evidence to a clean-property distribution, and a categorical label-observation channel maps this distribution to recorded labels for training. This formulation derives posterior label reliability and modality-specific molecular evidence from the model. Experiments on naturally noisy molecular benchmarks and controlled label-flipping benchmarks show that MOLAR consistently outperforms representative baselines. Visualization analyses further show that MOLAR provides interpretable reliability and modality-evidence diagnostics.

item.title: CloakLM: Obfuscating GPU Memory Layout to Mitigate Model Ex-filtration for Serving
item.author: Kunal Jain, Seokjin Go, Divya Mahajan
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为CloakLM的软件内存混淆框架，旨在保护部署在第三方共享加速器基础设施上的大型基础模型免受模型窃取攻击。

背景: 大型基础模型在第三方或共享加速器上部署时面临模型被窃取的现实风险，现有防御措施未能完全解决该问题。模型权重存储在大块、连续且频繁访问的内存区域中，攻击者可通过被动观察PCIe传输或高带宽内存转储来重构模型。

目的: 消除模型在内存中的结构规律性，在不改变推理栈逻辑内存视图的前提下，防止未经授权的观察者获取模型参数和结构。

方法: 提出CloakLM框架，结合三种机制：PCIe流量整形、层间与层内权重洗牌、物理高带宽内存页重映射。该框架无需硬件改动，与vLLM和PyTorch集成，并可与机密计算互补。

主要发现: 在基于LLaMA和Qwen模型的分布式推理工作负载评估中，CloakLM在保持接近原生性能的同时，显著增强了对PCIe嗅探和高带宽内存转储攻击的抵抗力。

结论: CloakLM有效降低了推理阶段模型被窃取的实际可行性，为共享加速器环境下的模型安全提供了一种高效且无需硬件改动的软件防御方案。

翻译: 部署在第三方和共享加速器基础设施上的大型基础模型面临模型窃取的现实风险，而现有防御措施未能完全解决这一问题。在常见的服务部署中，模型提供商控制虚拟机或裸机服务栈，但不控制底层硬件。主机到GPU的互连、加速器fabric以及相邻的基础设施组件不在租户的信任边界内，且已被证明可被利用。Hermes展示了通过被动观察PCIe实现无损深度学习网络重构，而TunnelS则通过驱动级访问以高吞吐量窃取高带宽内存内容且不干扰推理。共存虚拟机甚至可以访问内存映射接口或配置错误的远程直接内存访问区域，而无需物理共置。这些攻击利用了机器学习系统的一个共同特性：模型权重存储在大块、连续且频繁访问的内存区域中，使得拦截的PCIe传输和高带宽内存转储数据足够丰富，从而揭示模型结构和参数。本文提出CloakLM，一种纯软件内存混淆框架，在不改变推理栈对内存逻辑视图的情况下消除这种结构规律性。CloakLM结合了三机制：PCIe流量整形、层间与层内权重洗牌以及物理高带宽内存页重映射。授权执行保留有效的虚拟内存布局且开销可忽略，而未授权观察者看到的则是碎片化且语义不连贯的状态。CloakLM与vLLM和PyTorch集成，无需硬件改动，并可与机密计算互补。在基于LLaMA和Qwen模型的分布式推理工作负载上的评估表明，其在保持接近原生性能的同时，显著增强了对PCIe嗅探和高带宽内存转储攻击的抵抗力，使得推理时的模型窃取变得实质上不再可行。

Abstract

Large foundation models deployed on third-party and shared accelerator infrastructure face a practical risk of model exfiltration that existing defenses do not fully address. In common serving deployments, model providers control the VM or bare-metal serving stack but not the surrounding hardware substrate. The host to GPU interconnect, accelerator fabric, and neighboring infrastructure components remain outside the tenant's trust boundary and have been shown to be exploitable. Hermes demonstrates lossless DNN reconstruction from passive PCIe observation, while TunnelS exfiltrates HBM contents at high throughput via driver-level access without disrupting inference. Co-tenant VMs can further access memory-mapped interfaces or misconfigured RDMA regions without physical co-location. These attacks exploit a common property of ML systems: model weights are stored in large, contiguous, and repeatedly accessed memory regions, making intercepted PCIe transfers and HBM dumps rich enough to reveal model structure and parameters. We present CloakLM, a software-only memory-obfuscation framework that removes this structural regularity without changing the inference stack's logical view of memory. CloakLM combines three mechanisms: PCIe traffic shaping, inter- and intra-layer weight shuffling, and physical HBM page remapping. Authorized execution retains a valid virtual memory layout with negligible overhead, while unauthorized observers see fragmented and semantically incoherent state. CloakLM integrates with vLLM and PyTorch, requires no hardware changes, and complements confidential computing. Evaluation on distributed inference workloads using LLaMA and Qwen models shows near-native performance while significantly increasing resistance to PCIe snooping and HBM dump attacks, making inference-time model exfiltration substantially less practical.

item.title: TMR-GGNN: Credit Card Fraud Detection based on Time-Aware Multi-Relational Guided Graph Neural Network
item.author: Rohit Tewari, Shubhankar Shilpi, Navin Chhibber, Devendra Singh Parmar, Sunil Khemka, Piyush Ranjan
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 针对信用卡欺诈检测中的数据不平衡、模式演变及复杂关系挑战，本研究提出时间感知多关系引导图神经网络框架。该方法通过构建动态多关系图、引入时间感知注意力机制、结合对比学习与复合损失函数，有效提升了欺诈识别精度与模型泛化能力，降低了漏报率。

背景: 近年来，信用卡欺诈检测面临数据高度不平衡、欺诈模式不断演变以及交易实体间复杂关联结构等显著挑战。

目的: 为应对上述挑战，提出一种名为时间感知多关系引导图神经网络的新型框架。

方法: 扩展编码器解码器图神经网络架构，通过时间窗口建模客户、商户、设备及IP间的异构交互；构建动态多关系图，并在编码器中引入时间感知关系注意力机制以自适应权衡交易相关性；解码器采用对比学习模块区分真实与合成交易模式以提升罕见欺诈案例泛化能力；引入结合信息噪声对比估计对比损失与焦点损失的复合损失函数，以处理类别不平衡并强化判别学习。

主要发现: 复合损失函数的整合有助于提升欺诈识别能力并减少漏报。

结论: 该框架能够有效应对信用卡欺诈检测中的多重挑战，提升模型对罕见欺诈案例的泛化能力与整体识别精度。

翻译: 近年来，信用卡欺诈检测因数据高度不平衡、欺诈模式不断演变以及交易实体间复杂的关联结构而面临重大挑战。为应对这些问题，本研究提出了一种名为时间感知多关系引导图神经网络的新型框架。具体而言，该框架通过时间窗口对客户、商户、设备和IP之间的异构交互进行建模，扩展了编码器解码器图神经网络架构。随后，该方法构建动态多关系图，并在编码器中融入时间感知关系注意力机制，以根据时间邻近性和语义上下文自适应地权衡交易相关性。解码器采用对比学习模块来区分真实与合成的交易模式，同时提升模型对罕见欺诈案例的泛化能力。此外，为有效管理严重的类别不平衡并强调判别学习，引入了一种结合基于信息噪声对比估计的对比损失与焦点损失的复合损失函数。该整合有助于提高欺诈识别能力并减少漏报。

Abstract

In recent years, credit card fraud detection has faced significant challenges due to highly imbalanced data, evolving fraud patterns, and complex relational structures among transaction entities. To address these issues, this research proposes a novel framework called Timeaware Multi Relational Guided Graph Neural Network (TMR GGNN). Particularly, the proposed TMR GGNN extends the encoder decoder Graph Neural Network GNN architecture by modeling heterogeneous interactions across customers, merchants, devices, and IPs over temporal windows. Subsequently, the proposed TMR GGNN approach constructs a dynamic, multi relational graph and incorporates a time aware relational attention mechanism within the encoder to adaptively weigh the transaction relevance based on temporal proximity and semantic context. Consequently, the decoder employs a contrastive learning module to distinguish between real and synthesized transaction patterns, while improving the models generalization of rare fraud cases. Additionally, to effectively manage severe class imbalances and emphasize discriminative learning, a composite loss function combining Information Noise Contrastive Estimation (InfoNCE) based contrastive loss with Focal Loss is introduced. This integration assists in improving fraud identification while mitigating false negatives.

item.title: APT: Atomic Physical Transitions for Causal Video-Language Understanding
item.author: Shang Wu, Haoran Lu, Songling Liu, Chenwei Xu, Lie Lu, Pranav Maneriker, Fan Du, Manling Li, Zhaoran Wang, Han Liu
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: ...

背景: ...

主要发现: ...

结论: ...

Abstract

Physical events are not understood by their names alone, but by the causal state changes that compose them. A clip-level label such as "bounce" can be correct while hiding the process that makes the event physically valid, from support loss and contact onset to rebound and settling. To make this hidden process explicit, we introduce Atomic Physical Transitions (APTs): minimal, temporally localized state changes that bind a visible cue to an active physical mechanism and before/after dynamical regimes. An APT chain represents a video as an ordered causal transition sequence rather than a single aggregate event label: event labels tell what happened; APT chains explain why it happened. To make APTs learnable by VLMs, we construct mixed-source APT data from human annotations and simulator ground truth, covering 14 transition types across contact, gravity, friction, and rotation/stability, with 27,303 timed instances over 1,246 trials. Using this data, we find that current VLMs miss transition-level physics, with zero-shot recall at most 14% and errors dominated by missed transitions. Direct fine-tuning on APT chains improves transition detection but causes event-level forgetting, indicating that the model learns a specialized answer format rather than a reusable physical representation. We therefore propose APT-Tune, a parameter-efficient recipe that teaches VLMs to use causal transitions without forgetting how to answer video questions. It combines image-pad-aware supervision, format-conditional co-training, and mechanism-conditioned domain-to-type decoding to make APT learning format-robust and physically grounded. With only 11 M LoRA parameters on Qwen3-VL-2B, APT-Tune substantially improves APT recall while also improving event-level video transfer. These results show that APTs are not a new answer format, but a human-aligned causal supervision signal for physical video understanding.

Abstract

Classifying implicit hate speech remains a challenge, as intent is often masked through insinuation and context rather than explicit slurs. Prior supervised contrastive approaches improve in-domain detection but can overfit surface cues and struggle to transfer across datasets. We propose ImpSH, a triplet-based framework that aligns posts with implied statements when available and uses context-bounded semi-hard negatives to focus learning on near confusions. We also examine AugSH, which forms positives via data augmentation. In controlled evaluations on IHC, SBIC, and DynaHate with BERT and HateBERT, ImpSH is a viable alternative to standard supervised contrastive baselines and often improves cross-domain performance under matched preprocessing and tuning budgets. Representation analysis using alignment and uniformity indicates tighter positive pairs with balanced global spread, and qualitative nearest-neighbor case studies illustrate typical false negatives under domain shift. These results demonstrate that aligning posts with their implied statements via context-bounded mining provides a more stable, bijective-like mapping to related insinuations, overcoming the volatility inherent in traditional clustering-based representation learning.

item.title: Physics-IQ Verified
item.author: Rädsch, Tim, Asano, Yuki M, Kuehne, Hilde, Bauer, Stefan, Jaini, Priyank, Geirhos, Robert, Lüth, Carsten T.
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文对物理理解基准测试进行了系统审查，通过优化提示词和真实数据质量，并引入样本级评分系统，提出了改进测量视频生成模型物理理解能力的新基准。

背景: 视频生成模型已扩展至世界建模等下游任务，评估其物理现实理解能力成为新兴领域，并催生了通过对比生成视频与真实物理实验视频来量化的基准测试。

目的: 系统审查现有基准测试的不足，提出解决方案以更准确地衡量视频生成模型的物理理解能力。

方法: 提升提示词与真实数据的质量以减少混淆因素干扰，并引入平等加权每个样本和指标的样本级评分系统，构建改进后的基准测试。

主要发现: 改进后的基准测试优化了超过一半的样本并提升了大量提示词，在六种图像到视频生成模型的对比研究中，模型排名发生了中等程度但具有实际意义的变化。

结论: 改进后的基准测试能为物理准确的视频生成模型提供更可靠的评估信号，有望推动该领域发展，相关代码已公开。

翻译: 视频生成模型已成为一个新前沿，不仅可用于视频生成，还可用于世界建模等多种下游任务。为推进这些任务，优秀的视频模型必须理解世界的物理现实。评估这种理解能力是一个新兴领域，并催生了物理智商基准测试，该测试通过比较模型生成的视频与真实物理实验视频来明确量化这一能力。在本工作中，我们对物理智商基准测试进行了系统审查，揭示了其不足之处，并提出了三种解决方案，以提升我们衡量视频生成模型物理理解能力的方式。具体而言，我们提升了提示词和真实数据的质量，以减少混淆因素的影响，并进一步引入了一种样本级评分系统，使每个样本和指标获得同等权重。我们生成的基准测试验证了物理智商基准，优化了百分之五十七点六的所有样本，并改进了超过百分之三十四点八的提示词。在使用六种图像到视频生成模型的对比研究中，我们观察到中等但具有实际意义的排名变化。我们希望物理智商验证基准能通过提供更可靠的信号来推动社区向物理准确的视频生成模型迈进。基准测试的代码可通过此网址获取。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决现有视频生成模型物理理解能力评估基准中存在的提示词模糊、指标聚合方式不合理以及参考视频存在干扰伪影等问题。该问题在研究中非常重要，因为视频生成模型正逐渐被用作模拟物理世界的“世界模型”，若评估基准存在缺陷，将导致模型排名失真，无法真实反映其物理推理能力，从而阻碍可靠物理模拟系统的研发。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者通过系统审计原基准发现提示词模糊、整体聚合掩盖样本差异以及参考视频存在无关干扰等问题，据此设计了提示词优化、样本级平等加权评分和清理参考视频伪影三项改进。该方法主要基于对原基准缺陷的针对性修正，并参考了视频生成模型厂商的提示词输入规范。文中未明确提及借鉴其他特定评估方法，而是以原基准为起点进行重构。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 核心思想是通过修正提示词质量、清理参考视频中的无关干扰并改为样本级评分，来消除原评测基准中的混淆因素，从而更准确地衡量视频生成模型对真实物理规律的理解能力。整体实现流程首先对模糊或错误的文本提示进行明确化修正，并按模型特性重新结构化；其次从参考视频中剔除非物理现象产生的视觉干扰；最后将原本基于整个数据集的聚合评分改为每个样本和指标均等权重的样本级评分机制，最终生成更可靠的物理理解评测分数。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新点在于对原有基准进行了三项核心改进：优化提示词质量以消除模糊描述并采用结构化模板，将指标聚合方式从数据集级改为样本级以实现平等加权，以及清理参考视频中的无关伪影以排除非物理现象干扰。相比之前的工作，新版基准通过修正提示词歧义、消除伪影干扰和解决聚合偏差，使评估结果更精准地反映模型真实的物理推理能力，而非受外部因素或计算方式影响。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文通过修正模糊提示词、引入样本级等权评分机制以及清理参考视频中的干扰伪影，对原有的物理理解评测基准进行了系统优化，从而构建了一个能更准确衡量视频生成模型物理认知能力的新基准。

Abstract

Video generative models ( VGMs) have become a new frontier that can be used not just for video generation but for a multitude of downstream tasks, including world modeling. To advance these tasks, a good video model must understand the physical reality of the world. Evaluating this understanding is an emerging field and has led to the Physics-IQ benchmark, which quantifies this explicitly by comparing model-generated videos to real-world videos of physical experiments. In this work, we present a systematic audit of the Physics-IQ benchmark, expose shortcomings and propose three solutions that sharpen how we can measure physical understanding of VGMs. Specifically, we improve prompt and ground-truth quality to reduce the influence of confounding factors and further introduce a sample-level scoring system that weights each sample and metric equally. Our resulting benchmark, Physics-IQ Verified, refines 57.6\% of all samples and improves over 34.8\% of prompts. In a comparison study using six image-to-video generative models, we observe moderate but meaningful ranking changes (Kendall's $\tau = 0.46$). We hope Physics-IQ Verified advances the community by providing a more reliable signal toward physically accurate VGMs. The code for the benchmark can be accessed at this https URL

item.author: Kaleem Ullah, Altaf Hussain, Muhammad Munsif, Sung Wook Baik

GPT 基础摘要

总结: ...

背景: ...

目的: ...

方法: ...

主要发现: ...

结论: ...

翻译: ...

Abstract

In today's media-driven world, the exponential growth of video content across domains such as surveillance, education, and entertainment has made retrieving semantically relevant videos via natural language queries increasingly critical. Early video retrieval systems relied on handcrafted features or shallow cross-modal mappings, limiting their ability to capture complex semantics and temporal dynamics. While large-scale vision-language models have improved cross-modal alignment, challenges remain in modeling fine-grained temporal dependencies and nuanced linguistic structures. In this paper, we introduce DREAM: Dual-path Representation Enhancement and Alignment Model, a novel multimodal framework that addresses these limitations through enhanced visual and textual encoding. DREAM incorporates a hybrid language modeling strategy that combines masked and permuted language modeling objectives to capture both local and global linguistic semantics. On the visual side, we design a hierarchical vision encoder with cascaded group attention, which integrates spatial and temporal information through multi-stage token interaction and coarse-to-fine attention refinement. We validate DREAM through comprehensive evaluations on the widely-used MSRVTT, MSVD and LSMDC benchmark datasets, where it achieves new state-of-the-art R1 scores of 49.4%, 49.7% and 27.3%, respectively. Qualitative analyses further show the model's ability to maintain coherent attention across frames and align complex queries with dynamic video content. These findings underscore the effectiveness of hierarchical attention and dual-objective textual modeling in enabling robust, context-aware video retrieval, and pave the way for future research in advancing cross-modal representation learning.

item.title: STARE: Surprisal-Guided Token-Level Advantage Reweighting for Policy Entropy Stability
item.author: Luo, Haipeng, Sun, Qingfeng, Wu, Songli, Xu, Can, Deng, Wenfeng, Hu, Han, Tang, Yansong
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出STARE方法，通过惊喜度引导的令牌级优势重加权和目标熵闭环门控，有效解决大语言模型强化学习训练中的策略熵崩溃问题，在多项基准测试中显著提升准确率并维持探索与利用的平衡。

背景: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习算法是当前大语言模型复杂推理训练的主流范式，但在训练过程中普遍面临策略熵崩溃的问题。

目的: 解决强化学习训练过程中的策略熵崩溃问题，实现策略熵的稳定调控。

方法: 提出STARE方法，通过批次内部惊喜度分位数识别熵关键令牌子集，选择性重加权其有效优势，并引入目标熵闭环门控机制以实现稳定的熵调控。

主要发现: 对GRPO下的令牌级熵动力学进行一阶梯度分析，发现令牌级信用分配不匹配现象。令牌级熵变可分解为轨迹级优势与下一令牌分布熵敏感度函数的乘积，呈现出优势惊喜度四象限结构及近临界特性。

结论: STARE在从一百五十亿到三百二十亿参数的模型及多种任务上均能维持数千步的稳定强化学习训练，策略熵保持在目标区间内。在AIME二十四和AIME二十五基准上，其平均准确率较DAPO等基线方法提升百分之四到百分之八，反思令牌与响应长度同步增长，表明探索与利用的平衡得以持续维持。

翻译: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习算法如GRPO已成为大语言模型复杂推理训练的主流后训练范式，但其在训练过程中普遍面临策略熵崩溃的问题。本文对GRPO下的令牌级熵动力学进行了一阶梯度分析，发现令牌级信用分配存在不匹配：令牌级熵变可分解为轨迹级优势与下一令牌分布熵敏感度函数的乘积，从而呈现出优势惊喜度四象限结构及近临界特性。受此启发，我们提出了STARE方法。该方法通过批次内部惊喜度分位数识别熵关键令牌子集，选择性重加权其有效优势，并引入目标熵闭环门控以实现稳定的熵调控。在从一百五十亿到三百二十亿参数的模型及短思维链、长思维链和多轮工具使用三类任务上，STARE均能维持数千步的稳定强化学习训练，并将策略熵保持在目标区间内。在AIME二十四和AIME二十五基准测试中，STARE的平均准确率较DAPO及其他竞争性基线方法提升百分之四到百分之八，且反思令牌与响应长度同步增长，表明探索与利用的平衡得以持续维持，进一步释放了强化学习训练的潜力。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决大语言模型在强化学习训练过程中出现的策略熵崩溃问题，即模型输出多样性迅速丧失并过早收敛。该问题在研究中至关重要，因为熵崩溃会破坏训练信号的有效性，严重限制可训练的步数，并阻碍模型在复杂推理任务中保持探索与利用的平衡，从而制约了模型性能的进一步提升。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者首先对原强化学习算法进行了梯度分析，发现其存在轨迹级奖励信号与词元级熵变不匹配的问题，并由此推导出优势与词元惊讶值的四象限结构及近临界性。基于这一理论发现，他们设计了该方法，通过批次内部的惊讶值分位数筛选关键词元，选择性调整其有效奖励信号，并引入目标熵闭环门控机制以实现稳定调控。该方法并非直接借鉴现有工作，而是针对现有缓解策略缺乏词元级理论依据的不足，提出的全新底层机制。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是通过识别并重新分配对策略熵影响最大的关键词元优势值，来防止强化学习训练中的策略熵崩溃。整体实现流程首先利用批次内部的词元意外度分位数筛选出熵临界词元子集，接着有选择地放大正优势轨迹中意外度高词元的有效优势并削弱负优势轨迹中同类词元的优势。最后，该方法引入目标熵闭环门控机制，仅在批次平均熵低于设定目标时激活重加权操作，熵恢复后则自动切换回原始算法，从而实现稳定且低侵入性的熵调控。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于提出了一种基于意外度引导的令牌级优势重加权机制，并引入了目标熵闭环门控进行动态调节。相比以往在轨迹或样本层面进行粗粒度调整、易受超参数影响或效果不对称的现有方法，该工作首次从一阶梯度分析揭示了训练过程中令牌级信用分配不匹配的根本原因。它通过批量内部意外度分位数精准识别关键令牌并选择性调整其优势值，仅在策略熵低于目标阈值时激活干预，从而以极小侵入性实现稳定、可控的熵值调节。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了一种基于词元惊奇度的优势重加权方法，结合目标熵闭环控制机制，有效缓解了强化学习训练中的策略熵崩溃问题，从而在保持模型探索能力的同时显著提升了复杂推理任务的性能。

Abstract

Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards algorithms like GRPO have emerged as the dominant post-training paradigm for complex reasoning in LLMs, yet commonly suffer from policy entropy collapse during training. We conduct a first-order gradient analysis of token-level entropy dynamics under GRPO and identify a token-level credit assignment mismatch: the per-token entropy variation decomposes into the product of the trajectory-level advantage and an entropy sensitivity function over the next-token distribution, yielding an advantage-surprisal four-quadrant structure and a near-criticality property. Motivated by it, we propose STARE (Surprisal-guided Token-level Advantage Reweighting for policy Entropy stability), which identifies entropy-critical token subsets via batch-internal surprisal quantiles, selectively reweights their effective advantages, and incorporates a target-entropy closed-loop gate for stable entropy regulation. Across model scales from 1.5B to 32B and three task families (Short CoT, Long CoT, and Multi-Turn Tool Use), STARE sustains stable RL training over thousands of steps while maintaining policy entropy within the target band. On AIME24 and AIME25, STARE outperforms DAPO and other competitive baselines by 4%-8% in average accuracy, with reflection tokens and response length growing in tandem, indicating sustained exploration-exploitation balance that further unlocks RL training this http URL is available at this https URL .

item.title: Reference-Driven Multi-Speaker Audio Scene Generation from In-the-Wild Priors
item.author: Michael Finkelson, Daniel Segal, Eitan Richardson, Shahar Armon, Nani Goldring, Poriya Panet, Nir Zabari, Benjamin Brazowski, Or Patashnik, Yoav HaCohen
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: ...

背景: ...

目的: ...

方法: ...

主要发现: ...

结论: ...

翻译: ...

Abstract

Existing multi-speaker dialogue systems bind speakers to utterances through structured supervision: per-turn tags, multi-stream transcriptions, or learnable speaker embeddings. These systems operate within speech-only pipelines that produce clean vocal sequences without the ambient texture of real conversations. We take a different approach. Our method, ScenA, conditions a text-to-audio flow-matching foundation model, pretrained on large-scale in-the-wild data, directly on multiple reference voices and a free-form natural language prompt that describes an entire multi-speaker audio scene. Leveraging such a foundational model allows us to inherit its capacity for natural, non-studio audio: background noise, room acoustics, overlapping dialogue, and spontaneous paralinguistic events, while adding multi-speaker control without any per-turn structure. Concretely, reference latents are concatenated into the model's token sequence and distinguished by lightweight identity-aware positional encodings. However, we identify a critical obstacle to this approach: the \textit{Reference Shortcut}. During training under standard noise schedules, the model can identify the matching reference by acoustic similarity to the noisy target, bypassing the text prompt entirely. We address this with a high-noise-biased timestep distribution that forces the model to rely on the text prompt for speaker assignment. We evaluate ScenA on the CoVoMix2-Dialogue benchmark, showing that it outperforms existing multi-speaker systems on speaker-binding metrics while generating rich conversational audio with overlapping speech, emotional vocalizations, and ambient sound. Our results demonstrate the advantage of using a general-purpose audio model conditioned on a free-form scene description, rather than passing structured dialog scripts through a speech-only pipeline.

item.title: Understanding Key Features of Time Series Foundation Models from Epidemic Forecasting
item.author: Alireza Jafari, Judy Fox, Geoffrey C. Fox, Madhav Marathe, Aniruddha Adiga
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: ...

背景: ...

目的: ...

方法: ...

主要发现: ...

结论: ...

翻译: Seasonal influenza infects millions of people and causes substantial morbidity and mortality in the United States each year, making accurate short-term forecasting a core public-health need. Reliable forecasts of epidemic time series can inform vaccination timing, hospital staffing, and resource allocation, yet the comparative behavior of modern forecasting architectures on infectious-disease surveillance data remains insufficiently characterized. We address this gap through a systematic evaluation of regional influenza forecasting using influenza-like illness surveillance and influenza-associated hospitalization time series under both temporal and spatial generalization settings for 1-4-week-ahead prediction. We compare classical neural network architectures, numerical transformer-based models, pretrained time series foundation models, and LLM-based forecasting approaches. Across tasks, we demonstrate that a mixture-of-experts model that fuses multiple pretrained forecasters achieves the strongest overall performance, indicating that heterogeneous pretrained representations provide complementary predictive information. Our results further show that numerical transformer-based models produce reliable forecasts, while pretraining provides the largest gains at longer horizons, particularly when the pretraining domain is mechanistically aligned with influenza dynamics. In contrast, LLM-based time series methods underperform relative to numerical forecasters in this setting. Finally, we examine hospitalization information as both an auxiliary covariate and a pretraining source. Hospitalization signals provide complementary improvements in selected settings and clarify when additional surveillance streams enhance the robustness of multi-horizon forecasting. These findings provide actionable guidance on model selection, pretraining strategy, and auxiliary-signal use for influenza preparedness.

item.title: Exploring the potential of AlphaEarth and TESSERA embeddings for Fine-scale Local Climate Zone Mapping: A case study across five cities in Switzerland
item.author: Htet Yamin Ko Ko, Clement Atzberger
item.description:

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本研究验证了利用地球观测基础模型嵌入将局部气候区地图上采样至十米分辨率的可行性，为精细尺度城市气候研究提供了高效可扩展的深度学习映射框架。

背景: 理解城市空间形态对气候建模与城市规划至关重要，局部气候区映射为此提供基础框架。但现有记录分辨率较粗，难以满足精细尺度研究需求。

目的: 比较预计算的基础模型嵌入与传统卫星数据组合，评估其是否能够将粗分辨率局部气候区地图上采样至十米分辨率。

方法: 在瑞士五个城市开展实验，利用基于注意力的神经网络架构，对比不同数据源的多城市迁移能力、高分辨率参考数据影响及时间鲁棒性。

主要发现: 所有数据源在测试中均取得良好表现，其中特定基础模型嵌入 consistently 优于其他数据。跨年份模型迁移仍具挑战性，而提升参考数据质量是进一步提高精度的关键。

结论: 地球观测基础模型嵌入能有效减少预处理与特征工程负担，增强区域迁移性与可扩展性，支持开发全面可复现的精细尺度局部气候区地图。

翻译: 理解城市空间形态对气候建模、风险评估和可持续城市规划至关重要，局部气候区映射为此提供了基础框架。然而，许多城市仍使用分辨率较粗的局部气候区记录，不适合精细尺度的城市研究。本研究在瑞士五个城市比较了预计算的基础模型嵌入与传统卫星数据组合，以评估其是否可通过基于注意力的网络将粗分辨率局部气候区地图上采样至十米分辨率。实验评估了多城市迁移能力、更高分辨率参考数据的影响及时间鲁棒性。结果显示所有数据集均表现强劲，其中特定模型 consistently 优于其他数据。跨年份迁移仍是挑战。总体而言，结果证明了地球观测基础模型嵌入的潜力，可减少预处理和特征工程负担，提升区域迁移性与可扩展性，支持开发全面可复现的精细尺度局部气候区地图。提高参考数据质量是进一步提升精度的关键。

Abstract

Understanding urban spatial morphology is critical for climate modeling, risk assessment, and sustainable urban design, and Local Climate Zone (LCZ) mapping provides the basic framework for this. However, many cities still use coarse ~100-m resolution LCZ records, which are unsuitable for fine-scale urban research. In this study, precomputed embeddings from TESSERA (Feng et al., 2025) and AlphaEarth (Brown et al., 2025) are compared to traditional Sentinel-1/2 (S1S2) composites in five Swiss cities to see if they can upscale coarse LCZ maps to 10-m resolution using an attention-based U-Net. Three experiments assess multi-city transferability, the impact of higher-resolution reference data, and temporal robustness to year-to-year phenology changes. We find that all datasets achieve strong performance with test data Intersection-over-Union (IoU) ranging from 0.59-0.69 and 0.77-0.82 in the first two experiments. TESSERA consistently outperforms both S1S2 and AlphaEarth across both settings As expected, we find that the transfer of embedding-based models from one year to another remains an open challenge. Overall, however, our results demonstrate the promising potential of embeddings derived from EO foundation models to reduce time consuming preprocessing, respectively, manual feature engineering tasks and to guide a universal deep learning-based LCZ mapping workflow. When combined with a simple location-aware attention U-Net architecture, the embeddings enhance regional transferability and scalability, supporting the development of comprehensive and reproducible fine-scale LCZ maps for global urban climate applications Improving reference data quality remains the strongest lever for further accuracy gains.

item.title: ELVA: Exploring Ranking-Driven Universal Multimodal Retrieval
item.author: Yuhan Liu, Pei Fu, Hang Li, Yukun Qi, Chao Jiang, Jingwen Fu, Zhen Liu, Bin Qin, Zhenbo Luo, Jian Luan, Jingmin Xin

主要发现: ...

结论: ...

翻译: ...

Abstract

Leveraging Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) via contrastive learning has become a mainstream paradigm for improving the performance of Universal Multimodal Retrieval (UMR). However, previous works have ignored the grain blindness when adapting the contrastive paradigm into retrieval tasks. Grain blindness refers to the tendency of the model to overlook grain-level information contained in the query, which is crucial for effectively handling complex queries. This stems from contrastive learning treating samples as a binary classification (positive/negative), while ignoring the different information carried by each negative sample. To address this, we argue that negatives should be treated differently according to their similarity to the positive sample, enabling the model to learn distinct grain information from each negative. In this paper, we introduce a simple but effective framework, called ELVA, a novel rule-based RL framework that mitigates grain blindness through ranking-driven MLLMs. 1) Instead of relying on reward models, we extend Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) to retrieval tasks, allowing the model to explore new ranking behaviors without explicit ranking labels. 2) By utilizing rule-based rewards, our approach jointly optimizes the ranking of negative samples while enlarging the similarity gap between positive and negative. To more precisely measure grain blindness, we further introduce MRBench, a new benchmark specifically designed for multi-grain query scenarios. ELVA achieves state-of-the-art results across standard retrieval benchmarks, and its notable 13.1% improvement on MRBench further demonstrates its effectiveness in alleviating grain blindness.

item.title: Slow Brain, Fast Planner: Latency-Resilient VLM-Augmented Urban Navigation
item.author: Zhenghao "Mark'' Peng, Honglin He, Quanyi Li, Yukai Ma, Bolei Zhou
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: ...

背景: ...

目的: ...

方法: ...

主要发现: ...

结论: ...

翻译: ...

Abstract

Learning-based planners for sidewalk navigation can generate diverse candidate trajectories in real time, yet their scoring functions often fail to select the best trajectory in challenging situations, outputting trajectories that make the mobile robot drive onto grass, toward pedestrians, or in the wrong direction, even when better candidates exist in the same set. We call this the trajectory scoring gap: in real-world sidewalk navigation, the gap between an anchor-based planner's top choice and the best possible candidate is substantial, likely due to limited high-level scene understanding capability of the planner. Rather than replacing the planner with an end-to-end Vision-Language-Action model, we propose a VLM-Planner interface that uses a VLM to select a candidate index from the planner's proposal set and then fuse it with the planner's initial output. However, VLMs take 1--3s per query and so cannot directly drive a 5--20Hz control loop. We contribute a training-free, latency-resilient trajectory-level fusion layer that turns a stale VLM selection into real-time planner scoring via geometric similarity with exponential decay. On $\sim$2,000 challenging real-world scenarios (e.g., junctions, pedestrian encounters), VLM selection achieves 30% ADE reduction versus the planner's best selection, while the planner remains competitive in routine situations. In simulation, Score Fusion maintains >80% success rate with delays up to 5s. We demonstrate the full system on a mobile robot navigating challenging campus sidewalks with varied network latency.

item.title: Distilling Examples into Task Instructions: Enhanced In-Context Learning for Real-World B2B Conversations
item.author: Rotman, Guy, Kopilov, Adi, Zalmanson, Danit Berger, Allouche, Omri
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文针对传统上下文学习在专业领域复杂商务对话分类中的局限性，提出了一种新型知识提取方法并发布了相关数据集，显著提升了分类性能与实际应用价值。

背景: 上下文学习是低资源分类的标准方法，但其在专业领域的有效性尚未充分探索。传统方法在处理语义复杂的多方商务对话时面临显著限制，尤其是在拼接多个少样本示例导致上下文长度增加时。

目的: 解决传统上下文学习在复杂商务对话分类中的局限，弥合模型性能与实际应用需求之间的差距，提升分类逻辑的透明度、效率及用户交互能力。

方法: 发布包含五个分类任务的通话手册数据集；提出新型知识提取方法，将冗长的示例提炼为紧凑、可解释的结构化分类标准和精确任务描述。

主要发现: 该方法使标记使用量减少百分之九十九，宏观平均受试者工作特征曲线下面积较传统上下文学习提升最高百分之七；随着上下文增长保持稳健，而先进的标记压缩基线方法性能下降超过九个分数点。

结论: 该框架支持对分类逻辑进行直接优化，满足了现实自然语言处理应用中对透明度、效率和用户交互的关键需求，为专业领域的低资源分类提供了实用解决方案。

翻译: 上下文学习是低资源分类的标准方法，但其在专业领域的有效性尚未充分探索。我们致力于解决对语义复杂的多方商务对话进行分类的挑战，传统上下文学习在此面临显著局限，尤其是在拼接多个少样本示例导致上下文长度增加时。我们发布了通话手册数据集，包含源自真实商务对话并针对核心销售概念的五个分类任务。为弥合性能与实际效用之间的差距，我们提出了新型知识提取方法，将冗长的示例提炼为紧凑、可解释的结构化分类标准和精确任务描述。我们的方法使标记使用量减少百分之九十九，宏观平均受试者工作特征曲线下面积较传统上下文学习提升最高百分之七。值得注意的是，随着上下文增长该方法保持稳健，而先进的标记压缩基线方法性能下降超过九个分数点。重要的是，我们的框架支持对分类逻辑进行直接优化，满足了现实自然语言处理应用中对透明度、效率和用户交互的关键需求。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决传统上下文学习方法在处理复杂的多方企业对话时，因拼接多个示例导致上下文过长、模型性能下降且缺乏可解释性的问题。该问题在研究和现实中非常重要，因为自动分类此类对话能帮助企业高效提取关键商业情报以指导销售策略，但受限于标注数据稀缺和人工成本高昂，且业务人员必须依赖透明可审计的决策依据来维持信任。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者针对传统上下文学习中直接拼接多个示例会导致输入过长、性能下降且缺乏可解释性的问题，设计了利用大语言模型将原始示例自动转化为结构化分类标准与任务描述的知识提取方法。该方法在现有研究基础上进行了明确区分，并未直接沿用检索筛选、提示词重构或词元压缩等现有技术。这些现有方法多侧重于在原始示例上做减法，往往造成信息碎片化或需额外训练，而作者的方法通过改变知识表示形式，在大幅缩减输入长度的同时保留了逻辑连贯性与人机协同优化的空间。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是摒弃传统将多个示例直接拼接的做法，转而利用大语言模型自动从少量标注示例中提取通用任务知识，并将其转化为清晰的结构化分类标准或任务描述来替代原始示例。整体实现流程主要包含四个环节。首先抽取少量带标签的对话片段，接着利用模型将其蒸馏为明确的分类准则或任务说明，然后将用户意图、提取的知识与待分类的新片段组合成提示词，最后输入模型进行推理并输出分类结果。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 论文的关键创新点在于提出了一种知识提取框架，能够自动从少量标注示例中提炼出结构化的分类标准和任务描述，并用这些紧凑的文本替代传统的示例拼接。与以往依赖检索优化、提示词重构或片段级压缩的工作不同，该方法彻底改变了上下文信息的呈现形式，不仅大幅降低了输入长度消耗并提升了长上下文下的稳定性，还保留了高度的可解释性，支持人工直接优化分类逻辑。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一种将少样本示例自动提炼为简洁可解释的分类标准与任务说明的知识提取方法，在大幅降低计算成本的同时显著提升了B2B对话分类的准确率与决策透明度。

Abstract

In-context learning (ICL) is the standard method for low-resource classification, yet its efficacy in specialized domains remains largely unexplored. We address the challenge of classifying semantically complex, multi-party B2B conversations, where traditional ICL encounters significant limitations, especially as context length increases due to the concatenation of multiple few-shot examples. We introduce the \texttt{Call Playbook} dataset, featuring five classification tasks derived from real-world B2B conversations targeting core sales concepts. To bridge the gap between performance and practical utility, we propose novel knowledge extraction methods that distill verbose examples into compact, interpretable representations of structured classification criteria and precise task descriptions. Our approach achieves a 99\% reduction in token usage and improves macro-averaged AUC by up to 7\% over traditional ICL. Notably, it remains robust as context grows, unlike advanced token compression baselines which degrade by over 9 F1 points. Importantly, our framework enables direct refinement of classification logic, addressing critical needs for transparency, efficiency, and user interaction in real-world NLP applications.

item.title: The Data Manifold under the Microscope
item.author: Koulakis, Marios, Seibold, Constantin
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种用于研究数据几何结构的基准测试框架，通过扩展经典数据集并结合高精度估计器，为几何估计器提供校准环境，并用于验证和引导深度学习理论假设。

背景: 深度学习理论与实践存在显著差距，现有泛化与近似误差界限通常基于简化模型或过于宽松，且多依赖流形假设与几何正则性。现有基准测试两极分化：解析流形几何已知但适用性有限，真实数据集几何难以精确估计。

目的: 构建一个可控的测试环境，用于校准几何估计器，并作为探索理论假设的沙盒，以弥合理论与实际之间的差距。

方法: 改造并扩展了dSprites和COIL二十数据集，增加变换维度与密集轴对齐采样，并结合有限差分估计器，在通用估计器失效的范围内以接近真实值的精度恢复曲率、可达性和体积。

主要发现: 通过两项应用研究展示了框架效用：一是评估了特定学者的误差界限缩放行为，二是追踪了变分自编码器的逐层几何结构，揭示了现有界限的表现并证明了可控基准对理论指导的价值。

结论: 可控基准测试对于引导和验证未来深度学习理论具有重要价值，相关参考实现已公开。

翻译: 深度学习在理论与实践之间存在显著差距。泛化与近似误差界限通常是为简化模型推导的，或者过于宽松而缺乏信息量。许多界限依赖于流形假设以及内在维度、曲率和可达性等几何正则性。取得进展需要深入了解数据流形几何结构并采用合适的基准测试，然而现有选项两极分化：具有已知几何结构但适用性有限的解析流形，或几何结构仅能粗略估计的真实世界数据集。我们引入了一种用于研究数据几何的基准测试框架。我们改造并扩展了dSprites和COIL二十数据集，增加了额外的变换维度和密集的轴对齐采样，并将其与有限差分估计器配对，在通用估计器不可靠或难以部署的范围内，以接近真实值的精度恢复曲率、可达性和体积。该框架旨在作为可控测试平台，既可作为几何估计器的校准环境，也可作为探测理论假设的沙盒。为说明其用途，我们展示了两项应用研究，即评估Genovese等人及Fefferman等人界限的缩放行为，以及追踪beta变分自编码器的逐层几何结构，突出了现有界限的行为，并展示了可控基准测试在引导和验证未来理论方面的价值。参考实现已在此处提供。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要致力于解决深度学习理论与实际应用中存在的脱节问题，特别是现有理论所依赖的几何参数在真实数据中难以准确测量和验证的困境。该问题在研究中非常重要，因为只有通过可控的基准测试平台，才能有效校准几何估计器、验证现有理论界限的适用性，并为改进深度学习模型的理论保证提供实证依据。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者基于深度学习理论与实证之间的差距进行思考，发现现有理论依赖的几何量在真实数据中难以精确观测，而纯解析流形又缺乏实际应用价值。为此，他们设计了结合密集网格采样与有限差分估计器的基准框架，以在可控条件下精确还原流形的曲率、可达性和体积。该方法借鉴了经典的dSprites和COIL-20数据集，并直接针对Genovese等人及Fefferman等人的流形拟合理论界限进行实证检验，同时吸收了现有几何属性估计与流形假设的相关研究成果。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是构建一个可控的合成数据集基准测试框架，通过沿已知变换轴进行密集采样，使数据流形的几何结构具有精确的地面真值，从而弥补理论与实证之间的差距。整体实现流程首先对现有数据集进行扩展并施加规则网格采样，随后利用有限差分法高精度估算曲率、可达性和体积等几何量，最后将这些估算结果与生成模型或理论误差界限进行对比验证，为几何估计器和理论假设提供校准环境。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于提出了一套用于研究数据流形几何特性的基准测试框架。它通过改造扩展标准数据集，结合密集且沿坐标轴对齐的采样方法，并配套开发了高精度的有限差分几何量估计器。与以往工作相比，该框架有效弥补了理论流形过于简单或真实数据集几何信息模糊的空白，为几何估计器的校准和理论假设的验证提供了一个可控的实验环境。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一套可复现的基准测试框架，通过结合密集采样的低维数据集与高精度的有限差分几何估计器，为验证几何测量工具和检验深度学习理论边界提供了可控的实验环境。

Abstract

A significant gap exists between theory and practice in deep learning. Generalization and approximation error bounds are often derived for simplified models or are too loose to be informative. Many rely on the manifold hypothesis and on geometric regularity such as intrinsic dimension, curvature, and reach. Progress requires insight into data-manifold geometry and suitable benchmarks, yet existing options are polarized: analytic manifolds with known geometry but limited applicability, or real-world datasets where geometry is only coarsely estimable. We introduce a benchmarking framework for studying data geometry. We repurpose and extend dSprites and COIL-20 with additional transformation dimensions and dense, axis-aligned sampling, and pair them with finite-difference estimators that recover curvature, reach, and volume at near-ground-truth accuracy in a regime where general-purpose estimators are unreliable or difficult to deploy. The framework is intended as a controlled testbed, useful as a calibration environment for geometric estimators and a sandbox for probing theoretical assumptions. To illustrate its use, we present two application studies, namely assessing the scaling behavior of the bounds of Genovese et al. and Fefferman et al., and tracking the layer-wise geometry of a $\beta$-VAE, highlighting the behavior of current bounds and the value of controlled benchmarks for guiding and validating future theory. A reference implementation is available at this https URL .

item.title: Taylor-Calibrate: Principled Initialization for Hybrid Linear Attention Distillation
item.author: Zhou, Zhongzhu, Wu, Qingyang, Wang, Junxiong, Mishra, Mayank, Song, Shuaiwen Leon, Athiwaratkun, Ben, Xu, Chenfeng
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为泰勒校准的轻量级初始化方法，用于将预训练Transformer高效转换为门控Delta网络，显著提升了零样本性能并减少了训练开销。

背景: 混合线性注意力模型能降低长上下文推理的二次方计算成本和键值缓存负担，同时保持Transformer的质量。直接复制教师注意力投影到学生网络进行转换的方法仍不稳定。

目的: 解决直接转换模型时动态参数未指定、初始状态差、需消耗大量蒸馏令牌修复初始化的问题，实现高效准确的模型转换。

方法: 利用泰勒引导的教师注意力统计信息设定值投影、记忆时间尺度、写入门和输出门，并执行简短的逐层对齐步骤以匹配教师输出。

主要发现: 在多种教师设置和保留层策略下，该方法显著增强了零样本学生模型的性能，在代表性消融实验中提升达八十八倍，且达到相同恢复目标所需的训练令牌数量仅为朴素转换方法的二分之一到五分之一左右。

结论: 泰勒校准是一种有效且轻量的初始化策略，能大幅优化混合注意力模型的转换效率与效果。

翻译: 混合线性注意力模型为更快的长上下文推理提供了一条有吸引力的路径：它们在保留Transformer模型大部分质量的同时，降低了全softmax注意力的二次方成本和键值缓存负担。获取此类模型的一种实用方法是转换预训练的Transformer，而不是从头预训练新架构，但此转换过程仍然脆弱。简单地将教师注意力投影复制到门控DeltaNet学生网络中，并未指定新的循环衰减、写入和输出门控动态。因此，转换后的模型通常始于较差的动态状态，必须花费大量蒸馏令牌来修复初始化，而不是学习剩余的教师行为。我们提出了泰勒校准，这是一种用于混合门控DeltaNet学生的轻量级初始化方法。该方法使用泰勒引导的教师注意力统计信息来设定值投影、记忆时间尺度、写入门和输出门，然后应用简短的逐层对齐步骤，使每个转换层与教师输出匹配。在四种教师设置和三种保留层策略下，泰勒校准提供了显著更强的零样本学生模型，在代表性消融实验中提升达八十八倍，并且达到匹配的恢复目标所需的训练令牌数量比朴素转换少四点九到九点二倍。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决将预训练语言模型转换为混合线性注意力架构时，新引入的循环参数初始化不当导致模型性能低下且训练效率极低的问题。该问题在研究和应用中至关重要，因为传统注意力机制的计算成本和内存占用会随文本长度呈二次方增长，严重制约了长上下文推理的实际部署。通过科学设定这些循环参数的初始值，可以大幅减少模型恢复性能所需的训练数据量，从而以更低成本实现高效、高质量的长文本处理。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者发现直接将预训练模型的权重复制到新型循环注意力架构中，会导致新引入的循环参数处于随机状态，从而引发初始性能差和训练效率低的问题。为此，他们借鉴了将注意力机制展开为泰勒级数以近似线性循环计算的相关理论，从教师模型的注意力统计量中提取数值幅度、平均回溯距离和注意力集中度，并据此科学地初始化学生模型的各项门控参数。此外，该方法还参考了近期模型转换研究中常用的逐层输出匹配技术，在正式训练前进行短暂的局部对齐，以确保初始化效果。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 核心思想是将混合线性注意力模型的转换视为对循环动态参数的初始化问题，而非简单的权重复制。它利用教师模型注意力机制的统计特征，通过泰勒展开的近似关系，为新生成的循环衰减、写入门控和输出门控等参数设定合理的初始值。整体流程分为两步：首先基于教师注意力统计量计算并初始化这些关键参数；随后在少量校准数据上对每个转换层进行短暂的局部对齐训练，使学生层输出逼近教师层输出，从而为后续的全模型蒸馏提供高质量起点。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于提出了一种两阶段初始化方法，将混合线性注意力模型的转换明确视为循环动力学参数的初始化问题，而非仅仅复制投影权重。相比以往工作将新参数留待训练发现的做法，该方法直接利用教师模型的注意力统计信息来校准值投影幅度、记忆衰减时间和读写门控参数，并辅以短暂的逐层对齐步骤。这使得转换后的模型在零样本测试中表现更强，且能用更少的训练数据快速恢复教师模型的性能。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一种名为Taylor-Calibrate的两阶段初始化方法，通过利用教师模型的注意力统计信息校准循环参数并进行局部对齐，显著提升了混合线性注意力模型转换后的零样本性能并大幅减少了训练所需的数据量。

Abstract

Hybrid linear attention models offer an appealing path to faster long-context inference: they reduce the quadratic cost and KV-cache burden of full softmax attention while retaining much of the quality of Transformer models. A practical way to obtain such models is to convert a pretrained Transformer instead of pretraining a new architecture from scratch, but this conversion is still brittle. Simply copying the teacher attention projections into a Gated DeltaNet (GDN) student does not specify the new recurrent decay, write, and output-gating dynamics. As a result, the converted model often starts in a poor dynamical regime and must spend many distillation tokens repairing initialization rather than learning the remaining teacher behavior. We propose Taylor-Calibrate, a lightweight initialization method for hybrid GDN students. The method uses Taylor-guided teacher attention statistics to set the value projection, memory timescale, write gates, and output gate, then applies a short per-layer alignment step to match each converted layer to the teacher output. Across four teacher settings and three retained-layer policies, Taylor-Calibrate gives substantially stronger zero-shot students, with up to an 88x improvement in a representative ablation, and reaches matched recovery targets with 4.9x--9.2x fewer training tokens than naive conversion.

item.title: MyPCBench: A Benchmark for Personally Intelligent Computer-Use Agents
item.author: Jang, Lawrence Keunho, Jang, Andrew Keunwoo, Koh, Jing Yu, Salakhutdinov, Ruslan
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了MyPCBench基准测试，旨在评估计算机使用代理作为个人助理在个性化数字环境中的表现，填补了现有评估与实际部署之间的差距。

背景: 现有的计算机使用代理基准测试主要在无个人特征的环境中进行，导致评估结果与实际部署存在差距。个人助理需要在包含用户上下文、历史数据和登录账户的完整数字生活中工作，而当前基于网页的实时评估无法测试需要登录或处理个人信息的网站。

目的: 构建一个贴近真实个人助理使用场景的测试环境，以全面评估计算机使用代理在个性化任务中的能力。

方法: 搭建了一个包含十七个模拟真实网页应用和完整桌面栈的Linux桌面环境，并设定了固定用户画像。基于真实社区请求定义了一百八十四项任务，使用统一的电脑操作加命令行工具接口，对六个闭源和开源权重模型进行了基准测试。

主要发现: 表现最佳的模型仅能完全解决百分之五十五点四的任务，是唯一超过一半正确率的模型。模型失败主要集中在需要跨多个应用协作和长轨迹操作的任务上，个性化需求在此类场景中给助理带来最大压力。

结论: 研究团队已公开该测试环境、任务集及代理运行框架，为后续个人助理型计算机使用代理的研究与开发提供了资源。

翻译: 现有的计算机使用代理基准测试主要在无个人特征的环境中对模型进行评估。这导致评估与实际部署之间存在差距，因为个人助理需要在用户的整个数字生活中工作，包括其上下文、历史数据和已登录的账户。这一差距在网页任务中最为明显，因为实时网页评估无法测试需要登录或处理个人信息的网站，而这正是真正的个人助理必须操作的网站类型。我们推出了MyPCBench，该基准测试在一个Linux桌面上测试计算机使用代理作为个人助理的表现，该桌面配置了十七个模拟的真实网页应用和完整的桌面栈，所有数据均基于固定角色迈克尔斯科特进行初始化。我们在此环境中定义了一百八十四项任务，每项任务均受真实社区请求的启发，并使用统一的电脑操作加命令行工具接口对六个闭源和开源权重模型进行了基准测试。我们发现表现最佳的模型完全解决了一百八十四项任务中的百分之五十五点四，是唯一正确率超过一半的模型。模型失败主要集中在跨越多个应用的任务和长轨迹任务上，个性化在此类场景中给助理带来的压力最大。我们已公开该环境、任务集和代理运行框架。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决现有计算机智能体评测基准缺乏个性化数据的问题，即当前基准多在空白或通用环境中测试，无法反映智能体在真实个人数字生活中的表现。该问题在研究和现实中非常重要，因为真正的个人助理必须能够跨应用调用用户的登录状态、历史数据和上下文信息，缺乏此类评测会导致模型能力评估与实际部署需求脱节，阻碍个性化智能体向实用化产品的演进。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者发现现有评测缺乏个人历史数据与登录状态，无法真实检验个人助理能力，因此设计了一个以固定人物设定为种子、包含多个模拟应用和完整桌面栈的Linux环境。该环境通过确定性流水线生成跨应用一致的个人数据，并参考开源社区的真实需求编写了测试任务。在构建过程中，作者借鉴了现有桌面评测的虚拟机快照重置机制、人物设定思路以及评估标准格式，在此基础上将其扩展为支持持久化身份和跨应用数据关联的完整基准。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 核心思想是构建一个以单一固定人物身份为基准的可复现桌面环境，用于评估人工智能代理在跨应用协同、历史数据关联和真实用户习惯方面的个人助理能力。整体实现流程首先通过详细的人物设定文档，利用确定性脚本自动生成包含多个模拟真实网站、完整浏览器记录及文件系统数据的桌面镜像。接着，基于真实用户请求设计测试任务并编写对应的评分标准。最后，通过统一的工具接口驱动模型在该环境中执行任务，并根据任务完成度和跨应用数据一致性进行自动化评估。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于构建了一个以单一固定人物身份为核心的全桌面级可复现评测环境，并将十七个模拟真实应用的数据库与用户历史数据深度绑定。相比以往仅使用空白桌面或孤立应用状态的基准测试，本工作首次实现了跨应用的数据一致性与人物画像连贯性。评测任务要求智能体在登录状态下处理真实个人助理请求，从而有效检验了模型在复杂个人化场景中的实际能力。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了MYPCBENCH基准测试，通过为Linux桌面预置十七个真实网络应用及单一用户角色的完整个人数据，构建了包含一百八十四项真实请求任务的标准化评测环境，用于全面评估人工智能代理作为个人助手的跨应用协同与个性化服务能力。

Abstract

Current benchmarks for computer-use agents evaluate models in impersonal environments. This leaves a gap between evaluation and deployment where personal assistants are expected to work across a user's whole digital life, including their context, historical data, and logged-in accounts. This gap is widest on web tasks, where live web evaluations cannot exercise sites that require logging in or personal information, the kind of site a real personal assistant has to drive. We introduce MyPCBench, which tests computer-use agents as personal assistants on a Linux desktop populated with 17 simulated real-world web applications and a full desktop stack, all seeded for one canonical persona, Michael Scott from The Office. We define 184 tasks in this environment, each inspired by a real request drawn from the OpenClaw community, and benchmark six closed and open-weight models with a uniform computer+bash tool surface. We find that the best model, Claude Opus 4.6, fully solves 55.4\% of the tasks, the only model above 50\%. Model failures cluster on tasks that span many applications and on long trajectories, where personalization stresses an assistant the most. We release the environment, task set, and agent harness at this https URL .

item.title: No Resource, No Benchmarks, No Problem? Evaluating and Improving LLMs for Code Generation in No-Resource Languages
item.author: Giagnorio, Alessandro, Martin-Lopez, Alberto, Bavota, Gabriele
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: ...

背景: ...

目的: ...

方法: ...

主要发现: ...

结论: ...

翻译: ...

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决大型语言模型在缺乏训练数据的无资源编程语言上代码生成能力严重不足的问题。该问题在现实中非常重要，因为许多企业会开发私有或领域特定的编程语言，而主流商业人工智能工具并不支持这些语言，迫使企业必须自行研发成本可控的代码生成助手。在研究层面，目前缺乏针对此类语言的评估基准和有效的模型优化方法，限制了人工智能辅助编程技术的实际应用范围。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者发现直接对已具备指令遵循能力的模型进行进一步预训练会损害其核心功能，因此决定从基础模型开始，先在目标语言上进行预训练以掌握语言知识。随后，通过计算指令模型与原始基础模型之间的权重差异，并将该差异叠加到预训练模型上，从而成功注入指令遵循能力。这一方法的设计借鉴了自然语言处理领域近期关于同架构模型权重迁移的现有研究，旨在避免高昂的指令微调计算成本，以较低代价实现针对新语言的专用模型部署。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是通过权重差异迁移技术，将针对目标语言的进一步预训练与指令遵循能力相结合，从而避免全量指令微调的高昂计算成本。整体实现流程为：首先选取同架构的基础模型与指令模型，利用少量目标语言数据对基础模型进行进一步预训练；接着计算指令模型与原始基础模型之间的权重差值；最后将该差值直接叠加到预训练后的基础模型权重上，最终获得既掌握新语言又具备指令遵循能力的专用模型。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新点在于首次针对训练数据几乎为零的无资源编程语言构建了代码生成基准测试集，并系统评估了大型语言模型在该场景下的表现。相比以往主要关注高资源或低资源语言的研究，本文填补了无资源语言代码生成领域的空白。此外，论文提出了一种低成本模型适配方法，即先在基础模型上进行目标语言预训练，再通过权重差异迁移注入指令遵循能力，从而避免了全量指令微调的高计算成本。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文构建了面向无资源编程语言的代码生成基准，实证揭示了大语言模型在不同资源语言上的性能差距，并探索了低成本技术以帮助企业高效部署专属的代码生成助手。

Abstract

Large Language Models (LLMs) have significantly advanced the automation of software engineering tasks. One prominent example is code generation, where an LLM produces code in a specified programming language based on a natural language description. Most research in this area has focused on high-resource languages, such as Python or Java, which benefit from abundant training data. A smaller body of work has explored low-resource languages, which are underrepresented in training corpora. In contrast, no-resource languages for which LLMs have seen virtually no training data remain largely unstudied. These languages often emerge in industry, where organizations develop proprietary or domain-specific languages unsupported by commercial tools like GitHub Copilot. This results in the need for companies to deploy their own in-house code recommenders. To investigate possible solutions in this context, we build and release three code generation benchmarks for no-resource languages, based on two recently proposed programming languages for which very little training data is available. Using these benchmarks, we experiment several solutions to teach LLMs about no-resource languages, including prompt-based techniques as well as pre-training and fine-tuning exploiting the little data available. While further pre-training gives the largest performance gains for no-resource languages, applying it directly to instruction-tuned models harms their ability to follow instructions. To address this, we start from a base model, further pre-training it on the target language, and then inject instruction-following capabilities via weight diff transfer from an instruction model. Such an approach significantly improves code generation capabilities in no-resource settings, allowing companies to cheaply deploy a specialized instruct model without dealing with the computational cost of instruction fine-tuning.

item.title: LegalHalluLens: Typed Hallucination Auditing and Calibrated Multi-Agent Debate for Trustworthy Legal AI
item.author: Yadav, Lalit, Gurugubelli, Akshaj
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: ...

背景: ...

目的: ...

方法: ...

主要发现: ...

结论: ...

翻译: ...

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决法律人工智能在合同审查等场景中幻觉率高，且现有笼统的平均错误率无法揭示具体错误类型与偏差方向的问题。该问题在现实和研究中至关重要，因为法律决策容错率极低，平均指标会掩盖真正具有法律风险的关键条款错误。只有精准定位模型在数值、时间、义务或事实陈述上的具体失误及其遗漏或虚构倾向，才能有效指导合规审查、模型采购与纠错机制设计，从而实现真正可信的法律人工智能部署。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者发现传统汇总指标掩盖了法律模型错误的具体分布与方向，而遗漏与虚构错误的法律后果不对称，因此设计了按主张类型划分的幻觉画像、风险方向指数以及针对性校准的多智能体辩论机制。该方法明确借鉴了现有法律幻觉分类研究与多智能体辩论技术，但指出前人工作多采用通用调优且缺乏方向性量化指标，因此作者将实测的故障特征作为校准输入，使辩论组件能精准针对模型的实际薄弱环节进行干预。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是通过精准诊断法律人工智能在合同条款上的具体错误类型与偏差方向，并据此定制多智能体辩论机制，从而针对性地纠正模型幻觉。整体实现流程首先对法律文本进行逐类分析，生成详细的错误画像与风险方向指标；随后将这些诊断结果输入到一个包含质疑、辩护、重新提取、仲裁、验证和判决六个角色的辩论管道中；最后，系统依据预设的针对性挑战与不对称审查规则进行多轮交锋，最终输出经过校准的高可靠性条款提取结果。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于提出了按法律主张类型划分的幻觉画像、风险方向指数以及校准型多智能体辩论机制。与以往工作不同，它不再仅依赖整体幻觉率，而是将错误细分为数值、时间、义务与事实四类，并量化模型是倾向于遗漏还是虚构信息。此外，其辩论机制中的质疑角色和审查规则并非通用设置，而是直接根据前述诊断出的具体错误类型与方向进行定制，从而能用较小模型达到商业级效果。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一种法律AI审计框架，通过构建分类幻觉画像与风险方向指数精准诊断模型错误模式，并据此校准多智能体辩论机制，从而以极低成本显著降低法律文本提取中的幻觉与伪造率。

Abstract

AI systems deployed in legal workflows hallucinate at rates that aggregate metrics report at ~52%, but this average conceals where errors concentrate and in which direction they run, leaving compliance officers without an actionable signal for trustworthy deployment. We present LegalHalluLens, an auditing framework with three components: typed hallucination profiles across four legally-motivated claim categories (numeric, temporal, obligation/entitlement, factual) over CUAD (Hendrycks et al., 2021); a Risk Direction Index (RDI) that reduces omission-versus-invention bias to a single deployment-comparable scalar; and a typed debate pipeline calibrated to both magnitudes and directions. Across 510 contracts and 249,252 clause-level instances we measure a within-model gap of approximately 38-40 pp between obligation/numeric and temporal claims that aggregate reporting hides, and show that two systems with matched 52% rates can carry opposite RDIs. The debate pipeline reduces fabricated detections by 45% with per-category gains tracking the diagnosis, matching commercial APIs with a substantially smaller backbone (4B active parameters). Typed profiles and RDI surface failure modes that aggregate metrics hide; we further show these diagnostics serve as calibration inputs for multi-agent debate pipelines, where Skeptic challenges and asymmetric gates targeted at measured failure modes outperform generically-tuned debate. The framework supports direction-aware procurement, accountability, and agent design for legal AI deployed in the wild.

item.title: RankGraph-2: Lifecycle Co-Design for Billion-Node Graph Learning in Recommendation
item.author: Renzhi Wu, Zikun Cui, Junjie Yang, Tai Guo, Hong Li, Xian Chen, Li Yu, Ke Pan, Sri Reddy, Mahesh Srinivasan, Nipun Mathur, Haomin Yu, Hong Yan
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出RankGraph-2框架，通过协同设计图构建、表示学习和实时服务三个生命周期阶段，解决了十亿级节点规模下基于图的检索问题。

背景: 十亿级节点规模的基于图的检索需要协同解决图构建、表示学习和实时服务三个紧密耦合的问题，但现有工作通常孤立地处理每个问题。

目的: 为基于相似性的检索任务协同设计所有生命周期阶段，使各阶段的需求相互塑造，从而优化整体检索流程。

方法: 采用带流行度偏差校正的子采样技术大幅减少边数，通过个性化网页排名预计算多跳邻居以消除在线图基础设施需求，并协同学习残差量化聚类索引以避免昂贵的在线K近邻搜索，同时支持小时级刷新以覆盖物品。

主要发现: 该框架将服务计算成本降低了百分之八十三，在双部图上的召回率比图注意力网络结合深度图信息最大化模型高出三点八倍，在物品检索上比PyTorch-BigGraph高出二点一倍，点击率最高提升百分之零点九六，转化率最高提升百分之二点七五。

结论: 这种生命周期协同设计使得简单架构取得显著性能提升，并已在Meta的二十多个主要检索场景中成功部署应用。

翻译: 十亿级节点规模的基于图的检索需要协同解决图构建、表示学习和实时服务三个紧密耦合的问题，而现有工作通常孤立地处理每个问题。我们提出了部署于Meta的RankGraph-2框架，该框架为基于相似性的检索协同设计了所有生命周期阶段，各阶段的需求相互塑造。服务阶段需要协同学习的聚类索引以避免昂贵的在线K近邻搜索，这促使将索引协同训练纳入训练目标。训练阶段受益于基于相似性的检索容忍预计算邻居的观察结果，从而消除了在线图基础设施需求，这要求构建阶段生成自包含的数据。构建阶段还必须支持小时级刷新以覆盖物品。基于这些级联需求，RankGraph-2通过带流行度偏差校正的子采样将数千万亿条边减少至数千亿条，通过个性化网页排名预计算多跳邻居，并协同学习残差量化聚类索引，将服务计算成本降低了百分之八十三。这种生命周期协同设计使得简单架构在双部图上比图注意力网络结合深度图信息最大化模型实现三点八倍的召回率提升，在物品检索上比PyTorch-BigGraph实现二点一倍提升。RankGraph-2带来了最高百分之零点九六的点击率提升和百分之二点七五的转化率提升，并已在Meta的二十多个主要检索场景中成功部署。

Abstract

Graph-based retrieval at billion-node scale requires jointly solving three tightly coupled problems -- graph construction, representation learning, and real-time serving -- yet existing work addresses each in isolation. We present RankGraph-2, a framework deployed at Meta that co-designs all three lifecycle stages for similarity-based retrieval (U2U2I and U2I2I), where each stage's requirements shape the others. Serving requires a co-learned cluster index to avoid expensive online KNN -- this pushes index co-training into the training objective. Training benefits from the observation that similarity-based retrieval tolerates pre-computed neighborhoods, eliminating online graph infrastructure -- this requires construction to produce self-contained data. Construction must also support hour-level refresh for item coverage. Acting on these cascading requirements, RankGraph-2 reduces hundreds of trillions of edges to hundreds of billions via subsampling with popularity bias correction, pre-computes multi-hop neighborhoods via personalized PageRank, and co-learns a residual-quantization cluster index that reduces serving computational cost by 83%. This lifecycle co-design enables a simple architecture to achieve 3.8 x higher recall than a GAT + Deep Graph Infomax model on a bipartite graph and 2.1 x higher than PyTorch-BigGraph on item retrieval. RankGraph-2 delivers up to +0.96% CTR and +2.75% CVR, and has powered 20+ retrieval launches across major surfaces.

Abstract

As large language models (LLMs) become embedded in quantum simulation workflows (IDE copilots, notebook assistants, agentic pipelines), evaluation must move beyond functional correctness to anticipate and catch structured failures before they propagate through expensive pipelines. We present a layered evaluation framework for materials-informed Variational Quantum Eigensolver (VQE) circuit generation: (i) a gatekeeper screening rubric across seven physical and framework criteria; (ii) a circuit fidelity analysis comparing model outputs against analytical and reference-implementation values for H2/STO-3G/Jordan-Wigner/UCCSD, with ansatz classification and gate-composition breakdown; and (iii) design entropy, a run-to-run behavioral consistency metric. We surface a taxonomy of five distinct LLM failure modes (geometry hallucination, nonexistent API usage, runtime integration failures, constraint violations, and plausible-but-unverifiable output), each with distinct detectability profiles and structural to the task rather than to any one model. A forensic audit of the evaluation platform's own source code further establishes that two apparent model failures originated in the harness through silent fallback-template substitution, demonstrating that evaluation infrastructure belongs inside the same trust boundary as the models it tests. Applied across multiple foundation models on a Materials Project integrated pipeline, the framework shows that gatekeeper-style validation is necessary, not optional, for reliable deployment.

item.author: Yuyang Zhao, Lian Xu, Hao Miao, Chenxi Liu, Hao Xue

GPT 基础摘要

总结: ...

主要发现: ...

结论: ...

翻译: ...

Abstract

Time series forecasting (TSF) underpins consequential decisions in energy, transportation, finance, and healthcare, yet TSF models are almost universally ranked by a single number (e.g., average error) on clean held-out data, under the implicit assumption that it predicts deployed reliability. However, real faults are not i.i.d noise but structured events with temporal shape, broken cross-variable dependencies, regime change coupled with missingness, and causal propagation across a sensing pipeline. Treating TSF robustness as a data-quality problem, we present TS-Fault, a benchmark that evaluates forecasting models under explicit, parameterized fault scenarios with controllable semantic difficulty. TS-Fault organizes recurring failures into four modes along two orthogonal axes (observation- vs mechanism-level; univariate vs multivariate) and injects each fault into the most prediction-critical window via a unified importance score. This design enables robustness to be tested against the structures models actually rely on, rather than reduced to generic noise sensitivity. We evaluate 21 models across 6 datasets, 4 modes, and 5 difficulty levels under a paired clean/corrupt protocol. The results reveal three findings that contradict common leaderboard intuition: (i) clean-data accuracy anti-correlates with robustness; (ii) clean rankings are preserved under observation-level faults but reshuffled under mechanism-level faults; and (iii) all catastrophic failures occur under mechanism-level faults, with foundation models achieving the highest clean-data accuracy yet exhibiting the greatest fragility. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/Ray-zyy/TS-Fault.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要想解决如何评估智能体在长期、动态且充满不确定性的环境中进行持续决策与适应的能力。现有评测多局限于短期孤立任务，无法检验真实世界所需的长期规划、噪声信息处理与多任务协同能力。该问题在研究中至关重要，因为智能体若要在现实场景中真正发挥作用，必须具备跨越长时间跨度的战略控制与动态调整能力，而当前缺乏能准确衡量这一核心智能的评测标准。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者基于现实商业决策需要长期规划、噪声信息处理、动态适应和多任务协同的特点，设计了该创业模拟评估方法。他们指出已有基准测试多局限于短期任务或稳定环境，因此构建了一个为期五百天的公司运营环境，要求智能体通过编程接口自主查询数据、制定策略并协调各项业务。在设计过程中，作者借鉴了早期长程基准，同时针对其依赖大模型裁判等缺陷进行了改进，采用基于明确机制和随机变量的严谨规则来确保评估的客观性。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是构建一个为期五百天的虚拟初创企业运行环境，以全面评估人工智能智能体在长期战略规划、噪声信息处理、动态环境适应及多业务协同方面的综合能力。整体实现流程为智能体以企业负责人身份，通过编程接口每周调用数据库查询、定价、营销、研发、企业销售等数十种工具，编写代码分析业务数据并制定经营策略。模拟环境会持续生成客户偏好变化、竞争对手动作及宏观经济波动，智能体需根据延迟且带有噪声的间接反馈不断调整决策，直至模拟结束或资金耗尽。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于构建了一个模拟运营初创公司五百天的复杂商业环境，用于综合评估智能体在长期规划、噪声信息处理、动态适应及多任务协同方面的能力。与以往侧重短期孤立任务或静态环境的评测基准不同，该工作引入了部分可观测性、延迟反馈和持续演变的机制。智能体必须通过编程和数据分析自主制定连贯策略，而非依赖一次性任务或预设规则，从而更真实地检验了智能体在现实长程挑战中的综合智能水平。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了CEO-BENCH基准测试，通过构建一个为期500天的拟真初创企业运营模拟环境，系统评估了语言模型智能体在长期规划、噪声信息处理、动态适应及多任务协同方面的综合能力，并揭示了当前主流模型在持续战略控制上仍存在显著不足。

Abstract

Language model agents are becoming proficient executors at isolated, short-horizon tasks such as software engineering and customer service. Yet real-world challenges require a combination of sophisticated skills that remain largely untested in agents: (1) navigating long horizons amid uncertainty; (2) acquiring information in noisy environments; (3) adapting to a changing world; (4) orchestrating multiple moving parts toward a coherent goal. We introduce CEO-Bench, which evaluates these capabilities together by simulating a representative real-world task: operating a startup for 500 days. An agent manages pricing, marketing, budgeting, and many other aspects of a fictional company through a programmable Python interface, operating in the same environment and facing the same challenges as a human CEO. Success demands analyzing noisy, interconnected business databases, translating signals into sound strategy, and coordinating many decisions with programming. The strongest agents write sophisticated code that simulates customer cohorts to forecast future cash and mines negotiation history to uncover hidden customer preferences. Even so, most state-of-the-art models struggle in this environment. Only Claude Opus 4.8 and GPT-5.5 finish above the $1M starting balance, and neither consistently turns a profit. CEO-Bench takes a first step toward measuring the intelligence required to drive sustained, adaptive progress over time.

item.title: Experimental Analysis of Neural Network-Based Image Classification on the CIFAR-10 Dataset
item.author: Necati Kagan Erkek, Emre Balci, Berkin Halay
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文基于CIFAR十基准对神经图像分类进行了实验研究，完整展示了从数据预处理到模型评估的学习流程，并揭示了表征学习与记忆的差异，为后续研究提供了实验基线。

背景: CIFAR十图像分类基准上的神经网络图像分类任务。

目的: 完整分析图像分类的端到端学习流程，并为正则化、数据增强、更深网络结构及可复现图像分类教育研究提供紧凑的实验基线。

方法: 采用包含六个卷积层和三个最大池化阶段的卷积网络，结合图像向量化、归一化、独热编码、监督损失最小化、学习率选择、小批量训练及最大池化等技术，使用亚当优化器进行训练与验证评估。

主要发现: 验证准确率达到约百分之七十四点七七，训练至中期时验证损失开始上升而训练损失持续下降，体现了模型在表征学习与记忆之间的行为差异。

结论: 该实验清晰展示了表征学习与记忆的实际区别，并为未来在正则化、数据增强、网络深度扩展及图像分类教学方面的研究奠定了可复现的实验基础。

翻译: 本文通过全连接和卷积网络对CIFAR-10基准上的神经图像分类进行了实验研究。分析强调了完整的学习流程：图像向量化、归一化、独热类别编码、监督损失最小化、学习率选择、小批量训练、卷积特征提取、最大池化以及基于验证的泛化评估。使用批次大小为128、学习率为0.001的亚当优化器，对包含六个卷积层和三个最大池化阶段的卷积架构进行了十个训练轮次的评估。验证准确率达到约74.77%，而尽管训练损失持续下降，验证损失在训练中期开始增加。所得行为说明了表征学习与记忆之间的实际差异，并为未来关于正则化、数据增强、更深架构和可复现图像分类教育的研究提供了紧凑的实验基线。

Abstract

An experimental investigation of neural image classification on the CIFAR-10 benchmark is presented through fully connected and convolutional network formulations. The analysis emphasizes the complete learning pipeline: image vectorization, normalization, one-hot class encoding, supervised loss minimization, learning-rate selection, mini-batch training, convolutional feature extraction, max-pooling, and validation-based generalization assessment. A convolutional architecture with six convolutional layers and three max-pooling stages is evaluated for ten training epochs using a batch size of 128 and an Adam optimizer with a learning rate of 0.001. The validation accuracy reaches approximately 74.77%, while the validation loss begins to increase after the middle of training despite continued reduction in training loss. The resulting behavior illustrates the practical difference between representation learning and memorization, and it provides a compact experimental baseline for future studies on regularization, data augmentation, deeper architectures, and reproducible image-classification education.

item.title: Adaptive COVID-19 Trajectory Forecasting Using MAB-Inspired Ensemble Weighting
item.author: Hamed Karami, Javier Redondo Anton, Geunsoo Jang, K. Selcuk Candan, Gerardo Chowell

总结: ...
