The source code and datasets generated during the current study are available in the github repository, this https URL .

item.title: A Benchmark and Framework for Evaluating Next Action Predictions in Spreadsheets
item.author: Agrawal, Tejas, Le, Vu, Gulwani, Sumit, Verbruggen, Gust
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出一个电子表格预测代码补全的基准测试，解决公共数据集中编辑历史缺失和动作空间复杂的问题，通过手动构建动作序列和在线评估方法，分析多种预测模型的性能及影响因素。

背景: 预测代码补全能加速开发者工作，但在电子表格中此类自动补全功能几乎不存在。

目的: 解决公共电子表格语料库中编辑历史缺失的问题，并应对电子表格动作空间（空间、时间、复合）的复杂性，为预测系统提供基准。

方法: 手动构建52个包含一万两千个动作的序列，通过参数化启发式方法和大语言模型优化生成；提出在线评估方法，在每次用户动作后预测并接受或拒绝预测，更新未来动作直至目标电子表格完成；使用多种基线预测器（包括零样本大语言模型、微调小语言模型和经典模型）进行分析。

主要发现: 基准测试揭示了保存动作和假阳性的特性、效率、用户画像的影响、触发器的影响以及上下文的影响等属性。

结论: 该基准测试为电子表格预测代码补全提供了评估框架，揭示了多种影响因素，有助于改进预测系统。

翻译: Predictive code completion greatly accelerates how quickly developers work. In spreadsheets, despite being much more common, such auto-completion features are virtually non-existent. To address this gap, we introduce a benchmark for systems that observe a sequence of user actions in a spreadsheet and predict future actions. Two challenges are (1) the absence of edit histories in public spreadsheet corpora and (2) the complex space of spreadsheet actions (spatial, temporal, composite). To address (1), we manually curate 52 sequences of 12K actions that recreate spreadsheets from public corpora, seeded by parametrized heuristics and LLM refinement. To address (2), we propose an online evaluation that expects a prediction after each user action, accepts or rejects that prediction, updates the future actions upon acceptance, and repeats this until the target spreadsheet is obtained. We use multiple baseline predictors (including zero-shot LLMs, fine-tuned SLMs, and classical models) and analyze different properties that our benchmark teaches us, including but not limited to: properties of saved actions and false positives, efficiency, effect of user profiles, effect of triggers, and effect of context.

Abstract

Predictive code completion greatly accelerates how quickly developers work. In spreadsheets, despite being much more common, such auto-completion features are virtually non-existent. To address this gap, we introduce a benchmark for systems that observe a sequence of user actions in a spreadsheet and predict future actions. Two challenges are (1) the absence of edit histories in public spreadsheet corpora and (2) the complex space of spreadsheet actions (spatial, temporal, composite). To address (1), we manually curate 52 sequences of 12K actions that recreate spreadsheets from public corpora, seeded by parametrized heuristics and LLM refinement. To address (2), we propose an online evaluation that expects a prediction after each user action, accepts or rejects that prediction, updates the future actions upon acceptance, and repeats this until the target spreadsheet is obtained. We use multiple baseline predictors (including zero-shot LLMs, fine-tuned SLMs, and classical models) and analyze different properties that our benchmark teaches us, including but not limited to: properties of saved actions and false positives, efficiency, effect of user profiles, effect of triggers, and effect of context.

item.title: IndustryBench-MIPU: Benchmarking Multi-Image Attribute Value Extraction for Industrial Products
item.author: Qi, Haonan, Cao, Jin, Zhang, Yongqi, Wang, Xintong, Tang, Weidong, Chen, Bin, Huo, Chengfu, Pan, Haojun, You, Hengyu, Li, Jing, Wang, Yingde, Ding, Liang
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了IndustryBench-MIPU，这是首个针对多图像工业产品理解的大规模基准测试，专注于从产品图像中恢复结构化属性。

背景: 工业产品如阀门和断路器具有密集的技术规范，这些规范分散在多种异构产品图像中，包括规格表、铭牌和技术图纸。多模态大语言模型能否可靠地恢复这些规范尚待探索。

目的: 填补多模态大语言模型在工业产品理解方面的研究空白，通过结构化属性提取任务来评估模型能力。

方法: 构建包含4559个产品、27652张图像和103703个标注的基准测试，涵盖18个工业类别，通过多模型共识和三级质量保证进行构建。评估了九种多模态大语言模型在单图像和产品级多图像设置下的表现。

主要发现: 模型在单图像设置下实现高精确度（86%至94%），但在产品级属性恢复方面，最佳模型仅恢复49.9%的属性。从单图像到多图像提取导致召回率下降15至34个百分点。多图像完整性而非单图像准确性是核心瓶颈。

结论: 多图像完整性是当前多模态大语言模型在工业产品理解中的主要挑战，数据集和代码已公开。

翻译: Industrial products such as valves and circuit breakers are defined by dense technical specifications that govern procurement, compatibility, and safety across supply chains. These specifications are scattered across multiple heterogeneous product images, including specification tables, nameplates, and technical drawings, yet whether Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) can reliably recover them remains underexplored. To fill this gap, we introduce IndustryBench-MIPU, the first large-scale benchmark for multi-image industrial product understanding, built around structured attribute extraction -- recovering property-value pairs from product images. This task jointly probes text recognition on specification tables and nameplates, visual reasoning over technical drawings, domain knowledge to decode industrial terminology, and cross-image evidence integration to assemble scattered specifications. Concretely, the benchmark comprises 4,559 products across 27,652 images with 103,703 annotations spanning 18 industrial categories, constructed through multi-model consensus and three-tier quality assurance. Evaluating nine MLLMs under both single-image and product-level multi-image settings reveals a stark completeness gap: models achieve high precision (86--94%) but the best recovers only 49.9% of product-level attributes; moving from single-image to multi-image extraction costs 15--34 percentage points of recall. Multi-image completeness, not single-image accuracy, is the core bottleneck. Dataset and code are publicly available.

Abstract

Industrial products such as valves and circuit breakers are defined by dense technical specifications that govern procurement, compatibility, and safety across supply chains. These specifications are scattered across multiple heterogeneous product images, including specification tables, nameplates, and technical drawings, yet whether Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) can reliably recover them remains underexplored. To fill this gap, we introduce IndustryBench-MIPU, the first large-scale benchmark for multi-image industrial product understanding, built around structured attribute extraction -- recovering property-value pairs from product images. This task jointly probes text recognition on specification tables and nameplates, visual reasoning over technical drawings, domain knowledge to decode industrial terminology, and cross-image evidence integration to assemble scattered specifications. Concretely, the benchmark comprises 4,559 products across 27,652 images with 103,703 annotations spanning 18 industrial categories, constructed through multi-model consensus and three-tier quality assurance. Evaluating nine MLLMs under both single-image and product-level multi-image settings reveals a stark completeness gap: models achieve high precision (86--94%) but the best recovers only 49.9% of product-level attributes; moving from single-image to multi-image extraction costs 15--34 percentage points of recall. Multi-image completeness, not single-image accuracy, is the core bottleneck. Dataset and code are publicly available.

item.title: SciOrch: Learning to Orchestrate Expert LLMs for Solving Frontier Multimodal Scientific Reasoning Tasks
item.author: Guo, Jingru, Xue, Xiangyuan, Zhang, Lian, Xu, Wanghan, Chen, Siki, Torr, Philip, Ouyang, Wanli, Bai, Lei, Yin, Zhenfei
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为 SciOrch 的框架，用于训练一个轻量级模型来协调前沿大型语言模型进行科学推理。该框架通过分解问题、委托子问题给不同模型并综合答案，解决了单一模型在科学推理任务上的不足。

背景: 前沿科学推理对大型语言模型仍是一个重大挑战，即使是最强的商业系统也未能达到专家级水平。不同模型在不同类型的问题上各有优势，单一模型无法全面覆盖。

目的: 开发一个能够协调多个前沿大型语言模型进行科学推理的框架，以提高整体性能并降低对单一模型的依赖。

方法: 提出 SciOrch 框架，训练一个 8B 参数的轻量级模型作为协调器。该协调器通过分解问题、调用 API 将子问题委托给选定的商业模型，并综合最终答案。采用基于蒙特卡洛树搜索的方法生成多样化的协调轨迹，提取单轮样本，并使用类似 GRPO 的训练方法进行优化。

主要发现: 在包含 240 个问题的测试集上，SciOrch 的平均准确率达到 56.66%，比最强的单一商业模型高出 3.74%，比最强的多智能体基线高出 3.33%。同时，在 SGI 和 SFE 测试集上均取得了最佳准确率，且 API 成本不到典型多智能体方法的一半。

结论: SciOrch 框架通过协调多个前沿大型语言模型，显著提升了科学推理任务的性能，同时降低了计算成本，证明了多模型协作在复杂推理任务中的有效性。

翻译: Frontier scientific reasoning remains a major challenge for large language models (LLMs), where even the strongest commercial systems fall short of expert-level performance. A closer look at model behavior reveals substantial complementarity that single-model evaluation hides: different frontier models excel on different question types, and no single model captures the full picture. We present SciOrch, a framework that trains a lightweight 8B model to orchestrate frontier LLMs for scientific reasoning. The orchestrator decomposes each question, delegates sub-problems to selected commercial models through API calls, and synthesizes a final answer. Training such an orchestrator is fundamentally harder than conventional agentic RL: each action triggers an API call that is expensive in both dollar cost and latency, making standard online rollouts infeasible. We address this with MCTS-based approach, producing diverse orchestration trajectories, extracting per-node single-turn samples, and optimizing the orchestrator with GRPO-style training. On a 240-question test set spanning SGI-Reasoning and Scientists' First Exam, SciOrch reaches 56.66% average accuracy, outperforming the strongest single commercial model by 3.74% and the strongest multi-agent baseline by 3.33%. It also attains the best accuracy on both SGI and SFE with less than half the API cost of typical multi-agent methods.

Abstract

Frontier scientific reasoning remains a major challenge for large language models (LLMs), where even the strongest commercial systems fall short of expert-level performance. A closer look at model behavior reveals substantial complementarity that single-model evaluation hides: different frontier models excel on different question types, and no single model captures the full picture. We present SciOrch, a framework that trains a lightweight 8B model to orchestrate frontier LLMs for scientific reasoning. The orchestrator decomposes each question, delegates sub-problems to selected commercial models through API calls, and synthesizes a final answer. Training such an orchestrator is fundamentally harder than conventional agentic RL: each action triggers an API call that is expensive in both dollar cost and latency, making standard online rollouts infeasible. We address this with MCTS-based approach, producing diverse orchestration trajectories, extracting per-node single-turn samples, and optimizing the orchestrator with GRPO-style training. On a 240-question test set spanning SGI-Reasoning and Scientists' First Exam, SciOrch reaches 56.66% average accuracy, outperforming the strongest single commercial model by 3.74% and the strongest multi-agent baseline by 3.33%. It also attains the best accuracy on both SGI and SFE with less than half the API cost of typical multi-agent methods.

item.title: Kairos: A Native World Model Stack for Physical AI
item.author: Kairos Team, Wang, Fei, You, Shan, Zhang, Qiming, Huang, Tao, Fu, Zuoyi, Zheng, Zhisheng, Xi, Yunlong, Lv, Feng, Wu, Xiaoming, Liu, Zeyu, Wan, Cong, Li, Pu, Yang, Ruiqing, Li, Xiaoou, Wang, Wei, Zhu, Kangkang, Zhang, Yuwei, Fu, Shi, Zhang, Zheng, Wu, Xiaoning, Fan, Xuzeng, Tao, Dacheng, Wang, Xiaogang
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: Kairos是一个原生世界模型栈，旨在成为物理人工智能的基础操作基础设施。

背景: 世界模型正从被动视觉生成器转变为物理人工智能的基础操作基础设施，需要原生获取世界知识、维持长期状态并在实际部署约束下高效执行。

目的: 设计Kairos，以满足世界模型在知识获取、状态维持和高效执行方面的需求。

方法: Kairos采用原生预训练范式，通过跨体现数据课程组织开放世界视频、人类行为数据和机器人交互数据；采用原生统一架构，结合混合线性时间注意力机制，实现世界理解、生成和预测的统一；并采用部署感知系统协同设计，支持低延迟 rollout 生成。

主要发现: Kairos在具身世界模型、长视界和行动策略基准测试中达到顶级性能，同时提供了强大的效率与能力权衡。

结论: Kairos为未来自我进化的物理智能提供了一个连贯的操作基础。

翻译: Kairos是一个原生世界模型栈，旨在成为物理人工智能的基础操作基础设施。世界模型正从被动视觉生成器转变为物理人工智能的基础操作基础设施，需要原生获取世界知识、维持长期状态并在实际部署约束下高效执行。Kairos采用原生预训练范式，通过跨体现数据课程组织开放世界视频、人类行为数据和机器人交互数据；采用原生统一架构，结合混合线性时间注意力机制，实现世界理解、生成和预测的统一；并采用部署感知系统协同设计，支持低延迟 rollout 生成。Kairos在具身世界模型、长视界和行动策略基准测试中达到顶级性能，同时提供了强大的效率与能力权衡。Kairos为未来自我进化的物理智能提供了一个连贯的操作基础。

Abstract

World models are transitioning from passive visual generators to foundational, operational infrastructure for Physical AI: they must natively acquire world knowledge from heterogeneous experience, maintain persistent states over long horizons, and execute efficiently within real deployment constraints. We introduce Kairos, a native world model stack designed around these requirements. (1) Kairos learns the world by pioneering a Native Pre-training Paradigm governed by a Cross-Embodiment Data Curriculum, which organizes open-world videos, human behavioral data, and robot interactions into a progressive developmental pathway. (2) Kairos maintains the world by unified world understanding, generation, and prediction within a Native Unified Architecture equipped with Hybrid Linear Temporal Attention, where sliding-window attention captures local dynamics, dilated sliding windows capture mid-range dependencies, and gated linear attention maintains persistent global memory. We establish formal theoretical bounds demonstrating that this temporal factorization strictly limits error accumulation, mathematically guaranteeing state propagation across extended horizons. (3) Kairos runs the world by incorporating a Deployment-Aware System Co-Design to support low-latency rollout generation on server and consumer-grade hardware for real-world observation-action-feedback loops. Experiments on embodied world-model, long-horizon, and action-policy benchmarks show that Kairos achieves top level performance while offering a strong efficiency-capability trade-off. Together, these results position Kairos as a cohesive operational foundation for future self-evolving physical intelligence.

item.title: MaineCoon: Pursuing A Real-Time Audio-Visual Social World Model
item.author: Bai, Lichen, Zhang, Tianhao, Shao, Shitong, Tan, Dingwei, Zhong, Qiyu, Xie, Zhengpeng, Li, Haopeng, Huang, Qinghao, Shen, Dandan, Ji, Tengjiao, Wang, Wei, Wu, Peicheng, Zhao, Yuxuan, Zhu, Xiangyu, Luo, Welly, Yang, Shurui, Xie, Zeke
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为MaineCoon的实时音频视觉自回归模型，旨在填补社会世界模型在人类中心社会动态模拟方面的空白。该模型拥有二百二十亿参数，支持实时流式生成和亚秒级交互，帧率高达每秒四十七点五帧，是首个针对社交互动应用优化的实时音频视觉生成模型。

背景: 全球越来越多的视频内容在社交平台上以互动社交目的被消费，但针对社交世界构建的视频生成模型在以往研究中大多被忽视。现有的世界模型成功模拟了物理环境或游戏世界探索，但与以人为中心的社会动态基本脱节。

目的: 定义社会世界模型的位置，并构建原型模型作为迈向这一目标的第一步，以弥合现有世界模型与人类中心社会动态之间的差距。

方法: 提出MaineCoon模型，引入自重采样、跨模态表示对齐、领域感知偏好优化和强化在线策略蒸馏等新技术以实现高效稳定训练。设计首个代理流式推理框架，支持数千秒或更长时间的生成，并通过代理缓存管理和提示规划缓解漂移。

主要发现: MaineCoon在单张GPU上实现了高达每秒四十七点五帧的帧率，支持实时流式生成和亚秒级交互。该模型是首个针对社交互动应用优化的实时音频视觉生成模型，显著加速了训练并优化了实时推理性能。

结论: 该工作不仅为高质量、低延迟和长视野的音频视觉自回归模型设立了新的性能基准，也为下一代AI原生社交平台的范式转变指明了方向。

翻译: As an increasing majority of global video content is consumed on social platforms for interactive social purposes, video generation models built for social worlds are important but largely overlooked by previous studies. In this work, we define the position of social world models and build a prototype model as the first step towards this goal. While previous world models successfully simulate physical environments or gaming world exploration, they remain fundamentally detached from human-centric social dynamics. To bridge this gap as the first step to social world models, we present MaineCoon, the first real-time audio-visual autoregressive model that has 22B parameters and is capable of real-time streaming generation and sub-second interaction, with a record-breaking frame rate of up to 47.5 FPS, on a single GPU. To the best of our knowledge, MaineCoon is also the first real-time audio-visual generation model specifically optimized for social-interactive applications. To enable efficient and stable training, we introduce several novel techniques into MaineCoon, including self-resampling, cross-modal representation alignment, domain-aware preference optimization, and reinforced online-policy distillation (ROPD). We also design the first agentic streaming inference framework that supports thousand-second-scale or even longer generation while mitigating drift with agentic cache management and prompt planing. These innovations significantly accelerate training while optimizing real-time inference performance. We believe this work not only sets a new state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance benchmark for high-quality, low-latency, and long-horizon audio-visual autoregressive models, but also points out the paradigm shift desired for next-generation AI-native social platforms.

Abstract

As an increasing majority of global video content is consumed on social platforms for interactive social purposes, video generation models built for social worlds are important but largely overlooked by previous studies. In this work, we define the position of social world models and build a prototype model as the first step towards this goal. While previous world models successfully simulate physical environments or gaming world exploration, they remain fundamentally detached from human-centric social dynamics. To bridge this gap as the first step to social world models, we present MaineCoon, the first real-time audio-visual autoregressive model that has 22B parameters and is capable of real-time streaming generation and sub-second interaction, with a record-breaking frame rate of up to 47.5 FPS, on a single GPU. To the best of our knowledge, MaineCoon is also the first real-time audio-visual generation model specifically optimized for social-interactive applications. To enable efficient and stable training, we introduce several novel techniques into MaineCoon, including self-resampling, cross-modal representation alignment, domain-aware preference optimization, and reinforced online-policy distillation (ROPD). We also design the first agentic streaming inference framework that supports thousand-second-scale or even longer generation while mitigating drift with agentic cache management and prompt planing. These innovations significantly accelerate training while optimizing real-time inference performance. We believe this work not only sets a new state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance benchmark for high-quality, low-latency, and long-horizon audio-visual autoregressive models, but also points out the paradigm shift desired for next-generation AI-native social platforms.

item.title: Trust the Right Teacher: Quality-Aware Self-Distillation for GUI Grounding
item.author: Huang, Jingyuan, Huang, Zuming, Shi, Yucheng, Yang, Tianze, Zhai, Xiaoming, Chu, Wei, Liu, Ninghao
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种质量感知自蒸馏方法，用于基于视觉语言模型的图形用户界面定位任务，通过软正确性感知门控和教师概率缩放机制提升坐标令牌教师信号的质量，在六个基准测试中均优于基线模型。

背景: 图形用户界面定位任务要求视觉语言模型在高分辨率截图中识别小目标元素并预测精确屏幕坐标。在线策略自蒸馏是一种有前景的后期训练方法，能提供超越硬坐标标签的密集令牌级教师信号。

目的: 解决朴素在线策略自蒸馏在图形用户界面定位任务中不适用的问题，即当学生生成的前缀偏离目标坐标时，教师信号质量会下降，导致不可靠的教师信号。

方法: 提出质量感知自蒸馏方法，包含两个核心机制：软正确性感知门控，用于检查教师的当前坐标令牌预测是否能在学生生成的前缀下完成为真实边界框，若不能则降低相应教师信号的权重；教师概率缩放，利用教师的置信度作为轻量级因子进一步校准门控监督的强度。

主要发现: 单独使用任一组件均无法提升整体性能，但结合使用两者能 consistently 提升性能。这表明两个机制发挥互补作用：正确性感知门控抑制不可靠的坐标令牌监督，而教师概率缩放校准剩余信号的强度。

结论: 在六个图形用户界面定位基准测试上的实验表明，该方法能 consistently 提升基础模型性能，并优于强基线模型。

翻译: Graphical user interface grounding requires vision-language models to identify small target elements in high-resolution screenshots and predict precise screen coordinates. On-policy self-distillation is a promising post-training approach for this coordinate-sensitive task, since it provides dense token-level teacher signals beyond hard coordinate labels. However, naive on-policy self-distillation is not well suited to graphical user interface grounding: on-policy self-distillation evaluates the teacher on student-generated prefixes, the quality of coordinate-token teacher signals can degrade when the prefix has already deviated from the target coordinate, leading to unreliable teacher signal. To mitigate this, we propose quality-aware self-distillation for vision-language model-based graphical user interface grounding, which improves coordinate-token teacher-signal quality through soft correctness-aware gating and teacher-probability scaling. The soft correctness-aware gate checks whether the teacher's current coordinate-token prediction can still be completed into the ground-truth box under the student-generated prefix. If not, the corresponding teacher signal is down-weighted. Teacher-probability scaling then uses the teacher's confidence as a lightweight factor to further calibrate the strength of the gated supervision. A key empirical finding is that neither component alone improves overall performance, whereas combining them consistently improves performance. This suggests that the two mechanisms play complementary roles: correctness-aware gating suppresses unreliable coordinate-token supervision, while teacher-probability scaling calibrates the strength of the remaining signals. Experiments across six graphical user interface grounding benchmarks show that our method consistently improves the base model and outperforms strong baselines.

Abstract

Graphical user interface (GUI) grounding requires vision-language models (VLMs) to identify small target elements in high-resolution screenshots and predict precise screen coordinates. On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) is a promising post-training approach for this coordinate-sensitive task, since it provides dense token-level teacher signals beyond hard coordinate labels. However, naive OPSD is not well suited to GUI grounding: OPSD evaluates the teacher on student-generated prefixes, the quality of coordinate-token teacher signals can degrade when the prefix has already deviated from the target coordinate, leading to unreliable teacher signal. To mitigate this, We propose quality-aware self-distillation for VLM-based GUI grounding, which improves coordinate-token teacher-signal quality through soft correctness-aware gating and teacher-probability scaling. The soft correctness-aware gate checks whether the teacher's current coordinate-token prediction can still be completed into the ground-truth box under the student-generated prefix. If not, the corresponding teacher signal is down-weighted. Teacher-probability scaling then uses the teacher's confidence as a lightweight factor to further calibrate the strength of the gated supervision. A key empirical finding is that neither component alone improves overall performance, whereas combining them consistently improves performance. This suggests that the two mechanisms play complementary roles: correctness-aware gating suppresses unreliable coordinate-token supervision, while teacher-probability scaling calibrates the strength of the remaining signals. Experiments across six GUI grounding benchmarks show that our method consistently improves the base model and outperforms strong baselines.

item.title: SAE Interventions are Unreliable: Post-Intervention Recovery of Suppressed Behavior
item.author: Cui, Mingyue, Shen, Linghui, Yang, Xingyi
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文揭示了基于稀疏自编码器的潜在空间防御中存在的可恢复失败模式，即钳制有害特征虽能阻断可见行为路径，但无法彻底消除行为本身。

背景: 稀疏自编码器将残差流激活分解为可解释特征，近期潜在空间防御依赖此分解，假设识别出的不安全特征可作为监控和干预的有效手段。

目的: 检验钳制特定有害特征是否真的能可靠防止模型不当行为，并探究是否存在可恢复的失败模式。

方法: 将漏洞形式化为后干预恢复问题，即从干预后的残差状态出发，优化残差扰动以恢复干预前的行为，同时保持目标稀疏自编码器特征值不变。采用编码器正交更新和特征映射雅可比矩阵进行单跨层和跨层干预，并在多个实验场景下进行压力测试。

主要发现: 即使在干预持续有效的强威胁模型下，行为仍可恢复。在拒绝引导设置中，有效样本恢复率达百分之九十五点八，且受防御特征相对漂移远低于基线。恢复路径归因分析表明恢复源于稀疏自编码器重构残差。

结论: 特征级控制与行为完整性之间存在差距，控制稀疏自编码器特征并不保证能完全控制底层行为。

翻译: Sparse Autoencoders decompose residual-stream activations into interpretable features. Recent latent-space defenses increasingly rely on these decompositions, assuming that identified unsafe SAE features serve as actionable handles for monitoring and intervention. In this paradigm, clamping a specific harmful feature is expected to reliably prevent model misbehavior. However, we show that this success may hide a recoverable failure mode: the clamp may block one visible route to a behavior without eliminating the behavior itself. We formulate this vulnerability as post-intervention recovery, a constrained residual-space optimization problem. Starting from the post-intervention residual state, we optimize residual perturbations to recover the pre-intervention behavior while preserving the post-intervention values of the targeted SAE features. Even under a strong threat model where the intervention remains active throughout optimization and generation, recovery remains possible. To rule out that recovery simply undoes the intervention, we use encoder-orthogonal updates for single-layer interventions and the corresponding feature-map Jacobian in the cross-layer setting. Across TPP, unlearning, IOI, and refusal steering experiments, this stress test reveals recoverable behavior despite successful feature-level intervention. Especially in the safety-critical refusal-steering setting, we achieve a 95.8% recovery rate on valid samples while keeping defended-feature relative drift to 0.131, substantially below suffix-based baselines. A recovery-path attribution analysis further localizes this recovery to the SAE reconstruction residual, the component left unexplained by the SAE. These results expose a gap between feature-level control and behavioral completeness: SAE features can support causal intervention, but controlling them does not guarantee control over the underlying behavior.

Abstract

Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) decompose residual-stream activations into interpretable features. Recent latent-space defenses increasingly rely on these decompositions, assuming that identified "unsafe" SAE features serve as actionable handles for monitoring and intervention. In this paradigm, clamping a specific harmful feature is expected to reliably prevent model misbehavior. However, we show that this success may hide a recoverable failure mode: the clamp may block one visible route to a behavior without eliminating the behavior itself. We formulate this vulnerability as post-intervention recovery, a constrained residual-space optimization problem. Starting from the post-intervention residual state, we optimize residual perturbations to recover the pre-intervention behavior while preserving the post-intervention values of the targeted SAE features. Even under a strong threat model where the intervention remains active throughout optimization and generation, recovery remains possible. To rule out that recovery simply undoes the intervention, we use encoder-orthogonal updates for single-layer interventions and the corresponding feature-map Jacobian in the cross-layer setting. Across TPP, unlearning, IOI, and refusal steering experiments, this stress test reveals recoverable behavior despite successful feature-level intervention. Especially in the safety-critical refusal-steering setting, we achieve a 95.8% recovery rate on valid samples while keeping defended-feature relative drift to 0.131, substantially below suffix-based baselines. A recovery-path attribution analysis further localizes this recovery to the SAE reconstruction residual, the component left unexplained by the SAE. These results expose a gap between feature-level control and behavioral completeness: SAE features can support causal intervention, but controlling them does not guarantee control over the underlying behavior.

item.title: DeFAb: A Verifiable Benchmark for Defeasible Abduction in Foundation Models
item.author: Patrick Cooper, Alvaro Velasquez
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了DeFAb基准测试，这是一个用于评估可废止溯因推理的数据集和生成管道。该基准测试将四个十年的公共资助知识库转化为形式化实例，要求构建解释异常并覆盖默认值的假设，同时保持无关期望。所有假设必须通过多项式时间检查以确保有效推导、保守性和最小性。DeFAb基准测试包含超过372,648个实例，分为三个难度级别，并提供了可验证的黄金标准。实验结果显示，基于规则的逻辑求解器在50微秒内以100%的准确率解决所有实例，而最先进的语言模型在渲染鲁棒评估中准确率仅为23.5%。此外，还发布了DeFAb-Hard和CONJURE变体，以及用于偏好优化的精确奖励验证器。

背景: 当前语言模型在可废止推理方面的表现不佳，尤其是在需要严格逻辑严谨性的任务中。现有的评估方法可能无法准确衡量模型的理论推理能力。

目的: 引入DeFAb基准测试，以形式化方式评估模型的可废止溯因推理能力，强调逻辑严谨性而非流畅但破坏理论的文本。

方法: 使用DeFAb生成管道，将公共资助的知识库转化为形式化实例。结合分类层次结构（如OpenCyc、YAGO、Wikidata）和行为属性图（如ConceptNet、UMLS），生成多个难度级别的实例。所有假设必须通过多项式时间检查以确保有效推导、保守性和最小性。

主要发现: 基于规则的逻辑求解器在50微秒内以100%的准确率解决所有实例。最先进的语言模型在渲染鲁棒评估中准确率仅为23.5%。链式思维变异性超过模型间差距。DeFAb-Hard变体中，最佳模型准确率为53.3%，而符号求解器为100%。CONJURE变体中，零新概念的发现。

结论: 当前前沿模型未能可靠地内化可废止推理。DeFAb基准测试为评估和测量创造力及理论推理提供了逻辑严谨性的工具。

翻译: A rule-based logic solver resolves every instance in our benchmark in under 50 microseconds with 100% accuracy; the best frontier language model reaches 65% at best and drops to 23.5% under rendering-robust evaluation (worst case over four surface renderings). We introduce DeFAb (Defeasible Abduction Benchmark), a dataset and generation pipeline that converts four decades of publicly funded knowledge bases into formally grounded instances for defeasible abduction: constructing hypotheses that explain anomalies by overriding defaults while preserving unrelated expectations. Because every hypothesis must pass polynomial-time checks for valid derivation, conservativity, and minimality, DeFAb makes logical rigor the instrument for measuring creativity and theoretical reasoning, scoring the disciplined construction of theory revisions rather than fluent but theory-destroying prose. The pipeline pairs taxonomic hierarchies (OpenCyc, YAGO, Wikidata) with behavioral property graphs (ConceptNet, UMLS) to produce 372,648+ instances across 33.75M materialized rules from 18 sources, in three levels with polynomial-time verifiable gold standards. Four frontier models do not reliably internalize defeasible reasoning: rendering-robust Level 2 accuracy is 7.8-23.5%; chain-of-thought variance (~36 pp) exceeds any inter-model gap; and a matched contamination control isolates a +19.4 pp Level 3 gap. We further release DeFAb-Hard (a 235-instance Level 3 difficulty variant; best model 53.3% vs 100% symbolic) and CONJURE (a kernel-verified transformative-creativity variant of 560 Lean 4/Mathlib instances whose gold answers are definitions the proof kernel did not previously contain, judge-free verifier; a pilot finds zero novel concepts). The same verifier doubles as an exact reward for preference optimization (DPO, RLVR/GRPO). Released under MIT at https://huggingface.co/datasets/PatrickAllenCooper/DeFAb.

Abstract

A rule-based logic solver resolves every instance in our benchmark in under 50 microseconds with 100% accuracy; the best frontier language model reaches 65% at best and drops to 23.5% under rendering-robust evaluation (worst case over four surface renderings). We introduce DeFAb (Defeasible Abduction Benchmark), a dataset and generation pipeline that converts four decades of publicly funded knowledge bases into formally grounded instances for defeasible abduction: constructing hypotheses that explain anomalies by overriding defaults while preserving unrelated expectations. Because every hypothesis must pass polynomial-time checks for valid derivation, conservativity, and minimality, DeFAb makes logical rigor the instrument for measuring creativity and theoretical reasoning, scoring the disciplined construction of theory revisions rather than fluent but theory-destroying prose. The pipeline pairs taxonomic hierarchies (OpenCyc, YAGO, Wikidata) with behavioral property graphs (ConceptNet, UMLS) to produce 372,648+ instances across 33.75M materialized rules from 18 sources, in three levels with polynomial-time verifiable gold standards. Four frontier models do not reliably internalize defeasible reasoning: rendering-robust Level 2 accuracy is 7.8-23.5%; chain-of-thought variance (~36 pp) exceeds any inter-model gap; and a matched contamination control isolates a +19.4 pp Level 3 gap. We further release DeFAb-Hard (a 235-instance Level 3 difficulty variant; best model 53.3% vs 100% symbolic) and CONJURE (a kernel-verified transformative-creativity variant of 560 Lean 4/Mathlib instances whose gold answers are definitions the proof kernel did not previously contain, judge-free verifier; a pilot finds zero novel concepts). The same verifier doubles as an exact reward for preference optimization (DPO, RLVR/GRPO). Released under MIT at https://huggingface.co/datasets/PatrickAllenCooper/DeFAb.

item.title: Bridging Data Gaps in Structural Fragility Modeling through Transfer Learning: Methodology and Case Studies
item.author: Narges Saeednejad, Jamie Ellen Padgett
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种以方法为中心的迁移学习框架，用于在域偏移、类别不平衡和目标标签稀缺的情况下进行易损性适应，同时保持工程可解释性并支持不确定性下的决策。

背景: 在易损性模型开发中，面临域偏移、类别不平衡和目标标签稀缺的挑战，直接迁移源模型在这些条件下表现不佳。

目的: 提出一种迁移学习框架，以改善低数据条件下的故障检测率和预测稳定性，同时保持工程可解释性和支持不确定性决策。

方法: 展示了四种迁移学习策略：基于实例的迁移学习（通过重要性加权）、基于参数的迁移学习、分层贝叶斯迁移学习和多源迁移学习。通过三个案例研究进行验证：沿海桥梁易损性（卡特里娜飓风观测）、住宅建筑易损性（伊恩飓风观测）和地震桥梁易损性（2001年尼斯夸利地震观测）。

主要发现: 在域偏移和严重类别不平衡的情况下，直接迁移源模型失败，而针对性适应显著提高了低数据条件下的故障检测率和预测稳定性。

结论: 在开发和适应易损性模型时，需要系统性的指导，包括诊断、策略选择和不确定性报告。

翻译: This paper presents a methodology-centered transfer learning framework for fragility adaptation under domain shift, class imbalance, and scarce target labels while preserving engineering interpretability and supporting decision-making under uncertainty. Four transfer learning strategies (instance-based, parameter-based, hierarchical Bayesian, and multi-source) are demonstrated through three complementary case studies: (i) instance-based transfer learning via importance weighting, demonstrated on coastal bridge fragility using Hurricane Katrina observations; (ii) parameter-based transfer learning together with hierarchical Bayesian transfer learning, enabling partial pooling across strata and posterior uncertainty quantification, demonstrated on residential building fragility using Hurricane Ian observations; and (iii) multi-source transfer learning that fuses multiple analytical fragility models with learned source weights and regularized target-domain adaptation, demonstrated on seismic bridge fragility using observations from the 2001 Nisqually earthquake. Across these case studies, direct transfer of source models (i.e. using existing state-of-the-art models) fails under domain shift and severe class imbalance, while targeted adaptation substantially improves failure detection and predictive stability in low-data regimes. These findings highlight the need for systematic guidance on diagnostics, strategy selection, and uncertainty reporting when developing and adapting fragility models.

Abstract

This paper presents a methodology-centered transfer learning framework for fragility adaptation under domain shift, class imbalance, and scarce target labels while preserving engineering interpretability and supporting decision-making under uncertainty. Four transfer learning strategies (instance-based, parameter-based, hierarchical Bayesian, and multi-source) are demonstrated through three complementary case studies: (i) instance-based transfer learning via importance weighting, demonstrated on coastal bridge fragility using Hurricane Katrina observations; (ii) parameter-based transfer learning together with hierarchical Bayesian transfer learning, enabling partial pooling across strata and posterior uncertainty quantification, demonstrated on residential building fragility using Hurricane Ian observations; and (iii) multi-source transfer learning that fuses multiple analytical fragility models with learned source weights and regularized target-domain adaptation, demonstrated on seismic bridge fragility using observations from the 2001 Nisqually earthquake. Across these case studies, direct transfer of source models (i.e. using existing state-of-the-art models) fails under domain shift and severe class imbalance, while targeted adaptation substantially improves failure detection and predictive stability in low-data regimes. These findings highlight the need for systematic guidance on diagnostics, strategy selection, and uncertainty reporting when developing and adapting fragility models.

item.title: Technical Report for ICRA 2026 GOOSE 2D Fine-Grained Semantic Segmentation Challenge: Leveraging DINOv3 for Robust Outdoor Scene Understanding in Field Robotics
item.author: Jaeil Park, Hyobin Choi, Sangjin Lee, Hyungtae Lim, Sung-Hoon Yoon
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了在ICRA 2026野外机器人研讨会GOOSE 2D细粒度语义分割挑战赛中获得第一名的解决方案。

背景: 该挑战赛评估非道路图像在包含64个类别和11个评估非空粗类别的细粒度分类体系下的密集语义分割。

目的: 提出一种解决方案以在该挑战赛中取得优异成绩。

方法: 解决方案包含两个互补的改进：一是网络级设计，结合自监督DINOv3 ViT-L/16主干网络、ViT-Adapter和Mask2Former掩码分类解码器，并在全局CLS标记上添加粗类别辅助损失；二是推理时的聚合策略，基于多尺度和水平翻转测试时增强以及使用Codabench分数选择的三个最佳检查点的集成。

主要发现: 该方法取得了76.57%的官方综合得分，其中细类别mIoU为69.32%，类别级别mIoU为83.81%，并在最终阶段排行榜上排名第一。

结论: 所提出的方法在GOOSE 2D细粒度语义分割挑战赛中表现优异，获得了第一名。

翻译: The GOOSE 2D Fine-Grained Semantic Segmentation Challenge at the ICRA 2026 Workshop on Field Robotics evaluates dense semantic segmentation of off-road imagery over a fine-grained taxonomy of 64 classes and 11 evaluated non-void coarse categories. We present the first-place solution to this challenge. Our solution comprises two complementary improvements: (a) a network-level design that combines a self-supervised DINOv3 ViT-L/16 backbone, a ViT-Adapter, and a Mask2Former mask-classification decoder, together with a coarse-category auxiliary loss on the global [CLS] token; and (b) an inference-time aggregation strategy based on multi-scale and horizontal-flip test-time augmentation and an ensemble of the top three checkpoints selected using Codabench scores. Our method achieves an official composite score of 76.57%, consisting of 69.32% fine-class mIoU and 83.81% category-level mIoU, and ranks first on the final phase leaderboard: www.codabench.org/competitions/14257/#/results-tab.

Abstract

The GOOSE 2D Fine-Grained Semantic Segmentation Challenge at the ICRA 2026 Workshop on Field Robotics evaluates dense semantic segmentation of off-road imagery over a fine-grained taxonomy of 64 classes and 11 evaluated non-void coarse categories. We present the first-place solution to this challenge. Our solution comprises two complementary improvements: (a) a network-level design that combines a self-supervised DINOv3 ViT-L/16 backbone, a ViT-Adapter, and a Mask2Former mask-classification decoder, together with a coarse-category auxiliary loss on the global [CLS] token; and (b) an inference-time aggregation strategy based on multi-scale and horizontal-flip test-time augmentation and an ensemble of the top three checkpoints selected using Codabench scores. Our method achieves an official composite score of 76.57%, consisting of 69.32% fine-class mIoU and 83.81% category-level mIoU, and ranks first on the final phase leaderboard: www.codabench.org/competitions/14257/#/results-tab.

item.title: Low-resource Language Discrimination Towards Chinese Dialects with Transfer learning and Data Augmentation
item.author: Fan Xu, Yangjie Dan, Keyu Yan, Yong Ma, Mingwen Wang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种结合迁移学习和数据增强的中文方言识别框架CDDTLDA，以解决标注资源稀缺的问题。

背景: 中文方言识别是一项具有挑战性的自然语言处理任务，主要由于标注资源稀缺。

目的: 克服资源短缺问题，开发一种新的中文方言识别框架。

方法: 首先使用较大的中文方言语料库训练源端自动语音识别模型；然后采用速度、音调和噪声干扰等简单有效的数据增强方法对目标端低资源中文方言进行增强，并基于源端模型微调目标端自动语音识别模型；同时利用自注意力机制捕捉源端和目标端自动语音识别模型之间的潜在共同语义特征；最后提取目标端自动语音识别模型中的隐藏语义表示进行中文方言识别。

主要发现: 在两个基准中文方言语料库上，该模型显著优于最先进的方法。

结论: 该模型在中文方言识别任务上具有显著优势。

翻译: Chinese dialects discrimination is a challenging natural language processing task due to scarce annotation resource. In this article, we develop a novel Chinese dialects discrimination framework with transfer learning and data augmentation (CDDTLDA) in order to overcome the shortage of resources. To be more specific, we first use a relatively larger Chinese dialects corpus to train a source-side automatic speech recognition (ASR) model. Then, we adopt a simple but effective data augmentation method (i.e., speed, pitch, and noise disturbance) to augment the target-side low-resource Chinese dialects, and fine-tune another target ASR model based on the previous source-side ASR model. Meanwhile, the potential common semantic features between source-side and target-side ASR models can be captured by using self-attention mechanism. Finally, we extract the hidden semantic representation in the target ASR model to conduct Chinese dialects discrimination. Our extensive experimental results demonstrate that our model significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods on two benchmark Chinese dialects corpora.

Abstract

Chinese dialects discrimination is a challenging natural language processing task due to scarce annotation resource. In this article, we develop a novel Chinese dialects discrimination framework with transfer learning and data augmentation (CDDTLDA) in order to overcome the shortage of resources. To be more specific, we first use a relatively larger Chinese dialects corpus to train a source-side automatic speech recognition (ASR) model. Then, we adopt a simple but effective data augmentation method (i.e., speed, pitch, and noise disturbance) to augment the target-side low-resource Chinese dialects, and fine-tune another target ASR model based on the previous source-side ASR model. Meanwhile, the potential common semantic features between source-side and target-side ASR models can be captured by using self-attention mechanism. Finally, we extract the hidden semantic representation in the target ASR model to conduct Chinese dialects discrimination. Our extensive experimental results demonstrate that our model significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods on two benchmark Chinese dialects corpora.

item.title: Responsible ASR: Overcoming Challenges of Foundational Models in Narrow-Band and Low-Resource Settings
item.author: Tejas Godambe, Nutan Choudhary, Sanket Shah, Nagaraj Adiga, Sharath Adavanne
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究评估了广泛使用的基础自动语音识别模型在窄带印地语对话和印度口音英语上的性能。

背景: 全球电话对话通常在窄带信道中进行，且往往具有自发性和口语化特征。

目的: 评估开源和商业基础自动语音识别模型在低资源语言（印地语）和低资源口音（印度口音英语）的窄带对话中的性能。

方法: 首先在零样本设置下评估模型性能，随后使用有限的真实标注录音对开源模型进行微调，以探究微调的影响。

主要发现: 在零样本设置下模型性能普遍不理想；微调虽能带来一定提升，但其效果因语言和口音而异，主要受预训练阶段接触数据量的影响。

结论: 自动语音识别模型在窄带和低资源语言场景下面临挑战，微调的有效性取决于预训练数据量。

翻译: Telephony conversations worldwide are conducted over narrow-band channels and are often spontaneous and colloquial in nature. This paper evaluates the performance of widely used foundational automatic speech recognition (ASR) models -- both open-source and commercial -- on narrow-band conversations in Hindi, a low-resource language, and Indian-accented English, a low-resource accent. We first assess these models in a zero-shot setting and find that their performance remains suboptimal across the board. Highlighting the challenges faced by ASR models in narrow-band and low-resource language scenarios, we further investigate the impact of fine-tuning open-source models using a limited set of real-life annotated recordings. Our findings indicate that while fine-tuning provides some improvements, its effectiveness varies across languages and accents, largely influenced by the amount of data encountered during pretraining

Abstract

Telephony conversations worldwide are conducted over narrow-band channels and are often spontaneous and colloquial in nature. This paper evaluates the performance of widely used foundational automatic speech recognition (ASR) models -- both open-source and commercial -- on narrow-band conversations in Hindi, a low-resource language, and Indian-accented English, a low-resource accent. We first assess these models in a zero-shot setting and find that their performance remains suboptimal across the board. Highlighting the challenges faced by ASR models in narrow-band and low-resource language scenarios, we further investigate the impact of fine-tuning open-source models using a limited set of real-life annotated recordings. Our findings indicate that while fine-tuning provides some improvements, its effectiveness varies across languages and accents, largely influenced by the amount of data encountered during pretraining

item.title: BrainFusionNet: a deep learning and XAI model to understand local, global, and sequential features of MRI images for improved brain tumour detection
item.author: Md Taimur Ahad, Bo Song, Yan Li
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为BrainFusionNet的混合深度学习模型，用于脑部肿瘤分类。该模型结合了卷积神经网络、视觉变换器和门控循环单元，以提取MRI图像的空间、上下文和序列特征。通过可解释人工智能技术可视化决策过程，并在两个公开数据集上达到了百分之九十八的准确率。

背景: 磁共振成像中的噪声对深度学习构成挑战，特别是在肿瘤边界模糊、肿瘤位置和外观复杂的情况下。

目的: 开发一种能够有效提取MRI图像特征的模型，以提高脑部肿瘤分类的准确性。

方法: 构建了BrainFusionNet模型，结合卷积神经网络、视觉变换器和门控循环单元。使用可解释人工智能技术如SHAP、LIME和GradCAM进行可视化。在两个公开数据集上进行评估，采用五折交叉验证，并与六种最先进的卷积神经网络和迁移学习方法进行比较。

主要发现: BrainFusionNet在两个数据集上均达到百分之九十八的准确率，优于对比模型。该模型能有效提取局部和全局特征，即使在肿瘤区域较小或肿瘤尺寸较小的情况下。像素强度的分布影响深度学习性能。

结论: BrainFusionNet通过混合架构有效提取MRI图像特征，提高了脑部肿瘤分类的准确性，并为图像解释提供了新的见解。

翻译: The noise of Magnetic Resonance Imaging MRI poses challenges for Deep Learning DL when tumor boundaries are obscured tumor location and appearance are complex Therefore we develop BrainFusionNet that combines Convolutional Neural Networks CNNs Vision Transformers ViT and Gated Recurrent Units GRUs to extract spatial contextual and sequential features from MRI images for improved brain tumor classification Furthermore explainable AI such as SHAP LIME and GradCAM are integrated to visualise and highlight image regions that contribute to BrainFusionNets decisionmaking process The proposed BrainFusionNet model is evaluated on two publicly available MRI datasets Kfold validation suggests 98 accuracy on both datasets The model was compared with the six stateoftheart SOTA CNNs and transfer learning Among the SOTA CNNs DenseNet121 and VGG16 achieved the highest accuracy of 96 The novelty of BrainFusionNet is that the hybrid model effectively extracts local and global features from MRI images even in smallscale tumor regions and small tumor sizes The model has a balanced sequential CNN architecture to capture lowlevel and deeperlayer features a customized ViT that captures local features stabilizes gradient flow and reduces the risk of vanishing gradients during MRI image training The CNN and ViT outputs are fed into a GRU for final classification Furthermore we analyze pixel intensities to determine whether MRI image quality affects image classification Our findings are very novel in image interpretation as we found that the distribution of pixel intensities in MRI images affects DL performance

Abstract

The noise of Magnetic Resonance Imaging MRI poses challenges for Deep Learning DL when tumor boundaries are obscured tumor location and appearance are complex Therefore we develop BrainFusionNet that combines Convolutional Neural Networks CNNs Vision Transformers ViT and Gated Recurrent Units GRUs to extract spatial contextual and sequential features from MRI images for improved brain tumor classification Furthermore explainable AI such as SHAP LIME and GradCAM are integrated to visualise and highlight image regions that contribute to BrainFusionNets decisionmaking process The proposed BrainFusionNet model is evaluated on two publicly available MRI datasets Kfold validation suggests 98 accuracy on both datasets The model was compared with the six stateoftheart SOTA CNNs and transfer learning Among the SOTA CNNs DenseNet121 and VGG16 achieved the highest accuracy of 96 The novelty of BrainFusionNet is that the hybrid model effectively extracts local and global features from MRI images even in smallscale tumor regions and small tumor sizes The model has a balanced sequential CNN architecture to capture lowlevel and deeperlayer features a customized ViT that captures local features stabilizes gradient flow and reduces the risk of vanishing gradients during MRI image training The CNN and ViT outputs are fed into a GRU for final classification Furthermore we analyze pixel intensities to determine whether MRI image quality affects image classification Our findings are very novel in image interpretation as we found that the distribution of pixel intensities in MRI images affects DL performance

item.title: Bounded Context Management for Tabular Foundation Models on Stream Learning
item.author: Jinmo Lee, Doyun Choi, Moongi Choi, Jaemin Yoo
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文针对表格流学习在分布偏移下对顺序到达样本进行预测的需求，提出了一种基于表格基础模型的上下文管理策略CURE。该策略通过未来信息视角，要求保留近期样本、保留不确定样本并移除冗余样本，实现了熵门控准入和冗余感知驱逐。实验表明CURE在七个数据流上相比经典流学习器有显著性能提升，具有鲁棒性且优于其他策略变体。

背景: 表格流学习需要在分布偏移的情况下对顺序到达的样本进行预测。虽然标准方法通过更新模型状态来适应，但表格基础模型通过上下文中的标注样本进行条件预测，为流学习提供了自然的替代方案。这使得挑战从如何更新模型转变为如何管理上下文。

目的: 提出一种有效的上下文管理策略，以解决表格基础模型在流学习中的上下文管理问题，提升预测性能。

方法: 提出未来信息视角，得出上下文管理的三个实际需求：保留近期样本、保留不确定样本、移除冗余样本。基于这些需求实例化了CURE策略，该策略包含熵门控准入机制和冗余感知驱逐机制。

主要发现: 在七个数据流上，CURE相比经典流学习器实现了最高27.0%的相对性能提升；CURE在多种表格基础模型骨干网络上保持鲁棒性；CURE在其他策略变体中排名第一。

结论: CURE作为一种上下文管理策略，能够有效提升表格基础模型在流学习中的表现，具有显著的性能优势和鲁棒性。

翻译: Tabular stream learning requires predictions on sequentially arriving examples under distribution shift. While standard methods adapt by updating model states, tabular foundation models (TFMs) make predictions conditioned on a labeled context in an in-context manner, making them a natural alternative for stream learning. This shifts the challenge from how to update the model to how to manage the context. We propose a future information view that yields three practical requirements for context management: preserve recent examples, retain uncertain examples, and remove redundant examples. We instantiate these requirements as CURE (Context management via Uncertainty-aware admission and Redundancy aware Eviction), a context-managing policy with entropy-gated admission and redundancy-aware eviction. Across seven streams, CURE shows up to 27.0% relative improvement over classical stream learners, remains robust across multiple TFM backbones, and ranks first among other policy variants. Code and datasets are available at https://github.com/morcellinus/CURE-ICML-FMSD.

Abstract

Tabular stream learning requires predictions on sequentially arriving examples under distribution shift. While standard methods adapt by updating model states, tabular foundation models (TFMs) make predictions conditioned on a labeled context in an in-context manner, making them a natural alternative for stream learning. This shifts the challenge from how to update the model to how to manage the context. We propose a future information view that yields three practical requirements for context management: preserve recent examples, retain uncertain examples, and remove redundant examples. We instantiate these requirements as CURE (Context management via Uncertainty-aware admission and Redundancy aware Eviction), a context-managing policy with entropy-gated admission and redundancy-aware eviction. Across seven streams, CURE shows up to 27.0% relative improvement over classical stream learners, remains robust across multiple TFM backbones, and ranks first among other policy variants. Code and datasets are available at https://github.com/morcellinus/CURE-ICML-FMSD.

item.title: Trainable Photonic Measurement for Physics-Informed PDE Learning
item.author: Jiale Linghu, Hao Dong, Yangshuai Wang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种光子量子神经场，将坐标转化为可训练的光学相位，通过多光子福克空间干涉进行混合，并从光子数测量中解码。该光子电路作为神经场表示本身进行优化，而非固定特征映射或硬件加速器。在七个偏微分方程基准测试中，观察到相位复杂性过渡：在平滑区域，经典坐标和傅里叶特征网络足够；而在残差导数放大相位失配的困难区域，光子场最准确，误差最低，参数量仅为经典基线的四分之一。控制实验和噪声测试表明，这种优势源于学习到的干涉和稳定的福克概率读出。

背景: 光子量子机器学习提供了一种基于相位、干涉和测量的可训练物理表示途径，但其在科学机器学习中的作用尚未得到充分探索。物理信息神经场提供了一个自然的环境，因为微分方程需要保留相位、频率和导数结构的试验空间。

目的: 引入一种光子量子神经场，将坐标转化为可训练的光学相位，通过多光子福克空间干涉进行混合，并从光子数测量中解码，以优化光子电路作为神经场表示本身，从而最小化物理信息残差。

方法: 构建光子量子神经场，将坐标转化为可训练的光学相位，通过多光子福克空间干涉进行混合，并从光子数测量中解码。将光子电路作为神经场表示本身进行优化，而非固定特征映射或硬件加速器。在七个偏微分方程基准测试中评估其性能，并进行控制实验和噪声测试。

主要发现: 在七个偏微分方程基准测试中观察到相位复杂性过渡：在平滑区域，经典坐标和傅里叶特征网络足够；而在残差导数放大相位失配的困难区域，光子场最准确，误差最低，参数量仅为经典基线的四分之一。控制实验和噪声测试表明，这种优势源于学习到的干涉和稳定的福克概率读出。

结论: 光子量子测量被确定为科学机器学习的一种表示学习原则。

翻译: Photonic quantum machine learning offers a route to trainable physical representations built from phase, interference and measurement. However, its role in scientific machine learning remains largely unexplored. Physics-informed neural fields provide a natural setting, because differential equations require trial spaces that preserve phase, frequency and derivative structure. Here we introduce a photonic quantum neural field in which coordinates become trainable optical phases, are mixed by multi-photon Fock-space interference and are decoded from photon-number measurements. The photonic circuit is optimized as the neural-field representation itself, not as a fixed feature map or hardware accelerator. Photonic measurement is therefore a trainable representation on which the physics-informed residual is minimized. Across seven elliptic, wave, nonlinear dispersive and inverse PDE benchmarks, we observe a phase-complexity transition: classical coordinate and Fourier-feature networks suffice in smooth regimes, whereas the photonic field is most accurate when residual derivatives amplify phase mismatch. In the hardest regimes it gives the lowest errors, with margins reaching an order of magnitude and about one quarter of the trainable parameters of classical baselines. Frozen and shuffled controls, together with noise stress tests, attribute this gain to learned interference and stable Fock-probability readout under compound perturbations. These results identify photonic quantum measurement as a representation-learning principle for scientific machine learning.

Abstract

Photonic quantum machine learning offers a route to trainable physical representations built from phase, interference and measurement. However, its role in scientific machine learning remains largely unexplored. Physics-informed neural fields provide a natural setting, because differential equations require trial spaces that preserve phase, frequency and derivative structure. Here we introduce a photonic quantum neural field in which coordinates become trainable optical phases, are mixed by multi-photon Fock-space interference and are decoded from photon-number measurements. The photonic circuit is optimized as the neural-field representation itself, not as a fixed feature map or hardware accelerator. Photonic measurement is therefore a trainable representation on which the physics-informed residual is minimized. Across seven elliptic, wave, nonlinear dispersive and inverse PDE benchmarks, we observe a phase-complexity transition: classical coordinate and Fourier-feature networks suffice in smooth regimes, whereas the photonic field is most accurate when residual derivatives amplify phase mismatch. In the hardest regimes it gives the lowest errors, with margins reaching an order of magnitude and about one quarter of the trainable parameters of classical baselines. Frozen and shuffled controls, together with noise stress tests, attribute this gain to learned interference and stable Fock-probability readout under compound perturbations. These results identify photonic quantum measurement as a representation-learning principle for scientific machine learning.

item.title: Morpheus: A Morphology-Aware Neural Tokenizer and Word Embedder for Turkish
item.author: Şakar, Tolga
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为Morpheus的神经形态边界模型，该模型同时作为无损、形态感知的词元生成器和词嵌入生成器。

背景: 土耳其语是一种黏着语，意义由词素承载。然而，现代语言模型驱动的亚词词元分割器基于语料库统计信息分割单词，导致语义负载后缀碎片化，并且在某些情况下无法将输出解码回原始文本。

目的: 开发一种能够无损处理土耳其语形态结构，并生成词嵌入的模型。

方法: 使用可微分的泊松二项动态规划方法，将逐字符边界概率转化为训练时的软形态成员归属和推理时的精确分割。该模型无需字符串归一化，确保编码和解码过程的可逆性。

主要发现: Morpheus在可逆词元生成器中实现了最低的每字符位数，显著提高了形态对齐的准确率，并比64K词汇量的亚词词元分割器减少了约19%的GPU内存使用。作为嵌入器，冻结的Morpheus向量在词汇检索和同根验证任务上表现优异，超越了多语言检索器BGE-M3和BERTurk。

结论: Morpheus在形态感知和词嵌入生成方面表现出色，但在上下文和屈折依赖任务上，较重的上下文编码器仍占优势，这归因于Morpheus以词根为中心的几何结构。

翻译: Turkish is agglutinative: meaning is carried by morphemes, yet the subword tokenizers that drive modern language models split words by corpus statistics, fragmenting semantically loaded suffixes and -- in the case of WordPiece and rule-based analyzers -- failing to decode their output back to the original text. This paper presents Morpheus, a neural morpheme-boundary model for Turkish that is at once a lossless, morphology-aware tokenizer and a word-embedding producer. A differentiable Poisson-binomial dynamic program turns per-character boundary probabilities into soft morpheme memberships during training and exact segments at inference, with no string normalization, so decode(encode(w)) = w holds by construction. Because the model is neural, the same forward pass that tokenizes also emits a structured word embedding. Among reversible tokenizers -- the only ones valid for generation -- Morpheus attains the lowest bits-per-character, roughly doubles the gold morphological alignment of the subword family, and uses ~19% less GPU memory than 64K-vocabulary subword tokenizers. As an embedder, frozen Morpheus vectors lead on lexical retrieval and same-root verification, surpassing the multilingual retriever BGE-M3 and BERTurk; on context- and inflection-dependent tasks the heavier contextual encoders remain ahead -- a trade-off we attribute to Morpheus's root-centric geometry.

Abstract

Turkish is agglutinative: meaning is carried by morphemes, yet the subword tokenizers that drive modern language models split words by corpus statistics, fragmenting semantically loaded suffixes and -- in the case of WordPiece and rule-based analyzers -- failing to decode their output back to the original text. This paper presents \textbf{Morpheus}, a neural morpheme-boundary model for Turkish that is at once a lossless, morphology-aware tokenizer and a word-embedding producer. A differentiable Poisson-binomial dynamic program turns per-character boundary probabilities into soft morpheme memberships during training and exact segments at inference, with no string normalization, so $\mathrm{decode}(\mathrm{encode}(w)) = w$ holds by construction. Because the model is neural, the same forward pass that tokenizes also emits a structured word embedding. Among reversible tokenizers -- the only ones valid for generation -- Morpheus attains the lowest bits-per-character ($1.425$), roughly doubles the gold morphological alignment of the subword family (MorphScore macro-F1 $0.61$ vs.\ ${\sim}0.32$), and uses ${\sim}19\%$ less GPU memory than 64K-vocabulary subword tokenizers. As an embedder, frozen Morpheus vectors lead on lexical retrieval (root-family MAP $0.85$) and same-root verification (ROC-AUC $1.00$), surpassing the multilingual retriever BGE-M3 and BERTurk; on context- and inflection-dependent tasks (NER, case/number probing) the heavier contextual encoders remain ahead -- a trade-off we attribute to Morpheus's root-centric geometry. item.title: Reinforcement Learning Foundation Models Should Already Be A Thing
item.author: Abdelrahman Zighem, Jill-Jênn Vie
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文探讨了将基础模型应用于强化学习领域的可能性，指出强化学习是结构化领域中的显著空白，并提出通过合成马尔可夫决策过程数据训练模型，无需任务特定调整即可在上下文环境中解决表格基准测试。

背景: 语言和视觉的基础模型依赖于互联网规模的数据，而结构化领域如表格预测、时间序列预测、图学习和强化学习则缺乏此类数据。合成数据成为替代方案，将负担从数据收集转移到先验设计。目前已有许多结构化任务的先验存在，例如TabPFN及其后继者使用在合成贝叶斯先验上预训练的转换器解决表格分类问题。

目的: 指出强化学习在基础模型应用中的缺失，并探讨利用马尔可夫决策过程的固定大小充分统计量特性，使其适用于基于注意力的架构，从而定义强化学习基础模型的研究议程。

方法: 通过完全在合成马尔可夫决策过程数据上训练一个模型，展示其在无需任务特定调整的情况下，能够在上下文环境中解决保留的表格基准测试，包括在线和离线两种场景。

主要发现: 合成的马尔可夫决策过程采样与合成表格数据集采样同样可行，但当前没有上下文强化学习工作将先验设计作为主要目标。马尔可夫决策过程具有与观察到的回合数无关的固定大小充分统计量，且呈表格形状，这使其直接适用于用于表格基础模型的基于注意力的架构，只需将监督目标替换为策略头。

结论: 通过概念验证，训练出的模型在在线场景中比UCB-VI和表格Q学习所需的回合数少得多，在离线场景中与VI-LCB具有竞争力，证明了强化学习基础模型的可行性。

翻译: Foundation models for language and vision are powered by internet-scale data, while structured domains (tabular prediction, time-series forecasting, graph learning, reinforcement learning) are not. The substitute is synthetic data, which shifts the burden from collection to prior design. Such priors already exist for many structured tasks: TabPFN and its successors solve tabular classification with a transformer pretrained on a synthetic Bayesian prior. We make two points. First, reinforcement learning is the conspicuous gap: sampling a synthetic MDP is as feasible as sampling a synthetic tabular dataset, yet no in-context RL work treats prior design as a primary objective. Second, MDPs admit a fixed-size sufficient statistic, independent of the episodes observed and tabular in shape, which makes them directly amenable to the attention-based architectures used for tabular foundation models, with a policy head replacing the supervised target. Together these define the agenda for an RL foundation model. As a proof of concept, we train one model entirely on synthetic MDPs and show that, with no task-specific tuning, it solves held-out tabular benchmarks in context, both online and offline: online, in far fewer episodes than UCB-VI and tabular Q-learning, and offline, competitively with VI-LCB.

Abstract

Foundation models for language and vision are powered by internet-scale data, while structured domains (tabular prediction, time-series forecasting, graph learning, reinforcement learning) are not. The substitute is synthetic data, which shifts the burden from collection to prior design. Such priors already exist for many structured tasks: TabPFN and its successors solve tabular classification with a transformer pretrained on a synthetic Bayesian prior. We make two points. \textbf{First}, reinforcement learning is the conspicuous gap: sampling a synthetic MDP is as feasible as sampling a synthetic tabular dataset, yet no in-context RL work treats prior design as a primary objective. \textbf{Second}, MDPs admit a fixed-size sufficient statistic, independent of the episodes observed and tabular in shape, which makes them directly amenable to the attention-based architectures used for tabular foundation models, with a policy head replacing the supervised target. Together these define the agenda for an RL foundation model. As a proof of concept, we train one model entirely on synthetic MDPs and show that, with no task-specific tuning, it solves held-out tabular benchmarks in context, both online and offline: online, in far fewer episodes than UCB-VI and tabular Q-learning, and offline, competitively with VI-LCB.

item.title: Improving Human-Robot Teamwork in Urban Search and Rescue Through Episodic Memory of Prior Collaboration
item.author: Taewoon Kim, Emma van Zoelen, Mark Neerincx
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究探讨了机器人能否利用从人类合作伙伴那里获得的历史协作模式经验，在未来的互动中成为更好的团队成员。

背景: 有效的人机团队协作要求机器人从一开始就能适应合作伙伴、情境和任务动态。在MATRX城市搜救环境中，人们可以通过聊天和反思界面外化他们在团队协作中发现的协作模式。

目的: 研究机器人能否利用此类先前的团队经验，在未来的互动中成为更好的团队成员。

方法: 将历史协作模式表示为知识图谱的情景记忆，使用带有节点分类目标的图表示学习来识别一个具有代表性且有效的记忆以供重用，并在新协作 episode 开始前用该记忆初始化机器人。

主要发现: 在涉及二十名参与者和一百六十次轮次观察的实验中，用单个自动选择的先前协作模式初始化机器人，使救援成功率从百分之二十五点七提高到百分之四十一点三，并将平均任务时间减少了二百八十三秒。最强的提升出现在互动初期。

结论: 可重用情景记忆可以帮助机器人带着更有效的任务知识进入协作，并支持更顺畅的早期团队协作。

翻译: Effective human-robot teamwork requires robots to adapt to partners, situations, and task dynamics from the start of an interaction. In the MATRX Urban Search and Rescue (USAR) environment, people can externalize collaboration patterns (CPs) they discover during teamwork through a chat and reflection interface. We study whether a robot can use such prior team experience to become a better teammate in future interactions. To this end, we represent historical CPs as knowledge-graph episodic memories and use graph representation learning with a node-classification objective to identify a representative and effective memory for reuse. We then initialize the robot with this memory before a new collaboration episode begins. Across 20 participants and 160 round-level observations, initializing the robot with a single automatically selected prior CP increases rescue success from 25.7% to 41.3% and reduces average task time by 283 seconds. The strongest gains appear at the beginning of interaction, suggesting that reusable episodic memory can help robots enter collaboration with more effective task knowledge and support smoother early teamwork.

Abstract

Effective human-robot teamwork requires robots to adapt to partners, situations, and task dynamics from the start of an interaction. In the MATRX Urban Search and Rescue (USAR) environment, people can externalize collaboration patterns (CPs) they discover during teamwork through a chat and reflection interface. We study whether a robot can use such prior team experience to become a better teammate in future interactions. To this end, we represent historical CPs as knowledge-graph episodic memories and use graph representation learning with a node-classification objective to identify a representative and effective memory for reuse. We then initialize the robot with this memory before a new collaboration episode begins. Across 20 participants and 160 round-level observations, initializing the robot with a single automatically selected prior CP increases rescue success from 25.7% to 41.3% and reduces average task time by 283 seconds. The strongest gains appear at the beginning of interaction, suggesting that reusable episodic memory can help robots enter collaboration with more effective task knowledge and support smoother early teamwork.

item.title: Externalizing Research Synthesis and Validation in AI Scientists through a Research Harness
item.author: Wang, Zijian, Li, Hanqi, Yang, Ziyue, Hu, Zijian, Zuo, Shenghan, Zhang, Yunzhe, Ma, Da, Luo, Danyu, Wang, Chenrun, Peng, Jing, Huang, Tiancheng, Guo, Sijia, Wang, Huayang, Zhu, Zichen, Han, Senyu, Cao, Yilu, Yu, Kai, Chen, Lu
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

结论: AI 科学家不仅应通过最终产物评估，还应通过其综合和验证过程是否可归因、可检查和科学负责来评估。

翻译: AI 系统越来越多地自动化科学工作流，但连接先前证据、生成想法、实验和最终声明的推理通常隐含在模型推断内部。在此，我们引入 Xcientist，一个将研究综合和实验验证外化为可检查、受合同约束流程的研究框架。Xcientist 将文献证据、想法状态、实施计划、消融记录和修复痕迹组织为持久化研究产物，以便生成的机制可以被 grounding、执行、测试和修订而不丢失其证据基础。我们识别出自动研究的一种失效模式为'主张漂移'，即可运行产物不再支持最初声称的机制。在免训练记忆系统、图结构交通预测和多尺度物理信息神经网络中，Xcientist 保持了从问题 formulation 到机制设计、验证和有界修订的可追溯轨迹。这些结果表明，AI 科学家不仅应通过最终产物评估，还应通过其综合和验证过程是否可归因、可检查和科学负责来评估。

Abstract

AI systems can increasingly automate scientific workflows, but the reasoning that links prior evidence, generated ideas, experiments and final claims often remains implicit inside model inference. Here we introduce Xcientist, a research harness that externalizes research synthesis and experimental validation into inspectable, contract-governed processes. Xcientist organizes literature evidence, idea states, implementation plans, ablation records and repair traces as persistent research artifacts, so that generated mechanisms can be grounded, executed, tested and revised without losing their evidential basis. We identify claim drift as a failure mode of automated research, where runnable artifacts no longer support the mechanism originally claimed. Across training-free memory systems, graph-structured traffic forecasting and multi-scale physics-informed neural networks, Xcientist preserves traceable trajectories from problem formulation to mechanism design, validation and bounded revision. These results suggest that AI scientists should be evaluated not only by their final artifacts, but by whether their synthesis and validation processes remain attributable, inspectable and scientifically accountable.

item.title: ThinkDeception: A Progressive Reinforcement Learning Framework for Interpretable Multimodal Deception Detection
item.author: Jinhao Song, Shan Liang, Yiqun Yue, Zhuhuayang Zhang, Tianqi Gao
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出ThinkDeception框架，利用多模态大语言模型实现可解释的多模态欺骗检测，通过逐步推理和一致性训练提升检测精度与推理质量。

背景: 现有端到端黑盒方法缺乏可解释性，无法提供透明推理过程，难以捕捉欺骗行为中的跨模态细微不一致。

目的: 突破现有方法局限性，将欺骗检测从传统二分类任务转化为显式认知推理过程，实现可解释的多模态欺骗检测。

方法: 构建多模态大语言模型ThinkDeception，使用逐步多模态思维链数据集训练基础模型；提出视觉-音频一致性组相对策略优化方法，结合渐进式训练策略、动态课程调度器、多维过程感知奖励机制和反思学习范式。

主要发现: 模态不一致性在解码欺骗中起关键作用；渐进式训练策略显著提升模型推理质量；在主流基准测试中达到新状态，检测准确性和推理质量均优于现有方法。

结论: 该工作成功推动欺骗检测领域向可解释的多模态认知推理方向发展。

翻译: Multimodal deception detection is critical for identifying fraudulent intentions, yet existing approaches predominantly rely on end to end black--box paradigms. These methods suffer from a severe lack of interpretability failing to provide transparent reasoning trajectories and struggling to explicitly capture the subtle, cross modal inconsistencies inherent in deceptive behaviors. To transcend these limitations, we propose ThinkDeception, a novel and interpretable multimodal deception detection framework. As a pioneering effort, it introduces Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) into this domain, transforming deception detection from a traditional binary classification task into an explicit cognitive reasoning process. Facilitated by the first meticulously annotated step--by--step multimodal Chain of Thought (CoT) dataset, we develop a foundational model, ThinkDeception Base, empirically validating the critical role of modal inconsistency in decoding deception. Building upon this foundation, our core innovation lies in proposing Visual-Audio Consistency Group Relative Policy Optimization(VAC--GRPO) equipped with a progressive training strategy. Distinct from standard GRPO, we stratify the training data into four progressive difficulty tiers, guiding the model through a psychologically grounded easy--to-hard cognitive transition. By innovatively coupling this dynamic curriculum scheduler with a multi dimensional, process aware reward mechanism and a reflective learning paradigm, we significantly elevate the model's overall reasoning quality. Extensive experiments on mainstream benchmarks demonstrate that ThinkDeception establishes a new SOTA, significantly outperforming existing methods in both detection accuracy and rationale quality. Ultimately, this work successfully drives the field of deception detection toward interpretable, multimodal cognitive reasoning.

Abstract

Multimodal deception detection is critical for identifying fraudulent intentions, yet existing approaches predominantly rely on end to end black--box paradigms. These methods suffer from a severe lack of interpretability failing to provide transparent reasoning trajectories and struggling to explicitly capture the subtle, cross modal inconsistencies inherent in deceptive behaviors. To transcend these limitations, we propose ThinkDeception, a novel and interpretable multimodal deception detection framework. As a pioneering effort, it introduces Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) into this domain, transforming deception detection from a traditional binary classification task into an explicit cognitive reasoning process. Facilitated by the first meticulously annotated step--by--step multimodal Chain of Thought (CoT) dataset, we develop a foundational model, ThinkDeception Base, empirically validating the critical role of modal inconsistency in decoding deception. Building upon this foundation, our core innovation lies in proposing Visual-Audio Consistency Group Relative Policy Optimization(VAC--GRPO) equipped with a progressive training strategy. Distinct from standard GRPO, we stratify the training data into four progressive difficulty tiers, guiding the model through a psychologically grounded easy--to--hard cognitive transition. By innovatively coupling this dynamic curriculum scheduler with a multi dimensional, process aware reward mechanism and a reflective learning paradigm, we significantly elevate the model's overall reasoning quality. Extensive experiments on mainstream benchmarks demonstrate that ThinkDeception establishes a new SOTA, significantly outperforming existing methods in both detection accuracy and rationale quality. Ultimately, this work successfully drives the field of deception detection toward interpretable, multimodal cognitive reasoning.

item.title: Optimized Multi-Contrast Self-Supervised MRI Reconstruction using Learned k-space Partitioning
item.author: Brenden Kadota, Charles Millard, Mark Chiew
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究提出了一种多对比度自监督学习框架，用于磁共振成像重建。该方法无需完全采样的k空间数据作为参考，通过端到端学习最优的自监督数据划分策略，联合训练多个欠采样对比度。实验表明，与单对比度自监督学习方法相比，该方法显著提高了重建质量。

背景: 深度学习在通过欠采样数据重建高质量磁共振图像方面展现出潜力。虽然近期研究利用多对比度信息提升重建性能，但这些方法依赖监督学习，需要完全采样的k空间数据进行训练。自监督学习通过数据欠采样方法允许直接在欠采样k空间上训练，通过将数据分为两部分并建立网络映射。

目的: 改进磁共振自监督重建技术，通过两种修改提升性能：一是提出多对比度自监督学习框架，联合训练多个欠采样对比度；二是学习每个对比度的最优自监督数据划分，以进一步提升重建质量。

方法: 提出多对比度自监督学习框架，联合训练多个欠采样对比度，无需完全采样k空间数据。学习最优的自监督数据划分，通过端到端方式学习最优划分概率分布，采样生成掩码进行数据划分。

主要发现: 在两个公开多对比度磁共振数据集上的实验表明，所提出的自监督多对比度学习划分方法相比当前单对比度自监督学习方法提高了重建质量。学习k空间数据的划分进一步增强了重建的保真度。

结论: 多对比度重建结合学习划分，相比单对比度自监督磁共振重建提高了重建保真度。

翻译: Objective: Deep Learning has shown promise in accelerating MRI by reconstructing high-quality images from under-sampled data. While recent work has leveraged multi-contrast information to improve reconstruction performance, these methods rely on supervised learning, which requires fully sampled k-space for training. One method, self-supervised learning via data undersampling (SSDU), enables direct training on under-sampled k-space by partitioning it into two sets, with a network mapping between the two. In this work, we improve MRI self-supervised MRI reconstruction with two modifications. Methods: We propose a multi-contrast self-supervised learning framework that jointly trains on multiple under-sampled contrasts without requiring fully sampled k-space data as a reference. Moreover, we learn an optimal self-supervised data partitioning for each contrast in an end-to-end manner, further enhancing reconstruction quality. Specifically, we learn an optimal partitioning probability distribution, which is sampled to generate a mask for partitioning. Results: Experiments on two publicly available multi-contrast MRI datasets demonstrate the improved reconstruction quality of our proposed self-supervised multi-contrast learned partitioning method compared to the current single-contrast self-supervised learning methods. We also demonstrate that learning the partitioning of k-space data further enhances the fidelity of reconstructions. Conclusion: Multi-contrast reconstruction combined with learned partitioning improves reconstruction fidelity over single-contrast self-supervised MRI reconstructions. Significance: Our method can facilitate higher image fidelity and/or accelerated MRI protocol times compared to previous self-supervised methods, and without requiring fully sampled k-space for training.

Abstract

Objective: Deep Learning has shown promise in accelerating MRI by reconstructing high-quality images from under-sampled data. While recent work has leveraged multi-contrast information to improve reconstruction performance, these methods rely on supervised learning, which requires fully sampled k-space for training. One method, self-supervised learning via data undersampling (SSDU), enables direct training on under-sampled k-space by partitioning it into two sets, with a network mapping between the two. In this work, we improve MRI self-supervised MRI reconstruction with two modifications. Methods: We propose a multi-contrast self-supervised learning framework that jointly trains on multiple under-sampled contrasts without requiring fully sampled k-space data as a reference. Moreover, we learn an optimal self-supervised data partitioning for each contrast in an end-to-end manner, further enhancing reconstruction quality. Specifically, we learn an optimal partitioning probability distribution, which is sampled to generate a mask for partitioning. Results: Experiments on two publicly available multi-contrast MRI datasets demonstrate the improved reconstruction quality of our proposed self-supervised multi-contrast learned partitioning method compared to the current single-contrast self-supervised learning methods. We also demonstrate that learning the partitioning of k-space data further enhances the fidelity of reconstructions. Conclusion: Multi-contrast reconstruction combined with learned partitioning improves reconstruction fidelity over single-contrast self-supervised MRI reconstructions. Significance: Our method can facilitate higher image fidelity and/or accelerated MRI protocol times compared to previous self-supervised methods, and without requiring fully sampled k-space for training.

item.title: JWST-TST High Contrast: First Direct Spectroscopy of GJ 504 b reveals Clouds and Possible Metal Enrichment
item.author: Aneesh Baburaj, Jean-Baptiste Ruffio, Marshall Perrin, Jerry W. Xuan, William O. Balmer, Yayaati Chachan, Quinn M. Konopacky, Travis S. Barman, Mathilde Mâlin, Kielan K. W. Hoch, Emily Rickman, Kimberly Ward-Duong, Laurent Pueyo, Julien H. Girard, Isabel Rebollido, Alexis Bidot, Christine Chen, Kadin Worthen, Cicero Lu, Jens Kammerer, Roeland P. van der Marel, Nikole K. Lewis, Jeff Valenti, Sara Seager, Chris Stark, Rémi Soummer, Jay Anderson, Charles-Philippe Lajoie, Mark Clampin, C. Matt Mountain
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 利用詹姆斯·韦伯太空望远镜的近红外光谱仪对直接成像的行星质量伴星GJ 504 b进行了中等分辨率光谱观测。通过先进的后处理技术和正向建模框架，成功探测到该伴星并提取了其光谱。光谱分析显示存在多种分子物种，大气模型拟合得出有效温度、表面重力、金属丰度等参数。推导出的质量与演化模型一致，暗示了特定的年龄范围。与主星丰度对比显示该伴星可能存在金属增丰，支持类行星形成机制。

背景: 利用直接光谱学表征最冷的直接成像伴星在詹姆斯·韦伯太空望远镜之前仅通过光度观测成为可能，而GJ 504 b作为前韦伯时代最冷的成像行星质量伴星，因太暗而无法进行地基光谱观测。

目的: 对直接成像的行星质量伴星GJ 504 b进行中等分辨率光谱观测，以表征其物理和化学特性。

方法: 使用詹姆斯·韦伯太空望远镜的近红外光谱仪进行观测，采用先进的后处理技术和正向建模框架，结合角差分成像进行点扩散函数减法，提取光谱并使用petitRADTRANS进行大气建模。

主要发现: 成功以高信噪比探测到GJ 504 b，并首次在近红外光谱点云中通过角差分成像实现点扩散函数减法。提取的光谱显示存在水、一氧化碳、甲烷、二氧化碳、氨、硫化氢等多种分子物种。大气模型拟合得到有效温度约为五百六十四开尔文，表面重力、金属丰度、碳氧比等参数。推导出的质量约为二十五点木星质量，与演化模型一致。与主星对比显示该伴星存在硫丰度、超恒星碳丰度及可能的氧丰度。

结论: GJ 504 b的质量与年龄范围与演化模型一致。观测到的金属增丰现象初步支持类行星形成机制，但并未完全排除其具有恒星丰度的可能性。

翻译: Characterizing the coldest directly imaged companions through direct spectroscopy has only recently become possible with the James Webb Space Telescope. We present moderate-resolution spectroscopic observations of the directly imaged planetary-mass companion GJ 504 b using the JWST/NIRSpec. Leveraging advanced post-processing techniques with a forward modeling framework, we detect the companion at high signal-to-noise. We also present the first successful PSF subtraction with angular differential imaging in the NIRSpec point cloud. The extracted spectra show strong signatures of several molecular species. Atmospheric modeling yields an effective temperature, surface gravity, metallicity, C/O ratio, and strong evidence of disequilibrium chemistry and salt clouds. The retrieved parameters indicate a mass in agreement with evolutionary models, implying a specific age range. Comparing abundances to its primary shows metal enrichment, tentatively supporting planet-like formation.

Abstract

Characterizing the coldest directly imaged companions through direct spectroscopy has only recently become possible with the James Webb Space Telescope. We present moderate-resolution (R $\sim$ 2,700) spectroscopic observations of the directly imaged planetary-mass companion (PMC), GJ 504 b, using the $JWST$/NIRSpec. As the coldest imaged PMC of the pre-JWST era GJ 504 b is too faint for ground-based spectroscopy, with only photometric observations possible. Leveraging advanced post-processing techniques with a forward modeling framework, we detect the companion at high signal-to-noise (S/N$>$300). We also present the first successful PSF subtraction with angular differential imaging (ADI) in the NIRSpec point cloud, detecting GJ 504 b at S/N$>10$ and reaching contrast limits $<10^{-4}$. The extracted 2.9--5.3 $μm$ spectra show strong signatures of several molecular species, including H$_2$O, $^{12}$C$^{16}$O, CH$_4$, CO$_2$, NH$_3$, H$_2$S, $^{13}$C$^{16}$O, and $^{12}$C$^{18}$O. Atmospheric modeling of the spectra using \texttt{petitRADTRANS}, yields an effective temperature = 564$\pm$4 K, surface gravity $\log{g}$ = 4.87$^{+0.13}_{-0.12}$, metallicity [M/H] = 0.67$^{+0.13}_{-0.12}$, C/O ratio = 0.64$^{+0.02}_{-0.02}$, interstellar $^{12}$C/$^{13}$C and $^{16}$O/$^{18}$O isotopologue ratios, and strong evidence of disequilibrium chemistry and salt clouds. The retrieved parameters indicate a mass 25.2$^{+8.4}_{-6.0}$ $M_\mathrm{Jup}$, which is in agreement with the mass range (19--27 $M_\mathrm{Jup}$) obtained from ATMO evolutionary models, implying an age of 2.5--4.0 Gyr. Lastly, we compare the abundances of GJ 504 b to its primary, obtaining a stellar abundance of sulfur (S), super-stellar carbon (C), and possibly, oxygen (O). The observed metal enrichment tentatively supports planet-like formation, but does not entirely exclude stellar abundances for GJ 504 b.

item.title: A Unified Framework for Efficient Remote Sensing Visual Question Answering: Adapting Dual, Hybrid, and Encoder-Decoder Architectures
item.author: Timothy Agboada, Shikha Chandel, Yadav Raj Ghimire, Leila Hashemi-Beni
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要
