Stage 2: Uses entropy-filtered pseudo-labels from the Stage 1 model on 271,711 TCGA-UT scale-0 patches (0.5 um/pixel). Stage 3: Uses pseudo-labels from the Stage 2 model on all 1,608,060 TCGA-UT patches across six resolution scales (0.5-1.0 um/pixel). Segmentation outputs feed a structured TME feature extraction pipeline computing 20+ per-patch compositional, morphological, spatial entropy, and intercellular distance metrics. These are encoded as JSON and passed to a fine-tuned NVIDIA BioNeMo GPT model to generate clinically interpretable TME narratives. Preliminary validation on held-out PanNuke and TCGA-UT partitions demonstrates framework feasibility and internal consistency. The pseudo-labelled TCGA-UT dataset and UNI2-UPERHOVER checkpoint are publicly released to support large-scale TME profiling and spatial biology research.

Abstract

Characterising the tumour microenvironment (TME) from routine H&E-stained histology images requires simultaneous cell segmentation, feature extraction, and interpretable clinical reporting. We present SEGTME-UNI2, a unified framework addressing these requirements. Its core is UNI2-UPERHOVER, a dual-head segmentation model pairing the UNI2-H pathology foundation model (ViT-Giant, pretrained on >100M tiles from 100K slides) with two parallel UperNet decoders: one for six-class semantic segmentation and one for horizontal-vertical gradient regression enabling watershed-based nuclear instance separation. To address the lack of pixel-level annotations in large real-world repositories, UNI2-UPERHOVER undergoes a three-stage progressive pseudo-label curriculum. Each stage trains a fresh model without weight transfer, driving improvement entirely via increased pseudo-label quality: Stage 1: Uses human-annotated PanNuke (7,901 images, 189,744 nuclei, 0.25 um/pixel). Stage 2: Uses entropy-filtered pseudo-labels from the Stage 1 model on 271,711 TCGA-UT scale-0 patches (0.5 um/pixel). Stage 3: Uses pseudo-labels from the Stage 2 model on all 1,608,060 TCGA-UT patches across six resolution scales (0.5-1.0 um/pixel). Segmentation outputs feed a structured TME feature extraction pipeline computing 20+ per-patch compositional, morphological, spatial entropy, and intercellular distance metrics. These are encoded as JSON and passed to a fine-tuned NVIDIA BioNeMo GPT model to generate clinically interpretable TME narratives. Preliminary validation on held-out PanNuke and TCGA-UT partitions demonstrates framework feasibility and internal consistency. The pseudo-labelled TCGA-UT dataset and UNI2-UPERHOVER checkpoint are publicly released to support large-scale TME profiling and spatial biology research.

item.title: Double zero-inflated spatio-temporal modeling of daily precipitation under detection thresholds
item.author: Juan Marcen-Gutierrez, Jorge Castillo-Mateo, Alan E. Gelfand, Jesús Asín, Ana C. Cebrián
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究提出了一种多层时空模型，用于区分和解释降水行为中的两种零值情况（无降水事件和因检测限导致的未测量降水），并建模超过检测限的正降水。该模型结合概率回归、伽马回归和受阈值删失影响的观测机制，采用高斯过程捕捉空间依赖性，并在贝叶斯框架下进行推断。研究应用于西班牙东北部埃布罗河流域七十个站点十五年的春季每日观测数据。结果表明，检测阈值对观测降水的发生有显著影响，尤其在湿润地区，对总量影响较小，但对上分位数有重要影响。

背景: 在日尺度上解释降水行为对于精细理解驱动降水的机制至关重要。然而，由于频繁出现零值，这一工作具有挑战性。挑战因两种类型的零值而加剧：一是作为干燥事件的无降水，二是因检测限导致的未测量降水。

目的: 提出一种多层时空模型，以区分和解释两种类型的零值，并建模超过检测限的正降水。

方法: 结合概率回归模型化零值的概率，使用伽马回归建模潜在的正降水量，并采用受阈值删失影响的观测机制。在每个回归模型中使用高斯过程捕捉空间依赖性。在贝叶斯框架下进行推断，提供模型推断工具以比较和量化真实降水过程与观测过程之间的差异。

主要发现: 检测阈值强烈影响观测降水的发生，尤其在湿润地区。虽然其对总累积量的影响较小，但对上分位数有显著影响。

结论: 该模型能够有效区分和解释降水中的零值，并提供对降水机制的精细理解。检测阈值在观测降水分析中扮演重要角色，特别是在湿润地区。

翻译: 在日尺度上解释降水行为对于精细理解驱动降水的机制至关重要。然而，由于频繁出现零值，这一工作具有挑战性。挑战因两种类型的零值而加剧：一是作为干燥事件的无降水，二是因检测限导致的未测量降水。在本工作中，我们提出了一种多层时空模型，使我们能够区分和解释这两种零值，并建模超过检测限的正降水。该方法将零值处的点质量与通过概率回归模型化的概率相结合，对潜在的正降水量进行伽马回归，并采用受阈值删失影响的观测机制。为了捕捉空间依赖性，在每个回归模型中采用高斯过程。在贝叶斯框架内工作，我们可以获得具有精确不确定性的丰富推断范围。特别是，我们提供了模型推断工具，以比较和量化真实降水过程与其观测对应物在相关特征上的差异。我们将模型应用于西班牙东北部埃布罗河流域七十个站点十五年的春季每日观测数据分析。我们的研究结果表明，阈值强烈影响观测降水的发生，尤其在湿润地区。虽然其对总累积量的影响较小，但可能对上分位数产生重要影响。

Abstract

Explaining precipitation behavior at daily scale is important for fine scale understanding of the mechanisms driving precipitation. However, this effort is challenging because of the frequent incidence of zeros. The challenge is amplified by the acknowledged incidence of two types of zeros -- absence of precipitation as a dry event and absence of measured precipitation due to detection limits. In this work, we propose a multilevel spatio-temporal model which allows us to distinguish and explain the two types of zeros, as well as to model positive precipitation above the detection limit. The methodology combines a point mass at zero with probability modeled through a probit regression, a Gamma regression for latent positive precipitation amounts, and an observation mechanism subject to threshold-induced censoring. To capture spatial dependencies, Gaussian processes are employed in each regression model. Working within a Bayesian framework, we can obtain a rich range of inference with exact uncertainty. In particular, we provide model-based inference tools to compare and quantify differences between the true precipitation process and its observed counterpart across relevant characteristics. We apply our model to the analysis of daily spring observations at 70 sites over 15 years from the Ebro River Basin in northeastern Spain. Our findings indicate that the threshold strongly affects the occurrence of observed precipitation, especially in humid regions. While its impact on total accumulated amounts is small, it can exert a relevant effect on upper quantiles.

item.title: LiveStarPro: Proactive Streaming Video Understanding with Hierarchical Memory for Long-Horizon Streams
item.author: Zhenyu Yang, Kairui Zhang, Bing Wang, Shengsheng Qian, Changsheng Xu
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为LiveStarPro的直播流媒体助手，旨在解决视频大语言模型在处理连续视频流、自主决定响应时机以及保持长期上下文记忆方面的挑战。

背景: 尽管视频大语言模型取得了显著进展，但当前的在线架构仍难以同时处理连续视频流、自主决定响应时机并保留长期上下文记忆，这影响了实时响应能力并导致在长时间交互中出现严重遗忘。

目的: 设计一个能够主动理解长时域视频流的直播流媒体助手。

方法: LiveStarPro由三个互补组件构成：流式验证解码（SVeD），通过单次通过困惑度验证识别合适的响应时机；流式因果注意力掩码（SCAM），一种训练策略，用于在可变长度流上强制执行增量视频语言对齐；树状分层记忆（TSHM），一种递归记忆架构，将淘汰的历史信息组织成事件链，从而实现从有效无界视频流中高效检索。此外，还提出了OmniStarPro基准测试，涵盖十五种多样化的真实世界场景，并延伸至小时级流以评估长期记忆。

主要发现: 实验表明，LiveStarPro在语义正确性上提高了百分之二十八点九，在时机误差上减少了百分之十八点二，其流式键值缓存使推理速度提升了点五八倍。

结论: LiveStarPro在实时响应和长期记忆保持方面优于现有方法，模型和代码已公开。

翻译: 尽管视频大语言模型取得了显著进展，但当前的在线架构仍难以同时处理连续视频流、自主决定响应时机并保留长期上下文记忆，这影响了实时响应能力并导致在长时间交互中出现严重遗忘。本文提出了一种名为LiveStarPro的直播流媒体助手，旨在解决这一挑战。LiveStarPro由三个互补组件构成：流式验证解码（SVeD），通过单次通过困惑度验证识别合适的响应时机；流式因果注意力掩码（SCAM），一种训练策略，用于在可变长度流上强制执行增量视频语言对齐；树状分层记忆（TSHM），一种递归记忆架构，将淘汰的历史信息组织成事件链，从而实现从有效无界视频流中高效检索。此外，还提出了OmniStarPro基准测试，涵盖十五种多样化的真实世界场景，并延伸至小时级流以评估长期记忆。实验表明，LiveStarPro在语义正确性上提高了百分之二十八点九，在时机误差上减少了百分之十八点二，其流式键值缓存使推理速度提升了点五八倍。LiveStarPro在实时响应和长期记忆保持方面优于现有方法，模型和代码已公开。

Abstract

Despite the remarkable progress of Video Large Language Models (Video-LLMs), current online architectures still struggle to simultaneously process continuous video streams, decide autonomously when to respond, and preserve long-horizon contextual memory. These obstacles undermine real-time responsiveness and cause severe forgetting throughout prolonged interactions. In this work, we introduce LiveStarPro, a live streaming assistant that is designed for proactive video understanding over long-horizon streams. The design of LiveStarPro rests on three complementary components. The first component is Streaming Verification Decoding (SVeD), an inference framework that identifies the appropriate response timing through single-pass perplexity verification, thereby eliminating the dependency on explicit silence tokens. The second component is Streaming Causal Attention Masks (SCAM), a training strategy that enforces incremental video-language alignment over variable-length streams. The third component is Tree-Structured Hierarchical Memory (TSHM), a recursive memory architecture that organizes evicted historical information into event chains and consequently enables efficient retrieval from effectively unbounded video streams. To facilitate a comprehensive evaluation under realistic online conditions, we further present OmniStarPro, a large-scale benchmark that spans 15 diverse real-world scenarios and that extends to hour-scale streams for the assessment of long-term recall. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LiveStarPro consistently surpasses existing methods, attaining a 28.9% improvement in semantic correctness and an 18.2% reduction in timing error, while its streaming key-value cache further yields a 1.58x inference speedup over the same model without caching. The model and the code are publicly available at https://github.com/sotayang/LiveStarPro.

item.title: PhASE-Flow: Phonetic-Conditioned Acoustic Flow Matching in SSL Representation Domain for Speech Enhancement
item.author: Jun Gao, Xiaobin Rong, Yu Sun, Dahan Wang, Jing Lu
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: PhASE-Flow 是一种基于流匹配的语音增强框架，完全在自监督学习空间内运行，通过建模声学表示的条件分布并借助神经声码器重建波形，在感知质量和可懂度上优于现有基线，且仅需四次采样步骤即可实现高效推理。

背景: 流匹配技术能够实现高保真生成，自监督学习语音模型提供涵盖声学及音素层级的分层表示。然而，现有的基于流匹配的语音增强方法主要在频谱域运行，仅将自监督学习特征作为外部条件，而非直接在自监督学习潜在空间中进行建模。

目的: 为了充分利用自监督学习表示的结构丰富性，提出一种完全在自监督学习空间内运行的基于流匹配的语音增强框架。

方法: 提出 PhASE-Flow 框架，该框架完全在自监督学习空间内运行，对给定音素表示的干净声学表示的条件分布进行建模，并通过神经声码器重建波形。

主要发现: 实验表明 PhASE-Flow 在感知质量和可懂度方面优于最先进的基线方法。值得注意的是，它仅需四次采样步骤即可实现具有竞争力的性能，从而支持高度高效的推理。

结论: PhASE-Flow 成功利用自监督学习表示的结构丰富性，实现了高性能且高效的语音增强。

翻译: Flow matching enables high-fidelity generation, while self-supervised learning speech models provide hierarchical representations spanning acoustic and phonetic levels. However, existing FM-based speech enhancement methods operate primarily in the spectral domain, treating SSL features only as external conditions rather than modeling directly in the SSL latent space. To fully exploit the structural richness of SSL representations, we propose PhASE-Flow, an FM-based SE framework that operates entirely in the SSL space. It models the conditional distribution of clean acoustic representations given phonetic ones, reconstructing the waveform via a neural vocoder. Experiments show that PhASE-Flow outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in perceptual quality and intelligibility. Notably, it achieves competitive performance with only four sampling steps, enabling highly efficient inference. Audio demos are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/w/phase-flow_demo-E6E1/.

Abstract

Flow matching (FM) enables high-fidelity generation, while self-supervised learning (SSL) speech models provide hierarchical representations spanning acoustic and phonetic levels. However, existing FM-based speech enhancement (SE) methods operate primarily in the spectral domain, treating SSL features only as external conditions rather than modeling directly in the SSL latent space. To fully exploit the structural richness of SSL representations, we propose PhASE-Flow, an FM-based SE framework that operates entirely in the SSL space. It models the conditional distribution of clean acoustic representations given phonetic ones, reconstructing the waveform via a neural vocoder. Experiments show that PhASE-Flow outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in perceptual quality and intelligibility. Notably, it achieves competitive performance with only four sampling steps, enabling highly efficient inference. Audio demos are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/w/phase-flow_demo-E6E1/.

item.title: Million-scale multimodal pollen microscopy with expert-guided foundation models
item.author: András Biricz, Björn Gedda, Donát Magyar, Antonio Spanu, János Fillinger, Péter Pollner, István Csabai
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了Pollen AI Atlas，一个包含百万级多模态花粉显微图像的资源，旨在解决花粉自动识别的瓶颈问题。该资源包含来自四个地理来源、四种扫描仪设置和四十六个分类标签的纯物种全切片明场图像。通过标记级挖掘和过滤，生成了超过一百五十万的花粉颗粒检测，并提供了机器生成的形态学描述。实验表明，该资源在花粉识别和跨区域域适应方面具有基准价值。

背景: 从显微镜图像中自动识别花粉在气相生物学、古生态学和生物多样性监测中仍然是一个瓶颈，因为可扩展的系统必须能够泛化不同标本制备、扫描仪设置和地理来源，同时保持花粉学可解释性。

目的: 解决上述瓶颈问题，提供一个可扩展且保持花粉学可解释性的花粉识别系统。

方法: 构建了Pollen AI Atlas资源，包含来自四个地理来源、四种扫描仪设置和四十六个分类标签的纯物种全切片明场图像。通过标记级挖掘和过滤生成花粉颗粒检测，并使用五个开源视觉语言模型生成机器形态学描述，结合专家验证的花粉学锚点。

主要发现: 生成的检测在专家策展的测试区域中达到了百分之九十九点六的提案精度。Gemma4模型提供了最受控的主要描述集，具有严格的长度控制、无泄漏和最强的文本检索性能。基线基准测试达到了百分之八十八点一六的top-1准确率。跨区域检索显示，当图像相似度下降时，基于描述的文本嵌入仍然稳健。

结论: 释放的数据、注释、描述、划分、代码和权重为花粉识别、跨区域域适应和特定领域的多模态显微学习提供了基准。

翻译: Automated pollen identification from microscopy remains a bottleneck in aerobiology, palaeoecology and biodiversity monitoring, because scalable systems must generalise across specimen preparation, scanner settings and geographic origins while retaining palynological interpretability. To address this gap, we present a million-scale multimodal pollen microscopy resource, Pollen AI Atlas, assembled from pure-species whole-slide bright-field images spanning four geographic origins, four scanner settings and 46 taxon labels across 31 botanical families. Seeded by one manually selected exemplar per source slide, token-level mining and filtering produced 1,511,390 released grain detections with 99.6% proposal precision in expert-curated test regions. Each detection was paired with machine-generated grain-level morphological captions from five open-weight vision-language models, guided by expert-verified palynological anchors, yielding structured descriptions of aperture systems, wall ornamentation, shape and size. Among the evaluated models, Gemma4 provided the most controlled primary caption set, combining tight length control, no leakage and the strongest text-retrieval performance. Baseline benchmarks with frozen visual features reached 88.16% top-1 accuracy, while cross-regional retrieval showed that caption-derived text embeddings remained robust when image similarity degraded (mAP@20 0.811 versus 0.262). Released data, annotations, captions, splits, code, and weights provide a benchmark for pollen recognition, cross-regional domain adaptation and domain-specific multimodal microscopy learning.

Abstract

Automated pollen identification from microscopy remains a bottleneck in aerobiology, palaeoecology and biodiversity monitoring, because scalable systems must generalise across specimen preparation, scanner settings and geographic origins while retaining palynological interpretability. To address this gap, we present a million-scale multimodal pollen microscopy resource, Pollen AI Atlas, assembled from pure-species whole-slide bright-field images spanning four geographic origins, four scanner settings and 46 taxon labels across 31 botanical families. Seeded by one manually selected exemplar per source slide, token-level mining and filtering produced 1,511,390 released grain detections with 99.6\% proposal precision in expert-curated test regions. Each detection was paired with machine-generated grain-level morphological captions from five open-weight vision-language models, guided by expert-verified palynological anchors, yielding structured descriptions of aperture systems, wall ornamentation, shape and size. Among the evaluated models, Gemma4 provided the most controlled primary caption set, combining tight length control, no leakage and the strongest text-retrieval performance. Baseline benchmarks with frozen visual features reached 88.16\% top-1 accuracy, while cross-regional retrieval showed that caption-derived text embeddings remained robust when image similarity degraded (mAP@20 0.811 versus 0.262). Released data, annotations, captions, splits, code, and weights provide a benchmark for pollen recognition, cross-regional domain adaptation and domain-specific multimodal microscopy learning.

item.title: Qwen-RobotManip Technical Report: Alignment Unlocks Scale for Robotic Manipulation Foundation Models
item.author: Haoqi Yuan, Zhixuan Liang, Anzhe Chen, Ye Wang, Haoyang Li, Pei Lin, Yiyang Huang, Zixing Lei, Tong Zhang, Jiazhao Zhang, Jie Zhang, Jingyang Fan, Gengze Zhou, Qihang Peng, Chenxu Lv, Xiaoyue Chen, An Yang, Fei Huang, Junyang Lin, Dayiheng Liu, Jingren Zhou, Chenfei Wu, Xiong-Hui Chen
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: Qwen-RobotManip 是一个基于 Qwen-VL 的可泛化视觉-语言-动作基础模型，通过统一的对齐框架和大规模多源训练，实现了在机器人操作任务中的真正泛化能力，并在多个开放域设置和真实机器人平台上显著优于现有最先进模型。

背景: 语言和 multimodal 基础模型通过在统一框架下对齐异构数据并进行大规模训练，实现了强大的泛化能力。然而，将这种扩展方法应用于机器人操作面临挑战，因为操作数据具有天然的异构性、收集成本高且多样性有限，使得同时实现对齐和扩展变得困难。

目的: investigate 是否可以将语言和 multimodal 基础模型的扩展配方应用于机器人操作，以实现真正的泛化能力。

方法: 提出 Qwen-RobotManip 模型，引入跨表示、运动和行为的统一对齐框架，使大规模多源训练保持一致。通过人类到机器人的合成管道将第一人称手部演示转换为跨 15 个平台的机器人轨迹，并通过严格的策展管道协调异构数据集。仅使用开源数据集和人类视频，构建了约 38,100 小时的预训练语料库。

主要发现: Qwen-RobotManip 展现出涌现的泛化能力，包括零样本指令遵循、对扰动的鲁棒性、反应性错误恢复和跨形态转移。标准基准测试无法捕捉预训练质量，因此采用包括 RoboCasa365、LIBERO-Plus、EBench、RoboTwin-Clean2Rand、RoboTwin-IF 和 RoboTwin-XE 在内的开放域设置进行评估。Qwen-RobotManip 在所有开放域设置中显著优于包括 π0.5 在内的现有最先进模型，在 RoboChallenge 中排名第一，相对提升 20%，并在 AgileX ALOHA、Franka、UR 和 ARX 等真实机器人平台上得到验证。

结论: Qwen-RobotManip 通过统一对齐框架和大规模预训练，成功将基础模型的扩展方法应用于机器人操作，实现了显著的泛化能力和性能提升，为机器人操作领域提供了新的基础模型范式。

翻译: Qwen-RobotManip 是一个基于 Qwen-VL 的可泛化视觉-语言-动作基础模型，通过统一的对齐框架和大规模多源训练，实现了在机器人操作任务中的真正泛化能力，并在多个开放域设置和真实机器人平台上显著优于现有最先进模型。

Abstract

Foundation models in language and multimodality achieve strong generalization by aligning heterogeneous data under a unified formulation and training at scale. In this report, we investigate whether this scaling recipe can be applied to robotic manipulation to achieve genuine generalization. This is challenging because, unlike text, manipulation data is heterogeneous by nature, expensive to collect, and narrow in diversity, making alignment and scale simultaneously difficult. We present Qwen-RobotManip, a generalizable Vision-Language-Action foundation model built on Qwen-VL. Qwen-RobotManip introduces a unified alignment framework across the representation, motion, and behavioral dimensions of manipulation, making large-scale multi-source training coherent rather than conflicting. This alignment capability in turn enables Qwen-RobotManip to absorb manipulation data at a scale that prior training regimes could not sustain. A human-to-robot synthesis pipeline converts egocentric hand demonstrations into robot trajectories across 15 platforms, and a rigorous curation pipeline harmonizes heterogeneous datasets. Using only open-source datasets and human videos without proprietary data collection, Qwen-RobotManip constructs a ~38,100-hour pretraining corpus and exhibits emergent generalization capabilities, including zero-shot instruction following, robustness to perturbations, reactive error recovery, and cross-embodiment transfer. We find that standard benchmarks fail to capture pretraining quality and instead adopt OOD settings including RoboCasa365, LIBERO-Plus, EBench, RoboTwin-Clean2Rand, RoboTwin-IF, and RoboTwin-XE. Qwen-RobotManip substantially outperforms prior state-of-the-art models, including $π$0.5, across all OOD settings, ranks 1st in RoboChallenge with a 20% relative improvement, and is validated on real-robot platforms including AgileX ALOHA, Franka, UR, and ARX.

item.title: ChLogic: Evaluating Robustness of Logical Reasoning in Chinese Expressions
item.author: Zhou, Peixian, Chen, Yuxu, Zhang, Chaorui, Han, Wei, Bai, Bo, Niu, Xueyan
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: ChLogic基准测试揭示了大型语言模型在跨语言逻辑推理中的性能差异，指出中文表面实现、翻译 artifacts 和模型特定行为共同影响多语言逻辑推理能力。

背景: 大型语言模型在标准化逻辑推理基准测试中表现越来越好，但其在英语之外的能力是否稳健尚不清楚。

目的: 测试模型在相同潜在逻辑结构下，用英语和不同中文表面实现表达时是否能保持逻辑推理性能。

方法: 构建ChLogic基准，包含三个数据集：通用对齐集、困难对齐集和仅中文集，每个对齐项包含一个英语参考表达和五个中文实现。

主要发现: 在Qwen3、Ministral和GLM模型上实验发现存在持续的英语-中文性能差距；回译到英语通常改善通用对齐集性能，但在困难对齐集上效果不一，部分模型性能下降。

结论: ChLogic为多语言推理的稳健性提供了有用的压力测试。

翻译: unknown

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要想解决大语言模型在中文复杂表达下是否仍能保持与英文一致的逻辑推理能力的问题。该问题在研究中非常重要，因为现有基准多依赖英文和固定模板，无法反映中文特有的修辞、省略和语用特征对逻辑结构识别的挑战。评估这一能力有助于揭示模型在多语言环境下的真实推理短板，推动更鲁棒的跨语言人工智能系统的发展。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者采用模板优先的工作流进行设计，在固定底层逻辑结构和标准答案的前提下，生成多种中英文表面表达形式，以检验模型在不同语言和句式下的推理一致性。该方法借鉴并扩展了现有的单语鲁棒性测试思路，同时整合了已有逻辑推理基准中广泛使用的逻辑形式，并针对中文特有的语言现象进行了补充。整体设计旨在通过控制变量来诊断多语言模型在表面表达变化时的推理稳健性。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是通过构建中英对齐的逻辑推理基准，检验大模型在底层逻辑结构不变的情况下，面对不同语言表面表达形式时能否维持一致的推理能力。整体流程首先设计形式化逻辑模板并规划数据集，随后利用大语言模型将同一逻辑内容转化为一个英文参考句和多个中文变体，最后通过规则检查与人工审核进行严格的质量控制，确保逻辑标签不变的同时系统增加语言复杂度，从而评估模型的跨语言推理鲁棒性。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于构建了首个中英对齐的逻辑推理基准测试集。与以往主要依赖英语且句式模板化的评测集不同，该工作固定底层逻辑结构，系统引入口语、反问、习语等多样化的中文自然表达，并专门设计了涵盖中文特有语言现象的纯中文子集。这使得评测能更真实地检验大模型在跨语言和复杂中文语境下还原逻辑结构的能力，而非仅测试对显式连接词的识别。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文构建了中英对齐的逻辑推理基准测试，通过对比同一逻辑结构在不同语言表面表达下的模型表现，系统评估了大语言模型的多语言推理鲁棒性，并揭示了中文表达差异与翻译过程对推理准确率的显著影响。

Abstract

Large language models perform increasingly well on standardized logical reasoning benchmarks, but whether this ability remains robust beyond English is unclear. We introduce ChLogic, an English--Chinese aligned benchmark that tests whether models preserve logical reasoning performance when the same latent logical structure is expressed in English and diverse Chinese surface realizations. Built from formal logical templates, the benchmark contains three data sets: (i) the General aligned set, derived from 60 General Propositions across nine template families; (ii) the Difficult aligned set, derived from 40 Difficult Problems; and (iii) the Chinese-only set, covering 15 language-specific phenomenon types. Each aligned item pairs one English reference expression with five Chinese realizations. Experiments on Qwen3, Ministral, and GLM models reveal a persistent English--Chinese performance gap. Back-translation from standard Chinese into English often improves performance on the General aligned set, but produces mixed effects on the Difficult aligned set, where Qwen3-32B and GLM-5.1 perform worse after translation. These results indicate that Chinese surface realization, translation artifacts, and model-specific behavior jointly affect multilingual logical reasoning. Overall, ChLogic provides a useful stress test for the robustness of multilingual reasoning.

item.title: Learning task-specific subspaces via interventional post-training of speech foundation models
item.author: Jack Cox, Jon Barker
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该研究提出了一种基于干预对比学习的后训练优化方法，旨在将语音基础模型中表示内容与说话人信息的纠缠表示空间分离为独立的内容子空间和说话人子空间。

背景: 语音基础模型在大量未标记语音数据上预训练，能够生成适用于多种任务的通用表示。然而，这些表示以分布式方式编码了显著的语音变量信息，而下游语音任务通常只依赖于其中的一部分变量信息。

目的: 将语音基础模型中纠缠的表示空间分离为独立的内容子空间和说话人子空间，以解决下游任务仅依赖部分变量信息的问题。

方法: 提出一种基于干预对比学习的后训练优化方法，利用干预数据集和多部分对比损失函数，学习从纠缠表示空间到独立子空间的转换。

主要发现: 在说话人验证和关键词识别任务上评估了学习到的表示，发现跨域说话人验证性能得到提升，并且证据表明内容和说话人信息在所学子空间中实现了分离。

结论: 通过干预对比学习成功分离了语音基础模型中的内容与说话人信息，提升了模型在下游任务中的泛化能力和信息解耦效果。

翻译: Speech foundation models, pre-trained on large corpora of unlabelled speech data, produce general-purpose representations which are useful across tasks. However, these representations encode information about salient speech variables in a distributed manner, while downstream speech tasks rely on only some of this variability. In this work, we propose a post-training refinement approach using interventional contrastive learning. By leveraging an interventional dataset and multi-part contrastive loss, we learn a transformation from the entangled representation space of speech foundation models into separate content and speaker subspaces. We evaluate the learnt representations on speaker verification and keyword spotting tasks, showing improved out-of-domain speaker verification performance and evidence that speaker and content information are separated across the learned subspaces.

Abstract

Speech foundation models, pre-trained on large corpora of unlabelled speech data, produce general-purpose representations which are useful across tasks. However, these representations encode information about salient speech variables in a distributed manner, while downstream speech tasks rely on only some of this variability. In this work, we propose a post-training refinement approach using interventional contrastive learning. By leveraging an interventional dataset and multi-part contrastive loss, we learn a transformation from the entangled representation space of speech foundation models into separate content and speaker subspaces. We evaluate the learnt representations on speaker verification and keyword spotting tasks, showing improved out-of-domain speaker verification performance and evidence that speaker and content information are separated across the learned subspaces.

item.title: MoCo-AIS: A Contrastive Learning Framework for Similarity Computation of Vessel Trajectories
item.author: Ruixin Song, Md Mahbub Alam, Zahra Sadeghi, Amilcar Soares, José F. Rodrigues-Jr, Gabriel Spadon
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种基于动量对比范式的统一框架，用于学习船舶轨迹嵌入，通过正负轨迹对构建相似性学习，并在大规模真实船舶自动识别系统数据集上评估了多种深度学习模型，显著提升了相似性学习效果，同时为轨迹表示模型提供了基准测试平台。

背景: 轨迹相似性是分析移动模式的基础任务，对路径模式提取、移动预测和异常检测等应用至关重要。传统的基于距离的相似性计算方法计算成本高，促使人们采用轻量级的学习方法。监督方法依赖大量基于传统距离度量的标签，往往复现这些度量，限制了泛化能力。自监督学习通过对比学习解决了这一问题，但缺乏统一框架，难以对深度学习模型进行一致的轨迹表示比较。

目的: 提出一个统一的框架，用于学习船舶轨迹嵌入，以解决现有自监督学习方法缺乏统一框架、难以比较深度学习模型一致轨迹表示的问题。

方法: 提出名为MoCo-AIS的统一框架，基于动量对比范式，通过构建正负轨迹对来 formulate 相似性学习。在该框架内，评估了多种领先的深度学习模型在大规模真实船舶自动识别系统数据集上的表现，该数据集捕捉了多样的导航行为和操作条件。

主要发现: 该框架在相似性学习方面显著优于现有基线方法。

结论: MoCo-AIS框架不仅显著提升了轨迹相似性学习效果，还为评估轨迹表示模型提供了一个基准测试平台。

翻译: Trajectory similarity is a fundamental task in analyzing mobility patterns, essential for applications such as route pattern extraction, mobility prediction, and anomaly detection. Traditional distance-based measures for computing similarity incur high computational cost, driving the adoption of lightweight learning-based approaches. Supervised methods rely on extensive labels derived from traditional distance measures and often reproduce these metrics, which limits generalization. While self-supervised learning addresses this issue through contrastive learning, it lacks a unified framework, making it difficult to compare deep learning (DL) models for consistent trajectory representation. Accordingly, this paper presents MoCo-AIS, a unified framework for learning vessel trajectory embeddings based on the Momentum Contrast (MoCo) paradigm, which formulates similarity learning through positive and negative trajectory pairs. Within this framework, we evaluate a diverse set of leading DL models on large-scale, real-world vessel-tracking AIS datasets that capture diverse navigation behaviors and operating conditions. Results demonstrate that our framework significantly improves similarity learning over existing baselines, while providing a benchmarking platform for evaluating trajectory representation models.

Abstract

Trajectory similarity is a fundamental task in analyzing mobility patterns, essential for applications such as route pattern extraction, mobility prediction, and anomaly detection. Traditional distance-based measures for computing similarity incur high computational cost, driving the adoption of lightweight learning-based approaches. Supervised methods rely on extensive labels derived from traditional distance measures and often reproduce these metrics, which limits generalization. While self-supervised learning addresses this issue through contrastive learning, it lacks a unified framework, making it difficult to compare deep learning (DL) models for consistent trajectory representation. Accordingly, this paper presents MoCo-AIS, a unified framework for learning vessel trajectory embeddings based on the Momentum Contrast (MoCo) paradigm, which formulates similarity learning through positive and negative trajectory pairs. Within this framework, we evaluate a diverse set of leading DL models on large-scale, real-world vessel-tracking AIS datasets that capture diverse navigation behaviors and operating conditions. Results demonstrate that our framework significantly improves similarity learning over existing baselines, while providing a benchmarking platform for evaluating trajectory representation models.

item.title: Half a Link can Be Enough to Predict a Whole Link: Understanding Generalization in Knowledge Graph Foundation Models
item.author: Cosimo Gregucci, Obaidah Theeb, Daniel Hernandez, Antonio Vergari, Steffen Staab
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 知识图谱基础模型在未见过的图谱上预测链接时，其性能在部分可见链接上并不均匀。

背景: 知识图谱基础模型是零样本泛化器，训练一次即可预测未见图谱上的链接，但其在不同图谱上稳健泛化的条件和机制尚不明确。

目的: 揭示知识图谱基础模型的泛化机制，特别是其在部分可见链接上的性能表现。

方法: 提出一种基于半链接（即三元组中的头实体关系或关系尾实体）观察情况的四分法分类体系，并对该分类体系进行严格的分层分析。

主要发现: 当前最先进的知识图谱基础模型在预测时依赖于已观察到的半链接，而未观察到的半链接则带来不同的挑战。

结论: 这种细粒度的分类体系可作为诊断知识图谱基础模型稳健泛化的协议，并指出了新型模型需要改进的方向。

翻译: Knowledge graph foundation models are zero-shot generalizers that can predict links on unseen graphs without retraining. However, understanding their robust generalization across different knowledge graphs remains an open question. This paper investigates their generalization mechanisms, focusing on partially seen links called half-links. The authors propose a taxonomy of four scenarios based on the observation of these half-links and conduct a rigorous stratified analysis. They find that state-of-the-art models rely on seen half-links for predictions, while unseen half-links pose different challenges. This finer-grained taxonomy serves as a diagnostic protocol for robust generalization and highlights areas for improvement in novel models.

Abstract

Knowledge graph (KG) foundation models (KGFMs) are zero-shot generalizers: trained once, they can predict links on unseen graphs without retraining. However, understanding when and how they can robustly generalize across KGs is still an open question. In this paper, we shed some light on their generalization mechanisms highlighting how their performance on unseen KGs is not uniform when it comes to partially seen links, which we call half-links. In fact, we show that to predict a test triple $(h,r,t)$ it might suffice in practice to have observed the half-link $(h,r)$ or $(r,t)$ in the inference graph. This yields a taxonomy of four scenarios when combinations of these half-links are observed or not. In a rigorous stratified analysis over these scenarios, we reveal that SoTA KGFMs use seen half links for predictions, while unseen half-links pose different challenges. As such, our finer-grained taxonomy can be a diagnostic protocol for robust KGFM generalization and highlights where novel KGFMs can improve.

item.title: LoopCoder-v2: Only Loop Once for Efficient Test-Time Computation Scaling
item.author: Yang, Jian, Guo, Shawn, Zhang, Wei, Zheng, Tianyu, Du, Yaxin, Li, Haau-Sing, Wu, Jiajun, Song, Yue, Xing, Yan, Cai, Qingsong, Huang, Zelong, Hao, Chuan, Tao, Ran, Liu, Xianglong, Zhao, Wayne Xin, Tang, Mingjie, Lv, Weifeng, Zhou, Ming, Dai, Bryan
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文研究了并行循环Transformer中循环次数的选择问题，通过增益与成本的视角分析了循环次数对模型性能的影响。

背景: 循环Transformer通过重复应用共享块来扩展潜在计算，但顺序循环会增加延迟和KV缓存内存。并行循环Transformer通过跨循环位置偏移和共享键值门控滑动窗口注意力缓解了这些成本，使得循环次数成为实际的设计选择。

目的: 研究并行循环Transformer中循环次数的选择，分析额外循环带来的表示细化增益与跨循环位置偏移引入的位置不匹配成本之间的权衡。

方法: 训练了不同循环次数的七百亿参数并行循环代码生成模型家族，在一万八千亿个token上从头训练，并进行匹配指令调优和评估。

主要发现: 双循环变体在代码生成、代码推理、代理软件工程和使用工具基准测试中广泛优于非循环基线，显著提升了SWE-bench Verified和Multi-SWE的分数。而三圈或更多圈的变体则出现性能下降，揭示了循环次数效应的强非单调性。诊断显示，第二圈提供了主要的生产性细化，而后续循环产生收益递减、振荡更新和表示多样性降低。由于跨循环位置偏移引起的不匹配大致固定，随着细化收益的缩小，偏移成本越来越占主导地位。

结论: 增益与成本的权衡解释了并行循环Transformer在两个循环处饱和的原因，并为循环次数的选择提供了诊断依据。

翻译: Looped Transformers scale latent computation by repeatedly applying shared blocks, but sequential looping increases latency and KV-cache memory with the loop count. Parallel loop Transformers (PLT) alleviate this cost through cross-loop position offsets (CLP) and shared-KV gated sliding-window attention, making loop count a practical design choice. We therefore study PLT loop-count selection through a gain--cost view: an extra loop may refine representations, but CLP also introduces a positional mismatch at each loop boundary. We instantiate this study by training LoopCoder-v2, a family of 7B PLT coders with different loop counts, from scratch on 18T tokens, followed by matched instruction tuning and evaluation. Empirically, the two-loop variant delivers broad gains over the non-looped baseline across code generation, code reasoning, agentic software engineering, and tool-use benchmarks, improving SWE-bench Verified from 43.0 to 64.4 points and Multi-SWE from 14.0 to 31.0 points. In contrast, variants with three or more loops regress, revealing a strongly non-monotonic loop-count effect. Our diagnostics show that loop 2 provides the main productive refinement, while later loops yield diminishing, oscillatory updates and reduced representational diversity. Because the CLP-induced mismatch remains roughly fixed as refinement gains shrink, the offset cost increasingly dominates. This gain--cost trade-off explains PLT's saturation at two loops and provides diagnostics for loop-count selection.

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要研究如何为并行循环语言模型选择最优的推理循环次数，以平衡额外循环带来的内部优化收益与跨循环位置偏移引入的结构成本。该问题在研究和工程中非常重要，因为传统串行循环会随循环次数线性增加运行延迟和内存占用，而并行循环虽解决了效率瓶颈，但循环次数过多反而会导致模型性能下降。明确最优循环次数有助于在有限计算资源下最大化模型的代码生成与推理能力，推动高效测试时计算扩展的实际应用。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者针对传统循环推理延迟高、内存占用大的问题，借鉴了并行循环Transformer的现有架构，利用跨循环位置偏移和共享缓存机制实现高效并行计算。在方法设计上，他们将循环次数的选择视为收益与成本的权衡，即额外循环能细化模型内部表征，但位置偏移会引入固定的错位成本。为此，他们从零开始训练不同循环次数的模型，并通过分析内部状态动态与注意力演化规律，最终确定了性能最优的循环设置。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是通过重复调用同一组网络参数进行多次隐式计算来提升推理能力，同时利用并行技术消除传统串行循环的延迟与内存瓶颈，并在“表征优化收益”与“位置错位成本”之间寻求平衡，最终确定两次循环为最优配置。整体实现流程包括使用海量混合文本与代码数据从零训练模型，采用共享首轮缓存与跨循环位置偏移技术实现并行计算，随后进行统一的指令微调，并在推理阶段固定执行两次循环以完成代码生成与推理任务。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于提出了一种评估循环次数的增益与成本权衡视角，并通过内部状态诊断发现第二次循环能带来主要优化，而更多循环会因位置错位导致收益递减。相比以往串行循环模型随循环次数增加而显著升高延迟和内存占用的问题，该工作通过并行机制大幅降低了计算成本。同时，论文系统揭示了循环次数过多反而损害性能的内在原因，并训练了不同循环次数的七百亿参数代码模型，实证证明双循环版本在多项基准上表现最佳。

Empirically, the two-loop variant delivers broad gains over the non-looped baseline across code generation, code reasoning, agentic software engineering, and tool-use benchmarks, improving SWE-bench Verified from 43.0 to 64.4 points and Multi-SWE from 14.0 to 31.0 points. In contrast, variants with three or more loops regress, revealing a strongly non-monotonic loop-count effect. Our diagnostics show that loop 2 provides the main productive refinement, while later loops yield diminishing, oscillatory updates and reduced representational diversity. Because the CLP-induced mismatch remains roughly fixed as refinement gains shrink, the offset cost increasingly dominates. item.title: Predicting Immune Biomarkers with MultiModal Mixture-of-Expert Pathology Foundation Models Empowers Precision Oncology
item.author: Tianyu Liu, Ziqing Wang, Zhaokang Liang, Tong Ding, Peter Humphrey, Lorraine Colón-Cartagena, Emily Ling-Lin Pai, Kenneth Tou En Chang, Mohamed Kahila, Jonathan Chong Kai Liew, Tinglin Huang, Rex Ying, Kaize Ding, Faisal Mahmood, Wengong Jin
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了一种名为MixTIME的多模态基础模型，该模型利用混合专家架构整合了不同模态的病理基础模型，用于从苏木精和伊红全切片图像预测多重免疫荧光蛋白表达。

背景: 预测与肿瘤免疫微环境相关的免疫生物标志物对推进精准肿瘤学至关重要，但现有方法主要局限于单图像模态，存在分辨率不足和未能充分利用互补临床和生物学信息的问题。

目的: 开发一种能够整合多模态信息、提高预测精度并支持下游临床任务的多模态基础模型。

方法: 引入MixTIME模型，采用混合专家架构，整合仅图像、图像文本和图像转录组表示的病理基础模型，使用可学习路由器动态加权专家贡献，并采用分布和趋势感知损失函数进行训练。

主要发现: MixTIME在两个不同规模的数据集上实现了17种蛋白标志物的最先进性能，预测的多重免疫荧光谱显著提升了空间域识别、生存预测和AI辅助病理报告生成等下游任务，并实现了跨临床时间点的蛋白表达动态纵向追踪，揭示了与耐药性和免疫抑制相关的蛋白基因相互作用模式。

结论: MixTIME为计算病理学中的多模态生物标志物发现和临床转化提供了一个可扩展的框架。

翻译: Predicting immune biomarkers associated with the tumor immune microenvironment (TIME) is critical for advancing precision oncology, yet existing approaches are largely limited to single image modalities and suffer from insufficient resolution and incomplete utilization of complementary clinical and biological information. Here we introduce MixTIME, a multimodal foundation model that leverages a mixture-of-experts (MoE) architecture to integrate pathology foundation models trained across distinct modalities: image only (UNIv2), image text (CONCHv1.5), and image transcriptomic (STPath) representations for pixel-level and slide-level prediction of multiplex immunofluorescence (mIF) protein expression from hematoxylin and eosin (HE) whole-slide images. MixTIME employs a learnable router to dynamically weight expert contributions and is trained with a distribution- and tendency-aware loss function. Benchmarked on two datasets of different scales, MixTIME achieves state-of-the-art performance across 17 protein markers as measured by correlation metrics. The predicted mIF profiles substantially enhance downstream tasks, including spatial domain identification, survival prediction, and AI-assisted pathology report generation validated by expert pathologists from multiple institutes across the world. Furthermore, MixTIME enables longitudinal tracking of protein expression dynamics across clinical time points and reveals protein gene interaction patterns linked to drug resistance and immune suppression in tumor microenvironments. Collectively, MixTIME provides a scalable framework for multimodal biomarker discovery and clinical translation in computational pathology.

Abstract

Predicting immune biomarkers associated with the tumor immune microenvironment (TIME) is critical for advancing precision oncology, yet existing approaches are largely limited to single image modalities and suffer from insufficient resolution and incomplete utilization of complementary clinical and biological information. Here we introduce MixTIME, a multimodal foundation model that leverages a mixture-of-experts (MoE) architecture to integrate pathology foundation models trained across distinct modalities: image only (UNIv2), image text (CONCHv1.5), and image transcriptomic (STPath) representations for pixel-level and slide-level prediction of multiplex immunofluorescence (mIF) protein expression from hematoxylin and eosin (HE) whole-slide images. MixTIME employs a learnable router to dynamically weight expert contributions and is trained with a distribution- and tendency-aware loss function. Benchmarked on two datasets of different scales, MixTIME achieves state-of-the-art performance across 17 protein markers as measured by correlation metrics. The predicted mIF profiles substantially enhance downstream tasks, including spatial domain identification, survival prediction, and AI-assisted pathology report generation validated by expert pathologists from multiple institutes across the world. Furthermore, MixTIME enables longitudinal tracking of protein expression dynamics across clinical time points and reveals protein gene interaction patterns linked to drug resistance and immune suppression in tumor microenvironments. Collectively, MixTIME provides a scalable framework for multimodal biomarker discovery and clinical translation in computational pathology.

item.title: WEQA: Wearable hEalth Question Answering with Query-Adaptive Agentic Reasoning
item.author: Yuwei Zhang, Tong Xia, Bianca Emmerich, Yu Yvonne Wu, Dimitris Spathis, Xin Liu, Daniel McDuff, Cecilia Mascolo
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为WEQA的查询自适应智能体框架，该框架将大型语言模型的推理能力与专门的可穿戴设备分析和建模工具相结合，以解决可穿戴健康数据问答的挑战。

背景: 可穿戴健康传感器产生连续、高维和纵向数据，这些数据与大型语言模型预训练中的文本中心分布对齐困难，且传感器模态和用户意图的多样性使得固定推理流程或单一预训练基础模型难以有效处理。

目的: 解决可穿戴健康数据问答中数据对齐困难、模态多样性及用户意图复杂性等问题，提高问答准确性和实用性。

方法: 提出WEQA框架，使用大型语言模型控制器综合执行计划，动态将每个查询路由到合适的传感器分析和预训练模型组合，并通过外部知识进行响应审计。同时，构建了涵盖四个开放可穿戴数据集的基准测试，包含三个健康领域的分析和预测任务。

主要发现: 实验表明，该框架比大型语言模型和智能体基线准确率高出百分之二十四，盲测研究显示其在有用性和临床合理性方面具有显著提升。

结论: WEQA框架有效提升了可穿戴健康数据问答的准确性和实用性，为处理复杂可穿戴数据提供了新的解决方案。

翻译: Language models are remarkably capable at medical question answering, in some cases surpassing the accuracy of general physicians. However, answering questions about wearable health data remains challenging and understudied, as these ubiquitous sensors produce continuous, high-dimensional, and longitudinal data, which is non-trivial to align with text-centric distributions in LLM pretraining. The diversity of sensor modalities and user intents cannot be effectively handled by a fixed reasoning workflow or a single pretrained foundation model. To address these challenges, we propose WEQA, a query-adaptive agent framework that unifies LLM reasoning with specialized wearable analytical and modeling tools. An LLM controller is employed to synthesize execution plans and dynamically route each query to the appropriate combination of sensor analysis and pretrained models, and perform grounded response auditing with external knowledge. We also curate a benchmark spanning four open wearable datasets comprising analytic and predictive tasks in three different health domains. Experiments show that our framework is 24% more accurate than LLM and agentic baselines, and a blinded study with 12 medical experts and 8 users shows substantial gains in usefulness and clinical soundness.

Abstract

Language models are remarkably capable at medical question answering, in some cases surpassing the accuracy of general physicians. However, answering questions about wearable health data remains challenging and understudied, as these ubiquitous sensors produce continuous, high-dimensional, and longitudinal data, which is non-trivial to align with text-centric distributions in LLM pretraining. The diversity of sensor modalities and user intents cannot be effectively handled by a fixed reasoning workflow or a single pretrained foundation model. To address these challenges, we propose WEQA, a query-adaptive agent framework that unifies LLM reasoning with specialized wearable analytical and modeling tools. An LLM controller is employed to synthesize execution plans and dynamically route each query to the appropriate combination of sensor analysis and pretrained models, and perform grounded response auditing with external knowledge. We also curate a benchmark spanning four open wearable datasets comprising analytic and predictive tasks in three different health domains. Experiments show that our framework is 24% more accurate than LLM and agentic baselines, and a blinded study with 12 medical experts and 8 users shows substantial gains in usefulness and clinical soundness.

item.title: Learning from the Self-future: On-policy Self-distillation for dLLMs
item.author: Luo, Yifu, Chen, Zeyu, Wang, Haoyu, Hu, Xinhao, Zhang, Yuxuan, Sha, Zhizhou, Liu, Shiwei
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种针对扩散语言模型的在线策略自蒸馏框架，通过重构自教师构建和训练监督方式，显著提升了模型在推理任务中的性能与样本效率。

背景: 在线策略自蒸馏在大型语言模型的后训练中已被证明有效，但其在扩散语言模型中的应用尚未探索。现有的在线策略自蒸馏方法以自回归为中心，通过从左到右的前缀条件注入特权信息，这与扩散语言模型的任意顺序生成特性存在根本冲突。

目的: 开发一种专门针对扩散语言模型的在线策略自蒸馏框架，以解决现有方法在生成顺序和训练监督上的不匹配问题。

方法: 提出了一种名为扩散在线策略自蒸馏的新框架。首先，通过将自生成的答案作为后缀条件来重构自教师构建，使学生模型能够从“自我未来经验”中学习而非特权前缀。其次，将监督从词元级别转移到步骤级别，以匹配扩散语言模型的迭代去噪过程。

主要发现: 在四个推理基准测试中，该框架 consistently 优于强化学习验证和直接监督微调基线，具有更高的样本效率，仅需强化学习验证约百分之十的优化步骤。

结论: 该框架为扩散语言模型的后训练开辟了一条有前景的途径。

Abstract

On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) has proven effective for post-training large language models (LLMs), yet its application to diffusion LLMs (dLLMs) remains unexplored. Existing OPSD methods are inherently autoregressive-centric. They inject privileged information via left-to-right prefix conditioning with token-level divergence supervision, a design that fundamentally conflicts with the arbitraryorder generation of dLLMs. We introduce d-OPSD, the first OPSD framework tailored for dLLMs. Our approach makes two core contributions. First, we reframe self-teacher construction by using self-generated answers as suffix conditioning, enabling the student model to learn from "self future-experience" rather than privileged prefixes. Second, we shift supervision from token-level to step-level, aligning training with the iterative denoising process of dLLMs. Experiments across four reasoning benchmarks show that d-OPSD consistently outperforms RLVR and SFT baselines with superior sample efficiency, requiring only around 10% of the optimization steps by RLVR and opening a promising pathway for dLLM posttraining. The code is available at this https URL .

item.title: Looped World Models
item.author: Lu, Hongyuan Adam, Wei, Z. L. item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为循环世界模型的新架构，通过迭代细化潜在环境状态，解决了世界模型在长时域模拟中面临的深度计算与部署成本及误差累积之间的张力问题。

背景: 当前世界模型面临一个根本性的矛盾：忠实进行长时域模拟需要深度计算，但更深的模型部署成本高昂且容易累积误差。

目的: 解决世界模型在长时域模拟中深度计算需求与模型部署成本及误差累积之间的矛盾。

方法: 引入循环世界模型架构，使用参数共享的变换器块迭代细化潜在环境状态，并采用自适应计算机制自动根据预测步骤的复杂度调整深度。

主要发现: 该方法在参数效率上比传统方法提高了高达一百倍，并确立了迭代潜在深度作为世界模拟的新扩展维度。

结论: 循环世界模型通过建立迭代潜在深度这一新的扩展轴，有望显著推动世界模拟领域的发展。

翻译: Current world models face a fundamental tension: faithful long-horizon simulation demands deep computation, but deeper models are expensive to deploy and prone to compounding errors. We resolve this by introducing Looped World Models, which are the first looped architectures for world modelling. Our method iteratively refines latent environment states through a parameter-shared transformer block. This yield up to one hundred times parameter efficiency over conventional approaches with adaptive computation that automatically scales depth to match the complexity of each prediction step. Orthogonal to scaling model size and training data, LoopWM establishes iterative latent depth as a new scaling axis for world simulation, which might significantly push the community forward.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决世界模型在长期环境模拟中，计算深度与部署成本之间的根本矛盾。传统方法为提升长期预测准确性需加深网络，但这会导致参数激增、推理成本过高，且误差会随时间累积。该问题在研究和应用中至关重要，因为世界模型是强化学习与具身智能的基石，只有以较低算力实现稳定准确的长期推演，才能在实际资源受限的设备上部署，并支撑复杂的自主规划与决策任务。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者针对传统世界模型长程预测计算昂贵且误差易累积的问题，提出将语言模型中成熟的循环变换器架构引入环境模拟。他们基于物理状态迭代演化的特性，设计了参数共享的循环模块，通过反复迭代优化潜在状态。该方法直接借鉴了通用变换器、自适应计算时间以及谱约束参数化等现有工作，并结合自适应深度机制根据预测难度动态分配计算量，从而在保持预测精度的同时大幅提升参数效率。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是利用参数共享的循环计算模块反复迭代优化环境隐状态，使模型能够根据预测步骤的复杂程度自动调整计算深度，从而在大幅降低参数量的同时保证长期模拟的稳定性。整体实现流程首先将环境观测与智能体动作分别编码为隐向量，随后将上一时刻的隐状态与当前编码共同输入共享模块进行多次迭代更新，并通过自适应退出机制在状态收敛或任务简单时提前终止循环，最后将更新后的隐状态解码以输出未来的环境预测结果。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于首次将循环计算架构引入世界模型，通过参数共享的迭代模块逐步优化环境状态，并结合自适应计算机制，使模型能根据预测步骤的复杂度自动调整计算深度。相比以往世界模型固定深度的设计，该方法不仅大幅提升了参数效率，还有效缓解了长序列预测中的误差累积问题。此外，它将迭代隐层深度确立为一种全新的模型扩展维度，与传统的扩大模型规模或增加训练数据的方式完全独立。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文首次提出循环世界模型，通过参数共享的循环变压器块与自适应计算机制，在大幅降低参数量的同时实现了长期环境模拟的稳定性，并确立了迭代隐状态深度作为世界模型的新扩展方向。

Abstract

Current world models face a fundamental tension: faithful long-horizon simulation demands deep computation, but deeper models are expensive to deploy and prone to compounding errors. We resolve this by introducing Looped World Models (LoopWM), which are the first looped architectures for world modelling. Our method iteratively refines latent environment states through a parameter-shared transformer block. This yield up to 100x parameter efficiency over conventional approaches with adaptive computation that automatically scales depth to match the complexity of each prediction step. Orthogonal to scaling model size and training data, LoopWM establishes iterative latent depth as a new scaling axis for world simulation, which might significantly push the community forward.

item.title: Zone of Proximal Policy Optimization: Teacher in Prompts, Not Gradients
item.author: Lee, Byung-Kwan, Lu, Ximing, Diao, Shizhe, Kang, Minki, Muralidharan, Saurav, Sapra, Karan, Tao, Andrew, Molchanov, Pavlo, Choi, Yejin, Wang, Yu-Chiang Frank, Hachiuma, Ryo
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为近端策略优化区域（ZPPO）的新方法，旨在解决知识蒸馏在小规模学生模型中泛化能力差的问题。ZPPO 借鉴维果茨基的最近发展区理论，通过将教师模型保留在提示词中而非策略梯度中，利用二元候选包含问题和负向候选包含问题来强化学生对困难问题的处理能力，并在多个基准测试中取得了优于现有方法的性能。

背景: 知识蒸馏将教师模型的能力转移给小规模学生模型，但在小规模学生模型中表现脆弱。强制学生模仿远大于自身的教师模型的逻辑输出，会使学生过度集中于教师模型的最尖锐模式，从而损害其在训练语料库之外基准族上的泛化能力。强化学习通过基于学生自身 rollout 进行训练来避免逻辑模仿，但在所有 rollout 均失败的问题上，注入更强教师模型的响应会破坏策略梯度中的同策略假设并导致漂移。

目的: 引入近端策略优化区域（ZPPO）方法，以克服知识蒸馏在小型学生模型中的泛化缺陷以及强化学习在处理失败 rollout 时可能引发的策略漂移问题，从而提升小规模视觉语言模型和大型语言模型的性能。

方法: ZPPO 借鉴维果茨基的最近发展区理论，将教师模型保留在提示词中。对于困难问题，构建两种重新表述的提示词：二元候选包含问题（BCQ）将一个正确的教师响应和一个错误的学生响应作为匿名候选项供学生区分；负向候选包含问题（NCQ）将学生的错误 rollout 聚合到单个提示词中以揭示其共同的失败模式。使用提示词重放缓冲区循环处理每个困难问题，直到学生在此问题上的平均 rollout 准确率达到一半（毕业）或在有限容量下按先进先出原则被驱逐，从而在学生当前的最近发展区内放大 BCQ 和 NCQ 的效果。

主要发现: 在 Qwen3.5 系列的四个学生规模（0.8B 至 9B）上，使用 27B 教师模型进行后训练，并在包含 16 个视觉语言模型基准、10 个大语言模型基准和 5 个视频基准的 31 个基准套件上进行评估，ZPPO 的性能优于离线和在线知识蒸馏以及 GRPO 方法，且在学生模型规模最小时提升幅度最大。

结论: ZPPO 通过结合最近发展区理论和特定的提示词构建策略，有效提升了小规模学生模型在复杂任务上的泛化能力和性能，特别是在资源受限的小型模型上展现出显著优势。

翻译: Knowledge distillation transfers a teacher's competence to a small student but is brittle in the small-student regime: forcing the student to imitate logits from a much larger teacher concentrates it on the teacher's sharpest modes, hurting generalization on benchmark families beyond the training corpus. Reinforcement learning (RL) avoids logit imitation by training on the student's own rollouts. However, on questions where every rollout fails-yielding zero advantage and being silently discarded-injecting a stronger teacher's response into the policy gradient breaks the on-policy assumption and induces drift. We introduce Zone of Proximal Policy Optimization (ZPPO), inspired by Vygotsky's zone of proximal development, which keeps the teacher inside the prompt rather than the policy gradient. On hard questions, ZPPO constructs two reformulated prompts: a Binary Candidate-included Question (BCQ) pairs one correct teacher response with one incorrect student response as anonymized candidates the student must discriminate, and a Negative Candidate-included Question (NCQ) aggregates the student's wrong rollouts into a single prompt to surface their shared failure modes. A prompt replay buffer recirculates each hard question until it either graduates-the student's mean rollout accuracy on it reaches half- or is FIFO-evicted under finite capacity, amplifying BCQ and NCQ inside the student's current zone of proximal development. On the Qwen3.5 family at four student scales (0.8B-9B) with a 27B teacher, post-trained as vision-language models and evaluated on a 31-benchmark suite (16 VLM, 10 LLM, 5 Video), ZPPO outperforms off/on-policy distillation and GRPO, with the largest gains at the smallest scale.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决小模型在吸收大模型知识时容易死记硬背导致泛化能力下降，以及强化学习中完全答错的难题被系统忽略无法学习的问题。该问题在研究和现实中至关重要，因为实际应用场景需要能在手机、智能眼镜或机器人等算力受限设备上运行的小模型，且这些模型必须具备广泛适应新任务的能力，而非仅仅重复训练数据中的路径。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者首先发现传统知识蒸馏在小模型中易导致过拟合且损害泛化能力，而强化学习在难题上会产生无效信号，强行注入教师答案又会引发策略漂移。为此，作者借鉴教育心理学中的最近发展区理论，

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是受最近发展区理论启发，将教师的指导严格限制在提示词内部，避免小模型直接模仿教师输出或将其强行加入策略梯度，从而兼顾知识传递与策略稳定性。整体实现流程首先筛选出学生模型平均正确率低于一半的难题，随后针对这些难题构建两种提示词：一种是将教师正确答案与学生错误答案混合成匿名选项供学生判断，另一种是将学生所有错误答案汇总以暴露共性错误的提示。这些难题会被放入缓冲区中反复训练，直到学生正确率达到一半或缓冲区满为止，最终仅基于学生自身的生成结果进行强化学习参数更新。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文提出了近端策略优化区域方法，核心创新在于将教师模型的指导信息严格限制在提示词内部，而非直接修改策略梯度。具体通过构建包含正确教师回答与错误学生回答的对比问题，以及聚合学生所有错误回答的提示词，来引导模型自主推理并暴露共性错误。同时引入提示词重放机制，反复训练学生尚未掌握的题目。与以往知识蒸馏直接模仿教师输出导致泛化能力下降、或强化学习直接注入教师回答引发策略漂移不同，该方法在保持学生策略独立生成的前提下，有效解决了小模型在难题上无法学习的问题。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了一种名为近端策略优化区域的新方法，通过将大模型的正确答案与错误答案融入提示词中，并配合题目重放机制，使小模型在不直接模仿大模型输出也不破坏强化学习策略的前提下，有效攻克难题并显著提升泛化能力。

Abstract

Knowledge distillation transfers a teacher's competence to a small student but is brittle in the small-student regime: forcing the student to imitate logits from a much larger teacher concentrates it on the teacher's sharpest modes, hurting generalization on benchmark families beyond the training corpus. Reinforcement learning (RL) avoids logit imitation by training on the student's own rollouts. However, on questions where every rollout fails-yielding zero advantage and being silently discarded-injecting a stronger teacher's response into the policy gradient breaks the on-policy assumption and induces drift. We introduce Zone of Proximal Policy Optimization (ZPPO), inspired by Vygotsky's zone of proximal development, which keeps the teacher inside the prompt rather than the policy gradient. On hard questions, ZPPO constructs two reformulated prompts: a Binary Candidate-included Question (BCQ) pairs one correct teacher response with one incorrect student response as anonymized candidates the student must discriminate, and a Negative Candidate-included Question (NCQ) aggregates the student's wrong rollouts into a single prompt to surface their shared failure modes. A prompt replay buffer recirculates each hard question until it either graduates-the student's mean rollout accuracy on it reaches half- or is FIFO-evicted under finite capacity, amplifying BCQ and NCQ inside the student's current zone of proximal development. On the Qwen3.5 family at four student scales (0.8B-9B) with a 27B teacher, post-trained as vision-language models and evaluated on a 31-benchmark suite (16 VLM, 10 LLM, 5 Video), ZPPO outperforms off/on-policy distillation and GRPO, with the largest gains at the smallest scale.

item.title: EventDrive: Event Cameras for Vision-Language Driving Intelligence
item.author: Dongyue Lu, Rong Li, Ao Liang, Lingdong Kong, Wei Yin, Lai Xing Ng, Benoit R. Cottereau, Camille Simon Chane, Wei Tsang Ooi
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 事件相机通过异步亮度变化感知世界，具有微秒级延迟和高动态范围，在自动驾驶中作为RGB的补充，尤其在模糊、眩光和快速运动场景下表现优异。现有事件感知视觉语言模型局限于通用感知，未揭示事件传感对推理和决策的贡献。本文提出EventDrive，一个统一事件流、RGB帧和语言监督的大规模基准和模型套件，涵盖感知、理解、预测和规划四个核心维度。EventDrive-VLM引入多视界事件金字塔和时序视界混合专家模块，自适应编码和融合异步与帧基信息。评估显示事件流在时间精度、运动感知和鲁棒性方面带来显著提升，将事件传感置于驾驶智能的核心。

背景: 事件相机通过异步亮度变化感知世界，具有微秒级延迟和高动态范围，提供远超帧基传感器的运动保真度，并捕捉常规曝光常遗漏的时间结构。这些特性使事件成为自动驾驶中RGB的强大补充，尤其在模糊、眩光和快速运动等帧基感知不可靠的场景下。然而，现有事件感知视觉语言模型局限于通用感知，未揭示事件传感如何在全驾驶循环中贡献于推理和决策。

目的: 提出EventDrive，一个统一事件流、RGB帧和语言监督的大规模基准和模型套件，以揭示事件传感在自动驾驶全循环（感知、理解、预测、规划）中对推理和决策的贡献。

方法: 构建EventDrive基准和模型套件，涵盖感知、理解、预测和规划四个核心维度，包括字幕、结构化问答、定位、运动状态识别、轨迹预测和规划任务。提出EventDrive-VLM模型，引入多视界事件金字塔和时序视界混合专家模块，以自适应编码和融合异步事件与帧基信息，用于下游推理。

主要发现: 事件流在时间精度、运动感知和鲁棒性方面提供实质性提升。

结论: 事件传感将事件置于驾驶智能的核心。

翻译: Event cameras sense the world through asynchronous brightness changes with microsecond latency and high dynamic range, offering motion fidelity far beyond frame-based sensors and capturing temporal structure that conventional exposures often miss. These properties make events a powerful complement to RGB in autonomous driving, especially under blur, glare, and rapid motion, where frame-based perception can become unreliable. However, existing event-aware vision-language models remain limited to generic perception and do not reveal how event sensing contributes to reasoning and decision-making across the full driving loop. We present EventDrive, a large-scale benchmark and model suite that unifies event streams, RGB frames, and language supervision across four core dimensions: Perception, Understanding, Prediction, and Planning, covering captions, structured QA, grounding, motion-state recognition, trajectory forecasting, and planning tasks. Building on this foundation, EventDrive-VLM introduces a multi-horizon event pyramid and a temporal-horizon mixture-of-experts module to adaptively encode and fuse asynchronous and frame-based information for downstream reasoning. Comprehensive evaluation across diverse tasks shows that event streams provide substantial gains in temporal precision, motion awareness, and robustness, bringing event sensing into the center of driving intelligence.

Abstract

Event cameras sense the world through asynchronous brightness changes with microsecond latency and high dynamic range, offering motion fidelity far beyond frame-based sensors and capturing temporal structure that conventional exposures often miss. These properties make events a powerful complement to RGB in autonomous driving, especially under blur, glare, and rapid motion, where frame-based perception can become unreliable. However, existing event-aware vision-language models remain limited to generic perception and do not reveal how event sensing contributes to reasoning and decision-making across the full driving loop. We present EventDrive, a large-scale benchmark and model suite that unifies event streams, RGB frames, and language supervision across four core dimensions: Perception, Understanding, Prediction, and Planning, covering captions, structured QA, grounding, motion-state recognition, trajectory forecasting, and planning tasks. Building on this foundation, EventDrive-VLM introduces a multi-horizon event pyramid and a temporal-horizon mixture-of-experts module to adaptively encode and fuse asynchronous and frame-based information for downstream reasoning. Comprehensive evaluation across diverse tasks shows that event streams provide substantial gains in temporal precision, motion awareness, and robustness, bringing event sensing into the center of driving intelligence.

item.title: Variable-Width Transformers
item.author: Wu, Zhaofeng, Sieberling, Oliver, Tan, Shawn, Panda, Rameswar, Polyanskiy, Yury, Kim, Yoon
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种非均匀宽度分配的X形Transformer架构，通过调整网络深度中各层的宽度，实现了更优的语言模型扩展和资源效率。

背景: 当前基于Transformer的语言模型通常保持所有层宽度一致，导致参数和计算资源分配不均，未能充分利用不同层的计算角色差异。

目的: 探索非均匀容量分配对网络深度的影响，提出一种更资源优化的语言模型扩展方法。

方法: 设计X形Transformer架构，保持早期和晚期层较宽、中间层较窄，采用无参数残差调整机制，并在2亿至20亿参数（密集）和30亿参数（MoE）的解码器语言模型上进行实验。

主要发现: 该架构在语言建模损失上优于参数匹配的均匀基线，平均层宽度降低使总浮点运算次数减少22%，KV缓存内存和I/O成本降低15%，且残差流中产生定性不同的表示。

结论: 非均匀宽度分配能够实现更资源优化的语言模型扩展。

翻译: Scaling model size, specifically depth and width, has driven significant progress in transformer-based language models. However, most architectures maintain a constant width across all layers, allocating a fixed parameter and computation budget evenly despite different layers potentially playing distinct computational roles. In this work, we empirically investigate nonuniform capacity allocation across network depth by proposing a ×-shaped Transformer architecture. This design maintains wider early and late layers while narrowing the middle layers, utilizing a parameter-free residual resizing mechanism. Across decoder-only language models ranging from 200M to 2B parameters (dense) and 3B parameters (MoE), our ×-shaped Transformer consistently outperforms parameter-matched uniform baselines on language modeling loss. By reducing the average layer width, this architecture also requires fewer overall FLOPs (22% reduction under fitted loss-matched scaling curves) and smaller KV cache memory and I/O cost (15% reduction). In analysis, we show that this bottleneck structure results in qualitatively different representations in residual streams. Overall, our results demonstrate that nonuniform width allocation can result in more resource-optimal scaling of language models.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要探讨在固定参数预算下，是否应该打破传统模型各层宽度一致的设计，转而采用非均匀分配网络容量的方案。该问题之所以重要，是因为不同网络层在实际计算中承担的角色不同，均匀分配参数与计算资源可能并非最优。实验表明，非均匀宽度设计不仅能提升模型性能，还能显著降低训练与推理的计算量、内存占用及数据传输成本，从而实现更高效的模型扩展。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者基于不同网络层可能承担不同计算角色的观察，质疑传统模型各层宽度必须保持一致的假设，提出按深度非均匀分配计算容量的设计思路。在具体实现上，他们采用无需额外参数的残差流调整机制，通过直接截断或复制历史维度来适应层间宽度变化，从而避免引入投影瓶颈。该设计借鉴了以往仅调整前馈网络中间层维度的研究，但进一步将全模块宽度进行非均匀重新分配，并发现首尾宽、中间窄的结构在性能与效率上表现最佳。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 核心思想是打破传统模型各层宽度固定的限制，采用非均匀容量分配策略，设计为前后层较宽、中间层较窄的结构，在保持总参数量不变的前提下降低平均层宽以提升性能并节省计算与内存开销。实现流程上，模型保持全局残差维度固定，每层仅读写自身宽度对应的数据切片。维度缩小时直接截断多余部分，扩大时则通过无参数复制机制从最近处理过该维度的层恢复数据，各层宽度由预设参数自动推导以匹配固定预算。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于打破了传统Transformer各层宽度固定的假设，提出了一种非均匀宽度分配架构，并设计了一种无需额外参数的残差流尺寸调整机制。相比以往仅调整网络中间维度或保持固定宽度的工作，本研究将全模块宽度进行动态重分配，实证发现首尾宽、中间窄的结构在参数量相同时表现最优。这种设计在提升模型性能的同时，还能显著降低训练计算量、缓存占用和输入输出成本。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一种首尾层宽中间层窄的非均匀宽度语言模型架构，通过无参数残差调整机制，在参数量不变的情况下显著提升了模型性能，并有效降低了训练计算量、推理内存占用及数据传输成本。

Abstract

Scaling model size, specifically depth and width, has driven significant progress in transformer-based language models. However, most architectures maintain a constant width across all layers, allocating a fixed parameter and computation budget evenly despite different layers potentially playing distinct computational roles. In this work, we empirically investigate nonuniform capacity allocation across network depth by proposing a $\times$-shaped > <former architecture. This design maintains wider early and late layers while narrowing the middle layers, utilizing a parameter-free residual resizing mechanism. Across decoder-only language models ranging from 200M to 2B parameters (dense) and 3B parameters (MoE), our > <former consistently outperforms parameter-matched uniform baselines on language modeling loss. By reducing the average layer width, this architecture also requires fewer overall FLOPs (22% reduction under fitted loss-matched scaling curves) and smaller KV cache memory and I/O cost (15% reduction). In analysis, we show that this bottleneck structure results in qualitatively different representations in residual streams. Overall, our results demonstrate that nonuniform width allocation can result in more resource-optimal scaling of language models.

item.title: Unified Multimodal Autoregressive Modeling with Shared Context-Visual Tokenizer is Key to Unification
item.author: Peng, Wujian, Meng, Lingchen, Cai, Yuxuan, Zhuang, Xianwei, Yang, Yuhuan, Fang, Rongyao, Wu, Chenfei, Lin, Junyang, Wu, Zuxuan, Bai, Shuai
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: UniAR是一个统一的自回归框架，旨在整合视觉理解和生成。

背景: 现有的统一多模态建模方法通常依赖两个不同的视觉标记器，导致表示空间分裂，阻碍了真正的统一建模。

目的: 提出UniAR框架，通过单一的离散视觉标记器作为理解和生成之间的桥梁，实现共享上下文。

方法: 采用预训练视觉编码器，结合多级特征融合和无查找位量化方案，保留高级语义和低级细节；使用并行位预测联合预测空间分组的多级视觉代码；基于扩散的视觉解码器对离散视觉标记进行解码。

主要发现: UniAR在图像生成和图像编辑方面达到最先进性能，同时在多模态理解基准测试中保持竞争力。

结论: UniAR通过大规模预训练、监督微调与强化学习，实现了视觉理解和生成的统一建模。

翻译: 统一多模态建模旨在将视觉理解和生成整合到单一系统中。然而，现有方法通常依赖两个不同的视觉标记器，导致表示空间分裂，阻碍了真正的统一建模。我们提出了UniAR，这是一个统一的自回归框架，其中单一的离散视觉标记器作为理解和生成之间的关键桥梁，使模型能够在共享上下文中直接解释其自身生成的视觉标记，而无需额外的重新编码。UniAR通过多级特征融合和无查找位量化方案调整预训练视觉编码器，在最小成本下扩展有效视觉词汇量的同时保留高级语义和低级细节。在此基础上，统一的自回归模型采用并行位预测联合预测空间分组的多级视觉代码，大幅减少视觉序列长度并加速生成。最后，基于扩散的视觉解码器对离散视觉标记进行解码以生成高保真图像。通过大规模预训练、监督微调和强化学习，UniAR在图像生成和图像编辑方面达到最先进性能，同时在多模态理解基准测试中保持竞争力。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决现有统一多模态模型因使用两套独立视觉分词器而导致理解与生成任务割裂、无法共享上下文的问题。通过单一分词器，模型能在统一空间内直接理解并生成图像，无需重复编码。该问题在研究中至关重要，因为它有效弥合了理解任务所需的高层语义与生成任务所需的底层细节之间的鸿沟，为构建高效且真正融合的多模态人工智能系统奠定了基础。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者针对现有统一多模态模型依赖双视觉词元器导致表征空间割裂的问题，提出使用单一离散视觉词元器来打通理解与生成的共享上下文。在设计上，他们通过融合多层视觉特征兼顾高层语义与底层细节，并采用无查找表的按位量化方案高效扩展词表，同时引入并行按位预测机制压缩序列长度以加速生成。该方法借鉴了二进制球面量化技术以及类似工作的按位量化思路，并在视觉解码器设计上参考了扩散模型与条件流匹配框架，同时在与同类统一模型的对比中明确了自身在量化效率、推理速度与轻量化方面的改进方向。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是使用单一的离散视觉词元作为桥梁，将视觉理解与生成统一在同一个自回归框架和共享上下文中，使模型能直接解读自身生成的图像而无需重新编码。整体实现流程为：首先通过融合多层视觉特征和按位量化技术将图像转换为离散的二进制词元；接着在统一的自回归模型中并行预测文本与视觉词元；最后通过扩散解码器将预测出的视觉词元还原为高清图像。整个模型训练分为大规模预训练、监督微调和强化学习三个阶段，其中视觉词元与解码器在训练时保持冻结。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于提出了一种统一的自回归框架，利用单一离散视觉词元桥接图像理解与生成任务。它通过多级特征融合与无查找位量化技术，在极低成本下大幅扩展词表规模，同时兼顾高层语义与底层细节。相比以往依赖双词元或独立解码器的方法，该框架实现了真正的共享上下文，并通过并行预测机制显著缩短序列长度、提升生成速度，且其视觉解码器完全独立于文本输入，仅负责将离散词元还原为高清图像。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了一种统一的自回归框架，通过单一离散视觉词元结合多级特征融合与位量化技术，成功将图像理解与生成任务整合在同一共享上下文中，实现了高效的高分辨率图像生成与多模态理解。

Abstract

Unified Multimodal Modeling aims to integrate visual understanding and generation within a single system. However, existing approaches typically rely on two disparate visual tokenizers, which splits the representation space and hinders truly unified modeling. We propose UniAR, a unified autoregressive framework where a single discrete visual tokenizer serves as the key bridge between understanding and generation, enabling a shared context in which the model can directly interpret its own generated visual tokens without additional re-encoding. UniAR adapts a pretrained vision encoder with multi-level feature fusion and a lookup-free bitwise quantization scheme, preserving both high-level semantics and low-level details while scaling the effective visual vocabulary at minimal cost. Building on this, the unified autoregressive model adopts parallel-bitwise-prediction to jointly predict spatially grouped, multi-level visual codes, substantially reducing visual sequence length and accelerating generation. Finally, a diffusion-based visual decoder operates on discrete visual tokens to decode high-fidelity images. Through large-scale pre-training, followed by supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning, UniAR achieves state-of-the-art performance on image generation and image editing while remaining competitive on multimodal understanding benchmarks. The project page is available at this https URL .

item.title: Prompt-Level Distillation: A Non-Parametric Alternative to Model Fine-Tuning for Efficient Reasoning
item.author: Badhe, Sanket, Shah, Deep
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为提示级蒸馏的方法，旨在解决高级推理中链式思维提示的高延迟和成本问题，以及微调小模型带来的可解释性损失和资源开销问题。

背景: 高级推理通常依赖链式思维提示，虽然准确但存在高延迟和高推理成本；而微调小模型作为替代方案，往往牺牲可解释性并引入显著的资源与操作开销。

目的: 解决链式思维提示的高延迟与成本问题，以及微调小模型的可解释性损失和资源开销问题。

方法: 从教师模型中提取显式推理模式，并将其组织成结构化的表达性指令列表，用于学生模型的系统提示。

主要发现: 在Gemma-3 4B模型上，该方法在StereoSet和Contract-NLI数据集上显著提升了Macro F1分数，在LogiQA上提高了准确率；在Mistral Small 3.1上也取得了类似结果，证明了跨架构的泛化能力，使紧凑模型在几乎不增加延迟的情况下达到前沿性能。

结论: 该方法通过表达性指令使决策过程透明化，便于人类验证逻辑，适用于法律、金融和内容审核等受监管行业，以及高容量用例和边缘设备。

翻译: Advanced reasoning typically requires Chain-of-Thought prompting, which is accurate but incurs prohibitive latency and substantial test-time inference costs. The standard alternative, fine-tuning smaller models, often sacrifices interpretability while introducing significant resource and operational overhead. To address these limitations, we introduce Prompt-Level Distillation (PLD). We extract explicit reasoning patterns from a Teacher model and organize them into a structured list of expressive instructions for the Student model's System Prompt. Evaluated using Gemma-3 4B, PLD improved Macro F1 scores on StereoSet (57% to 90.0%) and Contract-NLI (67% to 83%), while increasing LogiQA accuracy to 70%. Similar results on Mistral Small 3.1 demonstrate cross-architecture generalizability, enabling these compact models to match frontier performance with negligible latency overhead. These expressive instructions render the decision-making process transparent, allowing for full human verification of logic, making this approach ideal for regulated industries such as law, finance, and content moderation, as well as high-volume use cases and edge devices.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决大语言模型在复杂推理任务中难以同时兼顾高准确率、低延迟与低资源消耗的问题。传统思维链提示虽然准确但推理速度过慢，而微调小模型虽然运行高效却会丧失可解释性并带来高昂的维护成本。该问题在现实中至关重要，因为金融、法律等高风险行业及高频应用场景迫切需要既快速准确又能完全透明验证逻辑的推理方案，以打破性能与成本之间的权衡困境。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者针对思维链提示延迟高和传统微调维护成本大的痛点，提出将大模型的推理逻辑直接编译为小模型的系统提示词，从而在不更新参数的情况下实现高效推理。该方法借鉴了思维链提示、知识蒸馏和自动提示优化等现有工作，但摒弃了传统的参数更新和单纯优化措辞的做法，转而通过监督提取、语义聚类、闭环冲突解决等步骤，将离散的推理规则整合为透明、无矛盾的自然语言指令集。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 核心思想是将大模型的推理逻辑提取为自然语言指令并直接写入小模型的提示词中，从而在不更新模型参数的前提下实现高效推理。整体流程包含四个阶段：首先利用大模型从训练数据中提取通用推理规则；接着通过聚类合并相似规则并生成统一指令；随后通过测试反馈迭代优化指令以消除逻辑冲突；最后将定稿的指令集作为系统提示词部署给小模型进行推理。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于提出了一种非参数化的提示级蒸馏框架，通过将大模型的显式推理规则提取并编译为结构化指令，直接注入小模型的系统提示中以实现能力迁移。与传统的思维链方法相比，该方法将复杂的推理过程离线完成并缓存至提示词中，彻底消除了运行时生成冗长推理步骤带来的高延迟与高成本。与传统的知识蒸馏或微调方法相比，该方法无需更新模型权重，避免了频繁重训带来的维护负担，同时将黑盒决策转化为透明可验证的自然语言规则，显著提升了逻辑的可解释性。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了一种名为提示级蒸馏的非参数化方法，通过将大模型的显式推理规则提取并编译为结构化指令直接注入小模型的系统提示中，使小模型无需微调即可在保持极低推理延迟的同时达到前沿的推理准确率。

Abstract

Advanced reasoning typically requires Chain-of-Thought prompting, which is accurate but incurs prohibitive latency and substantial test-time inference costs. The standard alternative, fine-tuning smaller models, often sacrifices interpretability while introducing significant resource and operational overhead. To address these limitations, we introduce Prompt-Level Distillation (PLD). We extract explicit reasoning patterns from a Teacher model and organize them into a structured list of expressive instructions for the Student model's System Prompt. Evaluated using Gemma-3 4B, PLD improved Macro F1 scores on StereoSet (57\% to 90.0\%) and Contract-NLI (67\% to 83\%), while increasing LogiQA accuracy to 70\%. Similar results on Mistral Small 3.1 demonstrate cross-architecture generalizability, enabling these compact models to match frontier performance with negligible latency overhead. These expressive instructions render the decision-making process transparent, allowing for full human verification of logic, making this approach ideal for regulated industries such as law, finance, and content moderation, as well as high-volume use cases and edge devices.

item.title: Tangram: Unlocking Non-Uniform KV Cache Compression for Efficient Multi-turn LLM Serving
item.author: Kim, Hyungmin, Kim, Minsoo, Kim, Hongseok, Choi, Jungwook
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为Tangram的LLM服务框架，旨在解决多轮对话中KV缓存增长导致的内存瓶颈问题。该框架通过静态分配预算、不规则分页和预先负载均衡等技术，实现了非均匀KV压缩的高效服务，显著提升了吞吐量。

背景: 多轮LLM服务中，对话历史累积导致KV缓存随每轮对话和用户增长，迅速超过模型权重，使内存成为吞吐量的主要限制因素。非均匀KV压缩虽能更好地保持精度，但现代服务栈假设所有注意力头的KV长度相同，导致异构性引发页面碎片化、预填充时间增加和GPU工作负载失衡等问题。

目的: 解决非均匀KV压缩在现代服务栈中因异构性导致的内存碎片化、预填充时间增加和GPU工作负载失衡等问题，提升多轮LLM服务的吞吐量。

方法: 提出Tangram框架，通过预算预留（Budget Reservation）在调度时固定每个头的压缩后足迹，消除页面回收；不规则分页（Ragged Paging）将预算相似的头聚类到独立页面表中，将碎片化转化为可回收内存；预先负载均衡（Ahead-of-Time Load Balancing）预先计算平衡的GPU分区，消除运行时规划开销。

主要发现: 头保留率遵循两级结构规律：输入不变的头部排名和 narrowly bounded 的每头比率，可通过少量样本离线校准。Tangram在vLLM上实现，作为现有非均匀压缩方法的即插即用基础，匹配其精度的同时，相比全KV基线将端到端吞吐量提升了最高2.6倍。

结论: Tangram框架通过静态解决动态问题，有效克服了非均匀KV压缩在服务中的实际障碍，显著提升了多轮LLM服务的吞吐量，且实现代码已公开。

翻译: Multi-turn LLM serving accumulates dialogue history whose Key-Value (KV) cache grows with every turn and every user, quickly exceeding the model weights themselves and making memory -- not compute -- the binding constraint on throughput. Non-uniform KV compression, which allocates heterogeneous budgets across attention heads, preserves accuracy far better than uniform schemes, yet remains impractical: modern serving stacks assume identical KV lengths across heads, so heterogeneity traps freed memory as page fragmentation, spends up to 25% of prefill time reclaiming scattered pages, and skews GPU workloads that inflate decode latency by up to $1.7imes$ or burn 15--20% of each decode step on re-planning. We observe that this heterogeneity need not be discovered at runtime: head-wise retention follows a two-level structural regularity -- an input-invariant head ranking with narrowly bounded per-head ratios -- that can be calibrated offline from as few as 50 samples. Building on this insight, we present Tangram, a serving framework that statically resolves what prior systems handle dynamically: Budget Reservation fixes each head's post-compression footprint at scheduling time, eliminating page reclamation; Ragged Paging clusters similar-budget heads into independent page tables, turning fragmentation into reclaimable memory; and Ahead-of-Time Load Balancing precomputes balanced GPU partitions with zero runtime planning. Implemented on vLLM, Tangram serves as a drop-in substrate for existing non-uniform compression methods, matching their accuracy while improving end-to-end throughput by up to $2.6imes$ over the full-KV baseline. Our implementation is publicly available at this https URL .

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决多轮对话大语言模型服务中，因采用非均匀缓存压缩技术而引发的内存碎片化、动态调度开销过大以及计算单元负载不均等系统效率瓶颈。该问题在现实中至关重要，因为多轮交互已成为人工智能助手的核心应用场景，对话历史会随轮数线性增长并迅速耗尽硬件内存。若无法高效管理这些缓存数据，系统将难以在有限资源下维持高吞吐与低延迟，严重阻碍大模型在实际服务中的规模化部署。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者的核心设计思路源于一个关键观察，即不同注意力头对键值缓存的保留模式具有高度稳定性且由模型内在决定。基于这一确定性特征，他们将原本动态的压缩过程转化为静态的内存分配，并以此为基础协同设计了调度策略、内存管理机制与计算内核执行流程。该方法并非凭空创造，而是针对现有主流大模型推理框架中假设缓存长度完全均匀的架构缺陷进行改造，通过引入确定性预算分配、头分组页面管理以及事前负载均衡等创新技术，有效解决了非均匀缓存带来的内存碎片、调度开销与负载不均问题。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是利用注意力头缓存保留模式高度稳定的特性，将动态压缩转化为预先确定的静态内存分配，从而彻底消除运行时调度开销。整体实现流程首先为每个注意力头分配固定的内存预算，接着将需求相似的注意力头分组并建立独立的页表以高效回收内存，最后基于静态预算预先计算最优的图形处理器负载分布。通过这套离线规划与静态管理的组合，系统能够在多轮对话中显著提升吞吐量并保持模型精度。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文提出了Tangram系统，核心创新在于通过静态预算分配、头分组页面管理和事前负载均衡三项技术，解决了非均匀键值缓存带来的内存碎片、动态回收开销和计算负载不均问题。与以往假设所有注意力头缓存长度一致的传统系统不同，Tangram利用各头缓存需求稳定可预测的特性，将原本依赖运行时动态调度的复杂操作转为离线预先计算，从而在保持模型精度的同时显著提升了多轮对话的吞吐量。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了Tangram系统，通过确定性预算分配、头分组分页和事前负载均衡三项技术，有效解决了非均匀键值缓存压缩引发的内存碎片、调度开销与负载不均问题，在完全保持模型精度的前提下将多轮大语言模型服务的吞吐量提升了最高2.6倍。

Abstract

Multi-turn LLM serving accumulates dialogue history whose Key-Value (KV) cache grows with every turn and every user, quickly exceeding the model weights themselves and making memory -- not compute -- the binding constraint on throughput. Non-uniform KV compression, which allocates heterogeneous budgets across attention heads, preserves accuracy far better than uniform schemes, yet remains impractical: modern serving stacks assume identical KV lengths across heads, so heterogeneity traps freed memory as page fragmentation, spends up to 25% of prefill time reclaiming scattered pages, and skews GPU workloads that inflate decode latency by up to $1.7\times$ or burn 15--20% of each decode step on re-planning. We observe that this heterogeneity need not be discovered at runtime: head-wise retention follows a two-level structural regularity -- an input-invariant head ranking with narrowly bounded per-head ratios -- that can be calibrated offline from as few as 50 samples. Building on this insight, we present Tangram, a serving framework that statically resolves what prior systems handle dynamically: Budget Reservation fixes each head's post-compression footprint at scheduling time, eliminating page reclamation; Ragged Paging clusters similar-budget heads into independent page tables, turning fragmentation into reclaimable memory; and Ahead-of-Time Load Balancing precomputes balanced GPU partitions with zero runtime planning. Implemented on vLLM, Tangram serves as a drop-in substrate for existing non-uniform compression methods, matching their accuracy while improving end-to-end throughput by up to $2.6\times$ over the full-KV baseline. Our implementation is publicly available at this https URL .

item.title: STCC: A Unified Source-Channel Semantic Token Coding Framework for Semantic Communications
item.author: Zhicheng Bao, Chen Dong, Sen Wang, Long Liu, Nan Ma, Hao Chen, Xiaodong Xu, Yinqiu Liu, Ping Zhang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出了一种名为语义令牌码本通信的框架，用于在噪声信道上传输基础模型的离散语义令牌。

背景: 深度联合信源信道编码在克服无线通信中的悬崖效应方面展现出潜力，但现有框架直接处理原始模拟数据而非离散语义令牌，且传统系统使用固定星座图，导致在信道噪声下出现灾难性随机错误。

目的: 设计一个统一的信源信道语义令牌编码框架，以兼容基础模型并优化传输过程。

方法: 提出语义令牌编解码器，采用基于多层感知机的编码器学习几何结构化的星座图，并通过三重损失目标进行优化，使信道拓扑与语义嵌入空间对齐。

主要发现: 信道噪声导致的错误被转化为拓扑错误而非随机损坏，具体表现为符号模态中的语义漂移和感知模态中的结构失真。

结论: 在低信噪比条件下，该框架显著优于传统系统，无需接收端修改即可将信道噪声转化为语义变化。

翻译: 提出了一种名为语义令牌码本通信的框架，用于在噪声信道上传输基础模型的离散语义令牌。背景：深度联合信源信道编码在克服无线通信中的悬崖效应方面展现出潜力，但现有框架直接处理原始模拟数据而非离散语义令牌，且传统系统使用固定星座图，导致在信道噪声下出现灾难性随机错误。目的：设计一个统一的信源信道语义令牌编码框架，以兼容基础模型并优化传输过程。方法：提出语义令牌编解码器，采用基于多层感知机的编码器学习几何结构化的星座图，并通过三重损失目标进行优化，使信道拓扑与语义嵌入空间对齐。主要发现：信道噪声导致的错误被转化为拓扑错误而非随机损坏，具体表现为符号模态中的语义漂移和感知模态中的结构失真。结论：在低信噪比条件下，该框架显著优于传统系统，无需接收端修改即可将信道噪声转化为语义变化。

Abstract

Deep Joint Source-Channel Coding (JSCC) has emerged as a promising paradigm for overcoming the ``cliff effect" in wireless communications. However, existing Deep JSCC frameworks operate directly on raw analog data such as image pixels rather than the discrete semantic tokens that foundation models require. Moreover, traditional systems employ fixed, hand-designed constellations that treat all tokens equally, leading to catastrophic random errors under channel noise. In this paper, the Semantic Token Codebook Communication (STCC) is proposed as a unified source-channel semantic token coding framework designed to transmit the discrete semantic tokens of foundation models over noisy channels. The core of STCC is the Semantic Token Codec (STC). It accepts discrete tokens as input, which maintains compatibility with foundation models while employing a residual multiple layer perceptron, i.e., MLP-based encoder that learns geometrically structured constellations optimized with a triple-loss objective. This learned mapping forces the channel topology to align with the semantic embedding space, ensuring that channel noise results in topological errors rather than random corruption. This phenomenon is theoretically and empirically characterized, identifying ``Semantic Drift" in symbolic modalities and ``Structural Distortion" in perceptual modalities, where errors shift predictions to semantically or structurally similar tokens. Extensive experiments demonstrate that STCC significantly outperforms traditional systems in low-SNR regimes, effectively converting channel noise into semantic variations without requiring receiver-side modification.

item.title: Unstable Features, Reproducible Subspaces: Understanding Seed Dependence in Sparse Autoencoders
item.author: Gerasimov, Gleb, Rusalev, Timofei, Balagansky, Nikita, Laptev, Daniil, Kurochkin, Vadim, Gavrilov, Daniil
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 稀疏自编码器在解释神经网络表示中广泛应用，但其效用取决于学习到的特征是否可复现。研究通过特征稳定性评估跨训练运行的可复现性，发现稳定特征携带大部分重建和预测相关信号，而不稳定特征具有弱边际影响且受低频表面形式触发器主导。不稳定特征在几何上虽个体不可复现，但集中于可复现的低秩子空间，表明种子依赖性反映共享激活空间内的基模糊而非纯噪声。通过合并跨种子唯一特征可构建更稳定的稀疏自编码器，同时保留解释方差。

背景: 稀疏自编码器广泛用于解释神经网络表示，但其效用取决于学习到的特征是否可复现。

目的: 研究稀疏自编码器学习到的特征在跨训练运行中的可复现性，评估特征稳定性。

方法: 通过估计每个特征在独立训练的稀疏自编码器中重新出现的概率来量化特征稳定性，进行大规模跨种子、模型、层、字典大小和稀疏自编码器变体的研究，并使用受控合成模型验证机制。

主要发现: 稳定特征携带大部分重建和预测相关信号，不稳定特征具有弱边际影响且受低频表面形式触发器主导；不稳定特征个体不可复现但集中于可复现的低秩子空间；合成模型显示低秩真实特征可在子空间层面恢复但作为个体稀疏自编码器潜在变量不可识别；合并跨种子唯一特征可构建更稳定的稀疏自编码器。

结论: 不稳定特征并非失败或噪声潜在变量，而是反映可复现的低维结构，标准稀疏自编码器在不同种子下以不同方式解析这些结构。

翻译: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) are widely used to interpret neural network representations, but their utility depends on whether the learned features are reproducible across training runs. We study this question through feature stability: for each SAE feature, we estimate the probability that a similar feature reappears in an independently trained SAE. This yields a scalable per-feature signal that separates stable from unstable features. In a large-scale study across seeds, models, layers, dictionary sizes, and SAE variants, we find a pronounced functional asymmetry: stable features carry most of the reconstruction- and prediction-relevant signal, while unstable features have weak marginal impact and are dominated by low-frequency surface-form triggers in both activation statistics and automatic explanations. Geometrically, unstable features are individually non-reproducible but concentrate in reproducible lower-rank subspaces, suggesting that seed dependence often reflects basis ambiguity within a shared region of activation space rather than pure noise. A controlled synthetic model makes this mechanism explicit, showing that low-rank ground-truth features can be recovered at the subspace level while remaining non-identifiable as individual SAE latents across seeds. Finally, by pooling unique cross-seed features, we construct more stable SAEs while preserving explained variance in this setting. Together, these results show that unstable features are not merely failed or noisy latents: they have weak individual functional impact, but reflect reproducible low-dimensional structure that standard SAEs resolve differently across seeds.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要研究稀疏自编码器在不同训练设置下所学到的特征是否具备可重复性，并深入探讨特征无法重现是真正缺失还是仅仅代表同一激活区域的不同基表示。该问题在研究中至关重要，因为稀疏自编码器是神经网络可解释性分析的核心工具，若其特征不可重复，将直接动摇解释结果的可靠性。明确这一机制有助于研究人员区分真正具有功能的稳定特征与仅反映低维结构或表面形式的噪声，从而提升模型可解释性方法的有效性与训练策略。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者通过计算单个特征在多次独立训练中的重现概率来量化稳定性，并采用基于余弦相似度的多对一匹配策略，以兼顾计算效率与单特征分析需求。该方法明确借鉴了前人关于特征匹配与集成训练的研究，例如参考了传统的一对一匹配算法进行稳健性验证，并沿用了集成学习的思路，但通过特征去重与高稳定性筛选进行了改进。整体设计旨在揭示不稳定特征虽个体不可复现，却共同构成可复现低维子空间的机制。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是通过评估稀疏自编码器在不同训练随机种子下学习到的特征重现概率，来区分稳定特征与不稳定特征，并揭示不稳定特征虽个体不可重复，但整体仍集中在可复现的低维子空间中。整体实现流程为：首先使用不同随机种子独立训练多个稀疏自编码器；接着以某一模型的特征为基准，计算其在其他模型中出现相似特征的频率作为稳定性指标；随后根据该指标将特征划分为稳定与不稳定两类，并分析其功能影响与几何结构；最后可通过合并去重多轮训练得到的独特特征来构建更稳定的新模型。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 本文的关键创新在于提出了一种高效的单特征稳定性评估方法，揭示了稳定特征与不稳定特征在功能影响和几何结构上的显著差异，并通过受控合成实验证明不稳定特征虽个体不可复现，但整体集中在可复现的低维子空间中。相比以往工作主要依赖计算成本较高的一对一特征匹配或简单的特征拼接，本文采用高效的多对一相似度匹配规则实现逐特征分析，并在构建新模型时通过去重筛选高稳定性特征，打破了以往认为稳定性与重建质量必然存在权衡的假设。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文揭示了稀疏自编码器中不稳定特征并非随机噪声，而是可复现低维结构在不同训练种子下的基分解差异，同时证明稳定特征主导了核心功能信号，且通过整合跨种子特征可有效提升模型稳定性而不损失重构质量。

Abstract

Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) are widely used to interpret neural network representations, but their utility depends on whether the learned features are reproducible across training runs. We study this question through \emph{feature stability}: for each SAE feature, we estimate the probability that a similar feature reappears in an independently trained SAE. This yields a scalable per-feature signal that separates stable from unstable features.
