New in this edition, the report tracks how AI is being tested more ambitiously across reasoning, safety, and real-world task execution, and why those measurements are increasingly difficult to rely on. It also features new estimates of generative AI's economic value alongside emerging evidence of its labor market effects, an analytical framework on AI sovereignty, and a science chapter developed in collaboration with Schmidt Sciences. For the first time, the report features standalone chapters on AI in science and AI in medicine, reflecting AI's growing impact across these two domains.

item.title: Unsupervised Learning for Missing Modalities in Multimodal Learning
item.author: Hassan Ismkhan, Hamid Bouchahcia
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为UL4M4的框架，用于解决多模态学习中的缺失模态问题。该框架通过无监督学习对缺失的特征嵌入进行插补，能够在任务无关的情况下处理任意数量和模式的缺失模态。实验表明，该方法在高度不完整的条件下具有鲁棒性，并显著优于现有基线方法。

背景: 多模态学习中存在缺失模态的挑战。

目的: 解决多模态学习中的缺失模态问题，实现任务无关的缺失特征嵌入插补。

方法: 提出UL4M4框架，包括模态特定的归一化和一种新的部分模态距离度量，以支持不完整观测的公平聚类。利用聚类中心指导迭代贪婪插补过程，使用冻结的编码器，且与下游任务解耦。

主要发现: 在多样化和高度不完整的条件下，UL4M4表现出鲁棒性。在超过百分之五十的模态槽位缺失的挑战性配置下，实现了超过零点七的F1-Micro分数，这是已知的首次一致达到该水平的结果。结果在聚类大小变化下稳定，并显著优于最先进基线。

结论: UL4M4框架能够有效处理多模态学习中的缺失模态问题，具有灵活性和鲁棒性，适用于任意数量的模态和任意缺失模式。

翻译: This paper addresses the missing-modality challenge in multi-modal learning by introducing Unsupervised Learning for Missing Modalities in Multi-Modal Learning (UL4M4), a flexible framework that imputes missing feature embeddings in a task-independent manner before supervised prediction. We propose modality-specific normalization and a novel partial-modality distance metric to enable fair clustering of incomplete observations, capturing cross-modal structures while preserving scale-invariance across varying dimensionalities and modality counts. Cluster centers from this unsupervised stage guide an iterative greedy imputation process for any missing modalities during training or inference, supporting arbitrary numbers of modalities and arbitrary missing patterns per sample. The imputation module is lightweight, uses frozen encoders, and decouples from the downstream task, allowing easy integration with any fusion/prediction architecture. Extensive experiments under diverse and highly incomplete regimes demonstrate UL4M4's robustness, achieving, to the best of our knowledge, the first consistent F1-Micro scores above 0.7 on challenging missing configurations even when more than 50% of modality slots are missing. Results are also stable across cluster sizes and significantly outperform state-of-the-art baselines. Code is available here: https://github.com/h-ismkhan/Multimodal-Learning-with-Missing-Modalities-via-Unsupervised-Learning.

Abstract

This paper addresses the missing-modality challenge in multi-modal learning by introducing Unsupervised Learning for Missing Modalities in Multi-Modal Learning (UL4M4), a flexible framework that imputes missing feature embeddings in a task-independent manner before supervised prediction. We propose modality-specific normalization and a novel partial-modality distance metric to enable fair clustering of incomplete observations, capturing cross-modal structures while preserving scale-invariance across varying dimensionalities and modality counts. Cluster centers from this unsupervised stage guide an iterative greedy imputation process for any missing modalities during training or inference, supporting arbitrary numbers of modalities and arbitrary missing patterns per sample. The imputation module is lightweight, uses frozen encoders, and decouples from the downstream task, allowing easy integration with any fusion/prediction architecture. Extensive experiments under diverse and highly incomplete regimes demonstrate UL4M4's robustness, achieving, to the best of our knowledge, the first consistent F1-Micro scores above 0.7 on challenging missing configurations even when more than 50\% of modality slots are missing. Results are also stable across cluster sizes and significantly outperform state-of-the-art baselines. Code is available here: https://github.com/h-ismkhan/Multimodal-Learning-with-Missing-Modalities-via-Unsupervised-Learning.

item.title: Task-Instructed Causal Routing of Vision Foundation Models for Multi-Task Learning
item.author: Donghyun Han, Yuseok Bae, Jung Uk Kim, Hyung-Il Kim
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为TIGER的框架，用于协调多个异构视觉基础模型以进行多任务密集预测。

背景: 视觉基础模型在广泛的视觉任务中表现出强大的鲁棒性和可迁移性，但每个模型通常编码由其预训练目标和数据域塑造的强归纳偏置，导致视觉知识碎片化但互补。单个模型往往难以捕捉跨多个密集预测任务所需的多样化视觉表示。

目的: 解决单个视觉基础模型难以捕捉跨多个密集预测任务所需多样化视觉表示的问题。

方法: 提出TIGER框架，利用自然语言任务指令指导路由网络，根据任务语义分配令牌级专家权重，实现互补专家特征的自适应集成。引入反事实损失，通过测量排除专家时的预测变化，将路由决策与每个专家的因果贡献对齐。

主要发现: 在NYUD-v2和Pascal Context两个多任务密集预测基准上，TIGER在保持所有视觉基础模型冻结的情况下，持续优于最近的多任务学习基线。

结论: 结合指令引导的专家路由与反事实因果对齐，能够有效协调异构视觉基础模型。

翻译: Vision foundation models (VFMs) have demonstrated strong robustness and transferability across a wide range of visual tasks. However, each model typically encodes strong inductive biases shaped by its pre-training objective and data domain, resulting in fragmented yet complementary visual knowledge. As a result, a single model often struggles to capture the diverse visual representations required across multiple dense prediction tasks. To address this limitation, we propose TIGER (Task-Instruction-Guided Expert Routing), a framework that coordinates multiple heterogeneous VFMs for multi-task dense prediction. Instead of naively aggregating expert features, TIGER leverages natural-language task instructions to guide a routing network that assigns token-level expert weights conditioned on task semantics, enabling adaptive integration of complementary expert features. TIGER further introduces a counterfactual loss that aligns routing decisions with each expert's causal contribution by measuring prediction changes when experts are excluded, encouraging more reliable and interpretable routing. We evaluate TIGER on two multi-task dense prediction benchmarks, NYUD-v2 and Pascal Context, where it consistently outperforms recent multi-task learning baselines while keeping all VFMs frozen. These results demonstrate that combining instruction-guided expert routing with counterfactual causal alignment enables effective coordination of heterogeneous vision foundation models.

Abstract

Vision foundation models (VFMs) have demonstrated strong robustness and transferability across a wide range of visual tasks. However, each model typically encodes strong inductive biases shaped by its pre-training objective and data domain, resulting in fragmented yet complementary visual knowledge. As a result, a single model often struggles to capture the diverse visual representations required across multiple dense prediction tasks. To address this limitation, we propose TIGER (Task-Instruction-Guided Expert Routing), a framework that coordinates multiple heterogeneous VFMs for multi-task dense prediction. Instead of naively aggregating expert features, TIGER leverages natural-language task instructions to guide a routing network that assigns token-level expert weights conditioned on task semantics, enabling adaptive integration of complementary expert features. TIGER further introduces a counterfactual loss that aligns routing decisions with each expert's causal contribution by measuring prediction changes when experts are excluded, encouraging more reliable and interpretable routing. We evaluate TIGER on two multi-task dense prediction benchmarks, NYUD-v2 and Pascal Context, where it consistently outperforms recent multi-task learning baselines while keeping all VFMs frozen. These results demonstrate that combining instruction-guided expert routing with counterfactual causal alignment enables effective coordination of heterogeneous vision foundation models.

item.title: LaWAM: Latent World Action Models for Efficient Dynamics-Aware Robot Policies
item.author: Jialei Chen, Kai Wang, Kang Chen, Shuaihang Chen, Feng Gao, Wenhao Tang, Zhiyuan Li, Weilin Liu, Zhuyu Yao, Boxun Li, Yuanbo Xu, Chao Yu
item.description:
来源: arxiv;hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为LaWAM的潜在世界动作模型，该模型通过紧凑的潜在视觉子目标而非重建的未来视频向机器人策略暴露预测动态，实现了低延迟且高效的机器人控制。

背景: 视觉语言动作模型利用大规模视觉语言预训练进行语义机器人控制，但通常缺乏对机器人动作如何改变场景的明确预见性。世界动作模型通过基于预测未来的条件策略来解决这一局限性，但现有方法通常依赖计算成本高昂且存在大量像素级冗余的视频生成。

目的: 提出一种新的潜在世界动作模型，以解决现有世界动作模型计算成本高和冗余度大的问题，同时实现具有动态意识的机器人控制。

方法: 核心是构建一个潜在动作条件的潜在世界模型，通过在预训练视觉基础模型的潜在空间中训练潜在动作模型，并重新利用其前向解码器来预测未来观察特征以模拟场景演变。LaWAM基于这些预测的潜在视觉子目标来生成动作，从而实现动态感知的机器人控制。

主要发现: LaWAM在LIBERO、RoboTwin和真实世界操作任务上取得了最先进或具有竞争力的成功率。LaWAM每次动作块预测仅需187毫秒，其实际运行延迟比像素空间的世界动作模型低24倍。

结论: LaWAM通过潜在视觉子目标实现了高效、低延迟的机器人控制，在保持高性能的同时显著降低了计算成本。

翻译: Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) leverage large-scale vision-language pretraining for semantic robot control, but often lack explicit foresight into how robot actions change the scene. World-Action Models (WAMs) address this limitation by conditioning policies on predicted futures, yet existing approaches typically rely on computationally expensive video generation with substantial pixel-level redundancy. We present LaWAM, a Latent World Action Model that exposes predictive dynamics to robot policies through compact latent visual subgoals instead of reconstructed future video. At the core of LaWAM is a latent-action-conditioned Latent World Model (LaWM). We obtain LaWM by training a latent action model in the latent space of a pretrained vision foundation model and repurposing its forward decoder to predict future observation features for scene evolution. LaWAM then conditions action generation on these predicted latent visual subgoals to enable dynamics-aware robot control. LaWAM achieves state-of-the-art or competitive success rates (SRs) across LIBERO (98.6% SR), RoboTwin (91.22% SR), and real-world manipulation tasks while retaining low-latency inference. LaWAM runs in 187 ms per action-chunk prediction and achieves up to 24x lower wall-clock latency than pixel-space WAMs.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决现有机器人控制模型缺乏对动作引发场景变化的预见性，以及现有引入未来预测的模型因依赖逐像素视频生成而导致计算成本高、推理延迟大的问题。该问题在研究和现实中非常重要，因为机器人需要快速准确地根据环境变化做出决策，过高的计算延迟会严重阻碍其实时控制能力，而高效的动态预测机制能显著提升机器人在实际任务中的成功率与运行效率。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者针对现有机器人控制模型缺乏场景演化预见性，且传统世界动作模型因逐像素生成视频导致计算昂贵的问题，提出用紧凑的潜在视觉目标替代未来视频进行预测。在设计上，他们借鉴了现有潜在动作模型的研究，发现其解码器本身已具备条件预测能力，因此将原本训练后通常被丢弃的解码器重新利用为核心预测模块，直接在特征空间预测未来状态。该方法通过单次计算即可为动作生成提供动态上下文，从而兼顾了预测精度与推理效率。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是放弃计算昂贵的未来视频生成，转而在预训练视觉模型的特征空间中预测紧凑的潜在视觉子目标，以此向机器人策略显式提供场景演变的动态信息。整体实现分为两阶段：首先训练潜在世界模型，学习从当前状态和潜在动作预测未来特征表示；随后将其融入控制策略，策略先预测潜在动作并转化为视觉子目标，最后结合当前上下文生成具体的机器人动作序列。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于提出了一种基于潜在空间的动态感知机器人控制方法，通过预测紧凑的潜在视觉子目标来引导动作生成，而非重建完整的未来视频。与以往依赖高计算成本、迭代式像素级视频生成的方法不同，该框架完全在特征空间运行，直接复用预训练视觉模型的解码器来预测未来场景变化。这一设计在大幅降低模型参数和推理延迟的同时，依然保持了领先的机器人任务成功率。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了一种潜在世界动作模型，通过直接预测紧凑的潜在视觉子目标替代昂贵的未来视频生成，为机器人控制提供了高效、低延迟且具备动力学感知能力的策略，在多项基准测试中实现了领先成功率并大幅降低了计算开销。

Abstract

Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) leverage large-scale vision-language pretraining for semantic robot control, but often lack explicit foresight into how robot actions change the scene. World-Action Models (WAMs) address this limitation by conditioning policies on predicted futures, yet existing approaches typically rely on computationally expensive video generation with substantial pixel-level redundancy. We present LaWAM, a Latent World Action Model that exposes predictive dynamics to robot policies through compact latent visual subgoals instead of reconstructed future video. At the core of LaWAM is a latent-action-conditioned Latent World Model (LaWM). We obtain LaWM by training a latent action model in the latent space of a pretrained vision foundation model and repurposing its forward decoder to predict future observation features for scene evolution. LaWAM then conditions action generation on these predicted latent visual subgoals to enable dynamics-aware robot control. LaWAM achieves state-of-the-art or competitive success rates (SRs) across LIBERO (98.6% SR), RoboTwin (91.22% SR), and real-world manipulation tasks while retaining low-latency inference. LaWAM runs in 187 ms per action-chunk prediction and achieves up to 24x lower wall-clock latency than pixel-space WAMs.

item.title: ttda704 at SemEval-2026 Task 4: Modeling Narrative Structures via Pseudonymization and Multi-View Sentence Alignment
item.author: Tai Tran Tan, An Dinh Thien
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了在 SemEval 2026 任务四中关于叙事故事相似性和叙事表示学习的方法。

背景: SemEval 2026 任务四：叙事故事相似性和叙事表示学习。

目的: 捕捉抽象主题、行动过程和结果层面的叙事相似性。

方法: 使用带有微调句子变换器的对比学习。开发了两种流水线：轨道 A 采用单视图方法，通过智能层冻结对完整叙事进行编码以减少过拟合；轨道 B 采用多视图方法，使用特定视图的投影头和自监督对齐来建模主题、情节和结果。两种流水线均基于句子变换器模型，并在合成数据上使用对比损失进行训练。

主要发现: 摘要中未提及具体的实验结果或数据发现。

结论: 提供了可用的代码仓库链接。

翻译: We present our approach to SemEval 2026 Task 4: Narrative Story Similarity and Narrative Representation Learning. Our solution uses contrastive learning with fine-tuned sentence transformers to capture narrative similarity across abstract themes, course of action, and outcomes. We develop two pipelines: (Track A) a single-view method that encodes full narratives with smart layer freezing to reduce overfitting, and (Track B) a multi-view method that models theme, plot, and outcome with view-specific projection heads and self-supervised alignment. Both pipelines build on sentence-transformers models and are trained with contrastive loss on synthetic data. The code is available at the following GitHub repository: https://github.com/dinhthienan33/SemEval2026-Task4-ttda704.

Abstract

We present our approach to SemEval 2026 Task 4: Narrative Story Similarity and Narrative Representation Learning. Our solution uses contrastive learning with fine-tuned sentence transformers to capture narrative similarity across abstract themes, course of action, and outcomes. We develop two pipelines: (Track A) a single-view method that encodes full narratives with smart layer freezing to reduce overfitting, and (Track B) a multi-view method that models theme, plot, and outcome with view-specific projection heads and self-supervised alignment. Both pipelines build on sentence-transformers models and are trained with contrastive loss on synthetic data. The code is available at the following GitHub repository: https://github.com/dinhthienan33/SemEval2026-Task4-ttda704.

item.title: Domain-Guided Prompting of the Segment Anything Model for Seismic Interpretation: The Role of Attributes, Visualization, and Hybrid Prompts
item.author: Aniq Ahmad, Heather Bedle, Ahmad Mustafa
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种用于地震数据零样本适应基础模型的原则性框架，通过对齐地震属性与可视化选择以及采用混合提示策略，实现了无需重新训练即可达到具有竞争力的分割性能。

背景: 大型预训练基础模型显著提高了视觉数据解释的效率，特别是分割一切模型通过基于提示的交互提供了强大的零样本分割能力，使其成为地震解释的有前景工具。然而，现有应用多依赖针对特定地质目标的微调，这需要大量标注数据、计算成本高且常损害模型的泛化能力。

目的: 引入一种原则性框架，实现基础模型对地震数据的零样本适应，以减少对标注数据的依赖并保留模型的通用性。

方法: 该框架包含两个关键组件：一是将地震属性和可视化选择与感兴趣的地质目标对齐；二是采用混合提示策略，结合稀疏的用户定义点提示和源自模型内部特征激活的密集掩码提示。

主要发现: 地质目标感知的地震属性和色标选择结合混合提示，增强了地质特征的可分离性，改进了边界描绘和分割准确性。当这些组件联合应用时，模型在完全零样本设置下可实现具有竞争力的分割性能。

结论: 该工作为在地震解释中利用基础模型建立了一条实用且可扩展的路径，减少了对标注数据的依赖，同时保留了模型的通用性。

翻译: The advent of large pretrained foundation models for computer vision has significantly improved the efficiency of visual data interpretation. The Segment Anything Model, in particular, offers powerful zero shot segmentation capabilities through prompt based interaction, thus making it a promising tool for seismic interpretation. However, most existing applications of the model rely on fine tuning for specific geological targets, which requires extensive labeled data, incurs high computational cost, and often compromises the model's generalization capability. In this study, we introduce a principled framework for zero shot adaptation of foundation models to seismic data. The framework is built on two key components: aligning seismic attributes and visualization choices with the geological target of interest, and employing a hybrid prompting strategy that combines sparse user defined point prompts with dense mask prompts derived from the model's internal feature activations. We systematically evaluate this framework across multiple geological targets, datasets, prompt configurations, and seismic attribute representations. Our results demonstrate that geologic target aware selection of seismic attributes and colormaps, combined with hybrid prompting, enhances the separability of geological features and improves boundary delineation and segmentation accuracy relative to point based prompting alone. Our findings show that, when these components are jointly applied, the model can achieve competitive segmentation performance in a fully zero shot setting, thereby eliminating the need to retrain the model for each geologic feature. This work establishes a practical and scalable pathway to leverage foundation models in seismic interpretation, reducing reliance on labeled data while preserving model generality.

Abstract

The advent of large pretrained foundation models for computer vision has significantly improved the efficiency of visual data interpretation. The Segment Anything Model (SAM), in particular, offers powerful zero shot segmentation capabilities through prompt based interaction, thus making it a promising tool for seismic interpretation. However, most existing applications of SAM rely on fine tuning for specific geological targets, which requires extensive labeled data, incurs high computational cost, and often compromises the model's generalization capability. In this study, we introduce a principled framework for zero shot adaptation of foundation models to seismic data. The framework is built on two key components: (1) aligning seismic attributes and visualization choices (e.g., colormaps) with the geological target of interest, and (2) employing a hybrid prompting strategy that combines sparse user defined point prompts with dense mask prompts derived from SAM's internal feature activations. We systematically evaluate this framework across multiple geological targets, datasets, prompt configurations, and seismic attribute representations. Our results demonstrate that geologic target aware selection of seismic attributes and colormaps, combined with hybrid prompting, enhances the separability of geological features and improves boundary delineation and segmentation accuracy relative to point based prompting alone. Our findings show that, when these components are jointly applied, SAM can achieve competitive segmentation performance in a fully zero shot setting, thereby eliminating the need to retrain SAM for each geologic feature. This work establishes a practical and scalable pathway to leverage foundation models in seismic interpretation, reducing reliance on labeled data while preserving model generality.

item.title: Object Tokens as a Bridge Between Segmentation and Visual Question Answering in Robotic Surgery
item.author: Yiping Li, Ronald de Jong, Romy van Jaarsveld, Franco Badaloni, Gino Kuiper, Jelle Ruurda, Josien Pluim, Marcel Breeuwer
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种用于机器人手术的视觉问答统一框架，该框架在单一模型内联合执行像素级分割和视觉问答。通过整合视觉语言模型与基于分割一切模型的解码器，并将场景元素表示为对象令牌，该方法实现了视觉感知与语言推理的深度融合，显著提升了手术场景的细粒度理解能力。

背景: 机器人手术中的视觉问答需要高级理解复杂手术场景，并将视觉感知与语言推理相结合，以支持手术培训和术中决策。尽管近期的视觉语言模型通过参数高效微调展现出良好性能，但现有方法多依赖粗粒度的视觉定位（通常限于边界框），无法捕捉手术对象的细粒度空间结构。

目的: 旨在解决现有方法无法捕捉手术对象细粒度空间结构的问题，提出一种统一框架，在单一框架内联合执行像素级分割和视觉问答，以增强视觉推理能力并提供显式的像素级定位。

方法: 提出一种统一框架，整合视觉语言模型与基于分割一切模型的解码器。将场景元素表示为视觉语言模型生成的对象令牌，这些令牌引导答案预测并投影至解码器以生成分割掩码。通过同时优化对象令牌嵌入的分割和问答目标，模型学习空间定位的表示。

主要发现: 在私有RAMIE数据集和公共EndoVis18数据集上的评估表明，该方法在手术视觉问答任务中持续优于基线方法。结果表明，将上下文感知的对象令牌整合到视觉语言模型中，能够提高对手术场景的细粒度理解。

结论: 所提出的统一框架通过联合优化分割和问答目标，实现了视觉感知与语言推理的有效结合，显著提升了机器人手术场景的细粒度理解能力，为手术培训和术中决策提供了更好的支持。

翻译: Visual Question Answering (VQA) in robotic surgery, referred to as surgical VQA, requires high-level understanding of complex surgical scenes and the integration of visual perception with language reasoning, with the potential to support surgical training and intraoperative decision-making. Recent Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have shown promising performance through parameter-efficient fine-tuning; however, most existing approaches rely on coarse visual grounding, typically limited to bounding boxes, which fails to capture the fine-grained spatial structure of surgical objects. In this work, we propose a unified framework that jointly performs pixel-level segmentation and visual question answering within a single framework. Our approach integrates a VLM with a Segment Anything Model (SAM)-based decoder and represents scene elements as object tokens generated by the VLM. These object tokens guide answer prediction and are further projected to the SAM-based decoder to produce segmentation masks. By optimizing the object token embeddings through both segmentation and question answering objectives, the model learns spatially grounded representations that enhance visual reasoning while providing explicit pixel-level grounding. We evaluate the proposed method on the private RAMIE (Robot-Assisted Minimally Invasive Esophagectomy) dataset and the public EndoVis18 dataset, where it consistently outperforms baseline methods for surgical VQA. These results demonstrate that incorporating context-aware object tokens into vision-language models improves fine-grained surgical scene understanding.

Abstract

Visual Question Answering (VQA) in robotic surgery, referred to as surgical VQA, requires high-level understanding of complex surgical scenes and the integration of visual perception with language reasoning, with the potential to support surgical training and intraoperative decision-making. Recent Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have shown promising performance through parameter-efficient fine-tuning; however, most existing approaches rely on coarse visual grounding, typically limited to bounding boxes, which fails to capture the fine-grained spatial structure of surgical objects. In this work, we propose a unified framework that jointly performs pixel-level segmentation and visual question answering within a single framework. Our approach integrates a VLM with a Segment Anything Model (SAM)-based decoder and represents scene elements as object tokens generated by the VLM. These object tokens guide answer prediction and are further projected to the SAM-based decoder to produce segmentation masks. By optimizing the object token embeddings through both segmentation and question answering objectives, the model learns spatially grounded representations that enhance visual reasoning while providing explicit pixel-level grounding. We evaluate the proposed method on the private RAMIE (Robot-Assisted Minimally Invasive Esophagectomy) dataset and the public EndoVis18 dataset, where it consistently outperforms baseline methods for surgical VQA. These results demonstrate that incorporating context-aware object tokens into vision-language models improves fine-grained surgical scene understanding.

item.title: UrbanWell: Benchmarking Multimodal Large Language Models for Spatio-Temporal Urban Wellbeing Analytics
item.author: Yanxin Xi, Xiang Su, Jie Feng, Yu Liu, Sasu Tarkoma, Pan Hui
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: UrbanWell是一个大规模基准测试，旨在系统评估多模态大语言模型在城市福祉分析中的时空推理能力。

背景: 从多模态数据理解城市福祉需要整合异构的空间和时间信号，这对当前的多模态大语言模型构成了重大挑战。

目的: 设计UrbanWell基准测试，通过联合建模卫星图像和街景图像，系统评估多模态大语言模型在城市福祉分析中的时空推理能力。

方法: UrbanWell涵盖38个城市多年的数据，包含环境条件、空间可达性、城市形态、城市活力和主观感知属性等指标，所有指标在网格级别对齐以实现标准化评估。定义了包括从历史观测中预测未来值和时序趋势分类在内的时序推理任务。在零样本设置下对15种最先进的多模态大语言模型进行了基准测试。

主要发现: 多模态大语言模型能够捕捉显著的空间和感知线索，但在跨越环境和主观感知的异构城市指标上，其性能存在显著差异。

结论: UrbanWell为评估城市福祉分析中的多模态时空推理提供了一个统一的基准测试，为多模态城市智能的系统评估和未来研究提供了标准化测试平台。

翻译: Understanding urban wellbeing from multimodal data requires integrating heterogeneous spatial and temporal signals, posing significant challenges for current multimodal large language models (MLLMs). We introduce UrbanWell, a large-scale benchmark designed to systematically evaluate the spatio-temporal reasoning capabilities of MLLMs for urban wellbeing analytics through joint modeling of satellite and street view imagery. UrbanWell spans 38 cities across multiple years and includes diverse indicators covering (1) environmental conditions (CO2, NO2, PM2.5, and Normalized Difference Vegetation Index), (2) spatial accessibility (minimum distance to supermarkets and restaurants), (3) urban form (road length, road density, and land use), (4) urban vitality (population, economic activity diversity, and land use diversity), and (5) subjective perception attributes (e.g., safety, beauty, liveliness, wealth, and quietness). All indicators are aligned at grid level to enable standardized evaluation. Beyond static prediction, UrbanWell defines temporal reasoning tasks, including future value forecasting from historical observations and temporal trend classification. We benchmark 15 state-of-the-art representative MLLMs in a zero-shot setting, providing a comprehensive comparative evaluation across spatial and temporal dimensions. Experimental results indicate that while MLLMs capture salient spatial and perceptual cues, their performance varies substantially across heterogeneous urban indicators spanning environment and subjective perception. UrbanWell serves as a unified benchmark for evaluating multimodal spatial and temporal reasoning in urban wellbeing analytics, offering a standardized testbed for systematic assessment and future research on multimodal urban intelligence. Our codes and datasets are accessible via https://github.com/axin1301/UrbanWell-Benchmark.

Abstract

Understanding urban wellbeing from multimodal data requires integrating heterogeneous spatial and temporal signals, posing significant challenges for current multimodal large language models (MLLMs). We introduce UrbanWell, a large-scale benchmark designed to systematically evaluate the spatio-temporal reasoning capabilities of MLLMs for urban wellbeing analytics through joint modeling of satellite and street view imagery. UrbanWell spans 38 cities across multiple years and includes diverse indicators covering (1) environmental conditions (CO$_2$, NO$_2$, PM${2.5}$, and Normalized Difference Vegetation Index), (2) spatial accessibility (minimum distance to supermarkets and restaurants), (3) urban form (road length, road density, and land use), (4) urban vitality (population, economic activity diversity, and land use diversity), and (5) subjective perception attributes (e.g., safety, beauty, liveliness, wealth, and quietness). All indicators are aligned at grid level to enable standardized evaluation. Beyond static prediction, UrbanWell defines temporal reasoning tasks, including future value forecasting from historical observations and temporal trend classification. We benchmark 15 state-of-the-art representative MLLMs in a zero-shot setting, providing a comprehensive comparative evaluation across spatial and temporal dimensions. Experimental results indicate that while MLLMs capture salient spatial and perceptual cues, their performance varies substantially across heterogeneous urban indicators spanning environment and subjective perception. UrbanWell serves as a unified benchmark for evaluating multimodal spatial and temporal reasoning in urban wellbeing analytics, offering a standardized testbed for systematic assessment and future research on multimodal urban intelligence. Our codes and datasets are accessible via https://github.com/axin1301/UrbanWell-Benchmark.

item.title: Learning Directional Semantic Transitions for Longitudinal Chest X-ray Analysis
item.author: Zhangfeng Hu, Zefan Yang, Ge Wang, Tanveer Syeda-Mahmood, Anushree Burade, Mannudeep Kalra, Pingkun Yan
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出ProTrans框架，将疾病进展建模为成对胸部X光研究之间的方向性语义转换，利用放射学报告锚定个体X光表示并引入可学习的进展特征图以编码状态间的语义变化，通过反向时间建模和双向重建一致性实现方向感知，在纵向下游任务中表现优于现有方法。

背景: 胸部X光解释通常需要纵向比较以评估疾病进展。现有方法通常依赖时间特征融合或研究间差异建模，但在捕捉细微进展语义方面存在局限，并忽视了疾病轨迹固有的方向性本质。

目的: 提出一种新的视觉语言预训练框架ProTrans，旨在将疾病进展形式化为成对胸部X光研究之间的方向性语义转换，以解决现有方法在捕捉细微进展语义和方向性方面的不足。

方法: 利用放射学报告将个体胸部X光表示锚定在可解释的疾病状态中；引入可学习的进展特征图以显式编码状态间的语义变化，并与报告衍生的进展描述对齐；采用反向时间建模过程以强制方向感知；施加状态和转换之间的双向重建一致性以解耦方向性语义并促进连贯的轨迹建模。

主要发现: 在包括疾病进展分类和进展描述生成在内的纵向下游任务上的广泛实验表明，ProTrans一致地优于现有方法。

结论: ProTrans建立了一个用于纵向胸部X光理解的统一预训练框架。

翻译: Chest X-ray (CXR) interpretation often requires longitudinal comparison to assess disease progression. Existing approaches typically rely on temporal feature fusion or inter-study discrepancy modeling, yet remain limited in capturing subtle progression semantics and overlook the inherently directional nature of disease trajectories. In this paper, we propose ProTrans, a novel vision-language pretraining framework that formulates disease progression as a directional semantic transition between paired CXR studies. ProTrans leverages radiology reports to anchor individual CXR representations within interpretable disease states, and introduces a learnable progression feature map to explicitly encode semantic shifts between states, aligned with report-derived progression descriptions. To enforce direction-aware perception, ProTrans incorporates a reversed temporal modeling process and imposes bidirectional reconstruction consistency across states and transitions, thereby disentangling directional semantics and promoting coherent trajectory modeling. Extensive experiments on longitudinal downstream tasks, including disease progression classification and progression captioning, demonstrate that ProTrans consistently outperforms existing methods, establishing a unified pretraining framework for longitudinal CXR understanding. https://github.com/RPIDIAL/ProTrans

Abstract

Chest X-ray (CXR) interpretation often requires longitudinal comparison to assess disease progression. Existing approaches typically rely on temporal feature fusion or inter-study discrepancy modeling, yet remain limited in capturing subtle progression semantics and overlook the inherently directional nature of disease trajectories. In this paper, we propose ProTrans, a novel vision-language pretraining framework that formulates disease progression as a directional semantic transition between paired CXR studies. ProTrans leverages radiology reports to anchor individual CXR representations within interpretable disease states, and introduces a learnable progression feature map to explicitly encode semantic shifts between states, aligned with report-derived progression descriptions. To enforce direction-aware perception, ProTrans incorporates a reversed temporal modeling process and imposes bidirectional reconstruction consistency across states and transitions, thereby disentangling directional semantics and promoting coherent trajectory modeling. Extensive experiments on longitudinal downstream tasks, including disease progression classification and progression captioning, demonstrate that ProTrans consistently outperforms existing methods, establishing a unified pretraining framework for longitudinal CXR understanding. https://github.com/RPIDIAL/ProTrans

item.title: You Don't Need Strong Assumptions: Visual Representation Learning via Temporal Differences
item.author: Ninad Daithankar, Alexi Gladstone, Yann LeCun, Heng Ji
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为视觉时序差分的新范式，用于从视频中学习自监督表示。该方法避免了现有的强归纳偏置，仅依赖过去导致未来的因果假设，通过联合训练图像编码器和运动编码器，使得当前帧表示加上编码后的运动等于下一帧表示。实验表明，该方法在密集空间任务上达到了最先进水平，为无需强假设的表示学习奠定了基础。

背景: 人工智能的进步主要由假设较少的方法推动。随着计算能力和数据的增加，具有较弱归纳偏置的方法通常优于具有较强假设的方法。在视觉表示学习领域，方法已从监督学习发展到弱监督学习，再到如今广泛成功的无人类标签的自监督学习。然而，现代自监督学习方法仍然依赖于增强、掩码或裁剪等强归纳偏置。

目的: 寻找依赖更少假设的方法，以解决随着数据规模增长，现有强归纳偏置可能成为瓶颈的问题。

方法: 引入视觉时序差分方法，这是一种从视频中学习自监督的新范式。它避免现有的强归纳偏置，仅依赖过去导致未来的因果假设。具体通过联合训练图像编码器和运动编码器，使得当前帧的表示加上编码后的运动等于下一帧的表示。

主要发现: 随着数据量的增加，最优的归纳偏置强度会下降。视觉时序差分方法在不利用任何强归纳偏置的情况下，在密集空间任务上达到了最先进的方法水平。

结论: 视觉时序差分方法为无需强假设的表示学习奠定了基础。

翻译: 人工智能的进步主要由假设较少的方法推动。随着计算能力和数据的增加，具有较弱归纳偏置的方法通常优于具有较强假设的方法。在视觉表示学习领域，方法已从监督学习发展到弱监督学习，再到如今广泛成功的无人类标签的自监督学习。然而，现代自监督学习方法仍然依赖于增强、掩码或裁剪等强归纳偏置。如果这一趋势持续，这些剩余的偏置在大规模下可能成为瓶颈——我们的实验证实了这一点：随着数据的增长，最优的归纳偏置强度会下降。这促使我们寻找依赖更少假设的方法。为此，我们引入了视觉时序差分，这是一种从视频中学习自监督的新范式，它避免了现有的归纳偏置，仅依赖过去导致未来的因果假设。视觉时序差分通过联合训练图像编码器和运动编码器来运作，使得当前帧的表示加上编码后的运动等于下一帧的表示。尽管没有利用任何强归纳偏置，视觉时序差分在密集空间任务上达到了最先进的方法水平，为无需强假设的表示学习奠定了基础。

Abstract

Progress in AI has largely been driven by methods that assume less. As compute and data increase, approaches with weaker inductive biases generally outperform those with stronger assumptions. This is particularly characteristic of the field of Visual Representation Learning, where approaches have gone from being dominated by Supervised Learning, to Weakly Supervised Learning, to the now widespread success of Self-Supervised Learning without human labels. Yet, even modern Self-Supervised Learning approaches still depend on strong inductive biases such as augmentations, masking, or cropping. If this trend holds, even these remaining biases should become bottlenecks at scale -- and our experiments confirm this: the optimal strength of inductive biases decreases as data grows. This motivates the search for approaches that rely on fewer assumptions. To this end, we introduce Temporal Difference in Vision (TDV), a new paradigm for self-supervised learning from video that avoids existing inductive biases, relying instead on a causal assumption that the past causes the future. TDV functions by jointly training an image encoder and a motion encoder so that the current frame's representation plus the encoded motion equals the next frame's representation. Despite not leveraging any strong inductive biases, TDV matches state-of-the-art recipes on dense spatial tasks, laying the foundation for representation learning without strong assumptions.

item.title: PreLort: Prefix-Nested LoRA for Federated Fine-Tuning under Rank Heterogeneity
item.author: Muhammad Waseem, Nurbek Tastan, Andrej Jovanovic, Nicholas D. Lane, Nils Lukas, Karthik Nandakumar, Samuel Horvath
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为PreLort的联邦低秩微调方法，通过嵌套低秩公式和分层前缀结构解决异构硬件资源下的模型聚合问题，有效提升了模型精度和性能。

背景: 使用参数高效方法如LoRA进行大语言模型的联邦微调可以保护隐私，但异构硬件资源导致不同客户端的适配器秩不同，难以直接聚合。现有方法虽能处理异构秩，但未能控制信息在秩维度上的分布，导致共享低秩表示的利用不充分。

目的: 提出一种新的联邦LoRA方法，通过组织适配器维度为前缀层次结构，确保低秩维度编码任务相关信息，高秩维度捕获额外容量，从而优化信息分布和聚合效果。

方法: 提出PreLort方法，包括：1. 嵌套低秩公式，将适配器维度组织为前缀层次结构；2. 分段聚合规则，仅对贡献每个秩段的客户端进行平均，避免低秩客户端的零填充稀释；3. 前缀嵌套训练策略，在多个秩截断下优化每个适配器，促使有用信号集中在低秩前缀维度。

主要发现: 实验表明，该方法在多个基础模型上 consistently 优于先前的异构联邦LoRA方法，在精度和ROUGE-L指标上表现更好，同时实现了更低或相当的困惑度。

结论: PreLort方法通过一致的秩前缀学习和聚合，使低秩客户端能够从更高秩客户端贡献的丰富信息中受益，有效解决了异构联邦学习中的挑战。

翻译: Federated fine-tuning of large language models using parameter-efficient methods such as LoRA enables privacy-preserving adaptation of foundation models. Heterogeneous hardware resources introduce challenges, as clients with different adapter ranks cannot be directly aggregated. While existing methods enable aggregation under heterogeneous ranks, they fail to control how information is distributed across rank dimensions, leading to suboptimal use of shared low-rank representations. Instead, we propose PreLort: a nested low-rank formulation for federated LoRA that organizes adapter dimensions into a prefix hierarchy. Our approach ensures that lower-rank dimensions encode task-relevant information, while higher-rank dimensions capture additional capacity. Building on this, we introduce (i) a segment-wise aggregation rule that averages only over clients contributing to each rank segment, avoiding dilution from zero-padded lower-rank clients, and (ii) a prefix-nested training strategy that optimizes each adapter under multiple rank truncations, encouraging useful signal to concentrate in low-rank prefix dimensions. Together, these components encourage a consistent low-rank prefix capturing the most task-relevant information, while higher-rank dimensions learn additional capacity. This allows low-rank clients to benefit from richer information contributed by higher-rank clients, as prefix dimensions are consistently learned and aggregated. Experiments demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms prior heterogeneous federated LoRA methods in accuracy and ROUGE-L, while achieving lower or comparable perplexity across multiple base models.

Abstract

Federated fine-tuning of large language models using parameter-efficient methods such as LoRA enables privacy-preserving adaptation of foundation models. Heterogeneous hardware resources introduce challenges, as clients with different adapter ranks cannot be directly aggregated. While existing methods enable aggregation under heterogeneous ranks, they fail to control how information is distributed across rank dimensions, leading to suboptimal use of shared low-rank representations. Instead, we propose PreLort: a nested low-rank formulation for federated LoRA that organizes adapter dimensions into a prefix hierarchy. Our approach ensures that lower-rank dimensions encode task-relevant information, while higher-rank dimensions capture additional capacity. Building on this, we introduce (i) a segment-wise aggregation rule that averages only over clients contributing to each rank segment, avoiding dilution from zero-padded lower-rank clients, and (ii) a prefix-nested training strategy that optimizes each adapter under multiple rank truncations, encouraging useful signal to concentrate in low-rank prefix dimensions. Together, these components encourage a consistent low-rank prefix capturing the most task-relevant information, while higher-rank dimensions learn additional capacity. This allows low-rank clients to benefit from richer information contributed by higher-rank clients, as prefix dimensions are consistently learned and aggregated. Experiments demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms prior heterogeneous federated LoRA methods in accuracy and ROUGE-L, while achieving lower or comparable perplexity across multiple base models.

item.title: PromptShift-CRC: Drift-Aware Conformal Risk Control for Foundation Models Under Prompt and Domain Shift
item.author: Jeffery Opoku, David Banahene
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为 PromptShift CRC 的漂移感知共形风险控制方法，用于应对基础模型在提示和领域漂移情况下的输出风险。

背景: 基础模型现在被用于提示快速变化的环境中，用户、主题和政策的变化可能导致模型突然面临校准数据中罕见的请求，使得固定校准变得有风险。共形预测和共形风险控制提供了模型无关的错误控制方法，但在校准数据与未来数据相似时效果最佳。

目的: 开发一种能够适应提示和领域漂移的共形风险控制方法，以控制基础模型输出的风险。

方法: 提出 PromptShift CRC 方法，该方法嵌入提示和响应，测量当前提示流与校准池之间的距离，为相关或近期的校准示例赋予更高权重，并在观察到违规后在线更新风险水平。

主要发现: 该方法报告了三种实用诊断：实现的风险误差、提示漂移和有效校准大小。在合成提示漂移基准测试中，静态共形风险控制方法在漂移后表现急剧下降，而 PromptShift-CRC 在考虑的自适应基线中提供了最佳的覆盖率。

结论: 该方法在分布不匹配和加权分位数不确定性的条件下控制风险，并在公共基准派生流上进行了评估，涵盖了问答、毒性、摘要事实性和长上下文幻觉风险。

翻译: Foundation models are now used in settings where the prompts they receive can change quickly. Users change, topics change, policies change, and the model may suddenly face a kind of request that was rare in the calibration data. This makes fixed calibration risky. Conformal prediction and conformal risk control give model-agnostic ways to control error, but they work best when the calibration data still look like the future data. This paper develops PromptShift CRC, a drift-aware conformal risk control method for foundation-model outputs under prompt and domain shift. The method embeds prompts and responses, measures how far the current prompt stream has moved from the calibration pool, gives more weight to relevant or recent calibration examples, and updates the risk level online after observed violations. It reports three practical diagnostics: realized risk error, prompt drift, and effective calibration size. We give conditions under which the method controls risk up to terms for distribution mismatch and weighted quantile uncertainty. In a synthetic prompt-shift benchmark, static conformal risk control fails sharply after drift, while PromptShift-CRC gives the best coverage among the adaptive baselines considered. We then evaluate the same calibration layer on public benchmark derived streams for question answering, toxicity, summarization factuality, and long-context hallucination risk

Abstract

Foundation models are now used in settings where the prompts they receive can change quickly. Users change, topics change, policies change, and the model may suddenly face a kind of request that was rare in the calibration data. This makes fixed calibration risky. Conformal prediction and conformal risk control give model-agnostic ways to control error, but they work best when the calibration data still look like the future data. This paper develops PromptShift CRC, a drift-aware conformal risk control method for foundation-model outputs under prompt and domain shift. The method embeds prompts and responses, measures how far the current prompt stream has moved from the calibration pool, gives more weight to relevant or recent calibration examples, and updates the risk level online after observed violations. It reports three practical diagnostics: realized risk error, prompt drift, and effective calibration size. We give conditions under which the method controls risk up to terms for distribution mismatch and weighted quantile uncertainty. In a synthetic prompt-shift benchmark, static conformal risk control fails sharply after drift, while PromptShift-CRC gives the best coverage among the adaptive baselines considered. We then evaluate the same calibration layer on public benchmark derived streams for question answering, toxicity, summarization factuality, and long-context hallucination risk

item.title: Classifying by Proxy: Explainable and Reproducible Ensemble of Proxy Tasks for Child Sexual Abuse Imagery Classification
item.author: Clara Ernesto, Carlos Caetano, Sandra Avila, João Macedo, Camila Laranjeira, Leo S. F. Ribeiro
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种基于代理任务集合的儿童性虐待图像分类系统，旨在提高模型的可复现性、可解释性和安全性。

背景: 儿童性虐待图像分类系统有助于减轻执法人员的心理压力并高效移除网络上的相关图像。然而，由于图像敏感且数据集访问受限，现有研究难以复现、分发和比较。此外，现有模型普遍缺乏执法人员所需的可解释性。

目的: 开发一种能够提高可复现性、可解释性和安全性的儿童性虐待图像分类模型，以满足执法机构的需求。

方法: 应用代理任务集合，这些任务与儿童性虐待图像分类相关。从相关文献中选择新颖的代理任务组合，并对原始框架进行训练调整。

主要发现: 最终模型在RCPD数据集上取得了百分之九十一点九的平衡准确率。与最佳表示学习模型DINO相比，该集合模型提高了准确率，并提供了分类结果的解释，而单一深度学习模型通常难以提供此类解释。

结论: 基于代理任务集合的方法在儿童性虐待图像分类任务中表现优异，不仅提升了性能，还增强了模型的可解释性，为执法工作提供了更有效的工具。

翻译: Child Sexual Abuse Imagery (CSAI) classification systems are needed solutions for lessening the psychological impacts often felt by law enforcement agents responsible for evaluating these materials and for efficient removal of these materials from the web. However, due to the nature of the task, researching and developing such systems is not a trivial endeavor. The images are highly sensitive, and the related datasets are under restrictive access regimes, which means most studies in the area are not reproducible or distributable and are therefore hard to compare and validate. More concerning still, most models for this task today lack an aspect often desired by law enforcement agents: explainability. In this paper, we apply an ensemble of Proxy Tasks -- tasks that correlate to CSAI classification -- yielding improvements in reproducibility, explainability, and security for distribution. This concept is applied for the first time to real CSAI, with a novel selection of relevant Proxy Tasks (selected from the CSAI literature) and training adaptations to the original framework. Our final model achieves competitive results, yielding 91.9% balanced accuracy on the RCPD dataset with the best Proxy Task combination. We furthermore contrast these results with the best-in-class representation learning model, DINO, and show that our ensemble improves accuracy and provides explanations for its classification results, a feature that a single deep learning model can seldom provide.

Abstract

Child Sexual Abuse Imagery (CSAI) classification systems are needed solutions for lessening the psychological impacts often felt by law enforcement agents responsible for evaluating these materials and for efficient removal of these materials from the web. However, due to the nature of the task, researching and developing such systems is not a trivial endeavor. The images are highly sensitive, and the related datasets are under restrictive access regimes, which means most studies in the area are not reproducible or distributable and are therefore hard to compare and validate. More concerning still, most models for this task today lack an aspect often desired by law enforcement agents: explainability. In this paper, we apply an ensemble of Proxy Tasks -- tasks that correlate to CSAI classification -- yielding improvements in reproducibility, explainability, and security for distribution. This concept is applied for the first time to real CSAI, with a novel selection of relevant Proxy Tasks (selected from the CSAI literature) and training adaptations to the original framework. Our final model achieves competitive results, yielding 91.9% balanced accuracy on the RCPD dataset with the best Proxy Task combination. We furthermore contrast these results with the best-in-class representation learning model, DINO, and show that our ensemble improves accuracy and provides explanations for its classification results, a feature that a single deep learning model can seldom provide.

item.title: Who Flips? Self- and Cross-Model Counterarguments Reveal Answer Instability in LLMs
item.author: Nikeghbal, Nafiseh, Kargaran, Amir Hossein, Kolli, Shaghayegh, Diesner, Jana
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种评估大语言模型答案稳定性的受控协议，通过引入对抗性反驳来测试模型在坚持正确回答时的表现，并发布了相关协议、挑战记录及数据集。

背景: 现有的标准准确率基准测试旨在评估大语言模型接近正确答案的程度，但不适合测试模型在面对合理反驳时是否能坚持正确的答案。

目的: 引入一种受控协议来评估答案的稳定性，即测量模型在回答正确后，面对针对错误选项的连贯反驳时是否会改变答案。

方法: 在模型正确回答多项选择题后，使用连贯的论点挑战模型的答案，并测量模型是否改变答案。该设置将论证内容与明显的社会压力隔离，并变化论证长度、自我归因和跨模型来源。

主要发现: 在七个前沿模型和五十七个学科中，答案改变率从百分之十七点五到百分之九十七点三不等。自我归因始终增加改变率。跨模型汇集错误答案论点并选择最有效的挑战比依赖单一来源模型产生更强的对抗性挑战。构建的 MaxFlip 挑战集比标准自生成挑战将改变率提高了最多百分之二十三点六。

结论: 标准准确率指标无法捕捉模型稳定性的巨大差异，本文发布的协议、挑战记录和 MaxFlip 数据集支持在标准准确率基准测试之外进行稳定性评估。

翻译: Standard accuracy benchmarks are designed to test how closely large language models (LLMs) approach correct answers, but are not suitable for testing whether LLMs stick with a correct answer when that answer is challenged by a plausible counter-argument. We introduce a controlled protocol for evaluating answer stability: after a model answers a multiple-choice question correctly, we challenge the model's answer with a coherent argument for an incorrect option and measure whether the model flips. The setup a) isolates argumentative content from overt social pressure and b) varies argument length, self-attribution, and cross-model source. Across seven frontier models and 57 MMLU subjects, flip rates range from 17.5% to 97.3%, revealing large differences in stability that are not captured by accuracy metrics alone. We find that self-attribution consistently increases flip rates (mean +7.1pp, up to +18.7pp). Also, pooling wrong-answer arguments across models and selecting the most effective one per question yields stronger adversarial challenges than relying on any single source model. We further construct MaxFlip, a curated challenge set that amplifies flips by up to +23.6pp over standard self-generated challenges. We release the protocol, challenge records, and MaxFlip to support stability evaluation alongside standard accuracy benchmarks. Materials are available at this https URL and this https URL .

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决大语言模型在面临合理反驳时能否坚持最初正确答案的问题，即评估模型的“答案稳定性”。该问题在现实和研究中非常重要，因为现有评估标准仅关注模型能否答对题目，却忽略了在实际应用中当用户或其他模型提出质疑或竞争推理时，模型是否会轻易改变正确结论。补充这一维度的评估有助于更全面地衡量模型在真实交互场景中的可靠性与鲁棒性。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者发现传统测试仅关注模型能否答对，却忽略了其在面临合理反驳时能否坚持正确答案。现有研究常将反驳内容与社交压力混为一谈，因此作者设计了两阶段控制协议：先让模型为错误选项生成论据，再在独立会话中用这些论据挑战模型，并系统改变论据长度、归属方式与来源，从而单独剥离论据内容对答案稳定性的影响。该方法明确借鉴了关于模型顺从性、论证驱动挑战及自我修正的现有研究，旨在弥补前人工作未能同时隔离多重变量及混淆社交压力的不足。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是评估大语言模型在面临合理反方论点时维持正确答案的稳定性，并将论点内容与社会压力明确区分开来。整体流程分为两阶段：首先强制模型为错误选项生成一段连贯的辩护理由；随后在独立会话中让模型正常答题，若答对则向其展示该反方论点并再次提问，通过统计其放弃原正确答案的比例来衡量稳定性。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于提出了一种控制性评估协议，专门测量大语言模型在面临合理反驳时维持正确答案的稳定性。该协议通过让模型生成错误选项的论证并发起挑战，成功将纯论证内容与显性社交压力分离开来，并系统考察了论证长度、自我归因和跨模型来源对答案稳定性的影响。相比以往研究多关注模型在用户直接质疑或社交压力下的顺从行为，本文完全去除显性对抗提示，仅通过纯论证内容测试模型，并在单一框架内同时控制并比较了多项关键变量，从而更精准地揭示了模型答案不稳定的内在机制。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出了一种仅通过论证内容评估大语言模型答案稳定性的控制协议，系统研究了论证长度、归属来源等因素对答案翻转率的影响，并发布了MAXFLIP挑战数据集以支持相关基准测试。

Abstract

Standard accuracy benchmarks are designed to test how closely large language models (LLMs) approach correct answers, but are not suitable for testing whether LLMs stick with a correct answer when that answer is challenged by a plausible counter-argument. We introduce a controlled protocol for evaluating answer stability: after a model answers a multiple-choice question correctly, we challenge the model's answer with a coherent argument for an incorrect option and measure whether the model flips. The setup a) isolates argumentative content from overt social pressure and b) varies argument length, self-attribution, and cross-model source. Across seven frontier models and 57 MMLU subjects, flip rates range from 17.5% to 97.3%, revealing large differences in stability that are not captured by accuracy metrics alone. We find that self-attribution consistently increases flip rates (mean +7.1pp, up to +18.7pp). Also, pooling wrong-answer arguments across models and selecting the most effective one per question yields stronger adversarial challenges than relying on any single source model. We further construct MaxFlip, a curated challenge set that amplifies flips by up to +23.6pp over standard self-generated challenges. We release the protocol, challenge records, and MaxFlip to support stability evaluation alongside standard accuracy benchmarks. Materials are available at this https URL and this https URL .

item.title: The Information-Theoretic Benefit of Shared Representations under Orthogonality Constraints
item.author: Thomas Dittrich, Oliver Potocki, Philipp Grohs
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文研究了在结构约束下，联合近似与单独近似在描述长度上的差异，证明了在共享潜在硬特征的情况下，联合近似在组合架构中需要更少的比特数，从而为多输出架构的描述长度效率和神经网络在几何约束下保持表达能力提供了理论见解。

背景: 现代深度学习架构日益多任务和多模态，通常结合预训练的基础模型与特定任务的微调模型。利用不同问题之间的相似性而非单独求解可以显著提升整体性能。尽管多任务学习的泛化和样本复杂度特性已被广泛研究，但联合近似与单独近似在参数复杂度方面的比较仍不太清楚，尤其是在模型需要满足等变性、守恒定律或正交性等结构约束的现代深度学习中。

目的: 探讨在结构约束下，联合近似与单独近似在描述长度上的差异，特别是当任务共享潜在硬特征时，联合近似是否能更高效。

方法: 在一致范数下，分别对单独近似类和联合近似类证明描述长度的下界和上界。通过组合由Rademacher-Haar小波级数实现的共享硬特征和用于强制输出坐标正交性的锯齿形沃尔什读出，构建一类正交函数。利用Rademacher-Haar小波的二进制树结构将近似难度集中在公共特征组件中，而读出作为特定任务的头部。使用信息论框架，获得联合编码和单独编码可实现的最佳近似率之间的显著差距。最后，通过归约到三角波近似，使用Heaviside激活函数在神经网络模型中实现这种分离。

主要发现: 即使在正交性约束下，只要任务共享一个潜在的硬特征，联合近似在组合架构中也需要严格更少的比特数。联合编码和单独编码可实现的最佳近似率之间存在显著差距。

结论: 联合近似在描述长度效率方面优于单独近似，特别是在共享潜在硬特征的情况下。这为组合多输出架构的描述长度效率提供了理论见解，并阐明了神经网络如何在几何约束下保持表达能力。

翻译: The paper studies the difference in description length between joint and separate approximation under structural constraints, proving that joint approximation requires fewer bits in compositional architectures when tasks share a latent hard feature, thus providing theoretical insights into the description length efficiency of multi-output architectures and how neural networks maintain expressivity under geometric constraints.

Abstract

Modern deep learning architectures are increasingly multi-task and multi-modal, using a pretrained foundation model combined with task-specific, fine-tuned models. Empirically, exploiting similarity across different problems, instead of solving them individually, can significantly improve overall performance. While the generalization and sample complexity properties of multitask learning have been widely studied, the parametric complexity of joint approximation in comparison to separate approximation remains less well understood. The question is particularly relevant in modern deep learning, where models are increasingly required to satisfy structural constraints such as equivariance, conservation laws, or orthogonality. We prove lower and upper bounds on the description-length for separate and joint approximation classes, respectively, in uniform norm. We build a class of orthogonal functions by composing a shared hard feature, realized by a Rademacher-Haar wavelet series, with Sawtooth-Walsh readouts to enforce orthogonality of output coordinates. The dyadic tree structure of the Rademacher-Haar wavelet concentrates the approximation hardness in the common feature component, while the readouts act as task-specific heads. Using an information-theoretic framework, we obtain a sharp gap between the optimal approximation rates achievable by joint and separate coding. Finally, we realize this separation in a neural network model using Heaviside activations via reduction to triangle-wave approximation. Our results show that even under an orthogonality constraint joint approximation requires strictly fewer bits in compositional architectures, provided the tasks share a latent hard feature. This provides theoretical insight into the description-length-efficiency of compositional multi-output architectures and clarifies how neural networks can retain expressivity under geometric constraints.

item.title: Inference-Time Decision Calibration for Temporal Classification
item.author: Arthur Chagas, Arthur Buzelin, Yan Aquino, Pedro Bento, Gisele L. Pappa, Wagner Meira, Cristiano Arbex Valle
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种用于时间分类的表示-校准分解方法，将训练好的原生分类器冻结，并在推理时分离出两种干预措施：保守的残差多尺度分支和事后分支感知校准器。该方法在不重新训练主干网络的情况下，区分了缺失的时间证据和未充分利用的决策级证据。实验表明，增益具有强烈的场景依赖性，残差多尺度证据在噪声或表示受限的设置中最为有用，而分支感知校准在原生和辅助逻辑包含互补证据时有效。结果表明，时间分类不仅应被视为表示学习，还应被视为信任、组合和校准多视角证据的问题。

背景: 时间分类错误通常被视为表示失败，但也可能源于如何将可用证据转化为决策。

目的: 提出一种表示-校准分解方法，以区分缺失的时间证据和未充分利用的决策级证据，而不重新训练主干网络。

方法: 保持训练好的原生分类器冻结，分离两种推理时干预措施：一是保守的残差多尺度分支，添加辅助逻辑到原生预测中；二是事后分支感知校准器，在决策时重新组合原生和残差证据。

主要发现: 在多个数据集上的实验表明，增益具有强烈的场景依赖性。残差多尺度证据在噪声或表示受限的设置（如短视界数据集和较弱的循环主干）中最为有用。分支感知校准在原生和辅助逻辑包含互补证据且原始决策规则未充分利用时有效。接近饱和的设置中，两种干预措施的增益有限。

结论: 时间分类不应仅被视为表示学习，还应被视为信任、组合和校准来自多视角证据的问题。

翻译: Temporal classification errors are often treated as representation failures, but they can also arise from how available evidence is converted into decisions. This paper proposes a representation--calibration decomposition for temporal classification. We keep a trained native classifier frozen and separate two inference-time interventions: a conservative residual multi-scale branch that adds auxiliary logits to the native prediction, and a post-hoc branch-aware calibrator that recombines native and residual evidence at decision time. This design distinguishes missing temporal evidence from underused decision-level evidence without retraining the backbone. Across FI-2010, PTB-XL, UCI-HAR, MHEALTH, and HARTH, we find that gains are strongly regime-dependent. Residual multi-scale evidence is most useful in noisy or representation-limited settings, especially short-horizon FI-2010 and weaker recurrent backbones, while branch-aware calibration helps when native and auxiliary logits contain complementary evidence not fully exploited by the raw decision rule. Near-saturated settings show limited gains from either intervention. These results suggest that temporal classification should be understood not only as representation learning, but also as the problem of trusting, combining, and calibrating evidence from multiple views.

Abstract

Temporal classification errors are often treated as representation failures, but they can also arise from how available evidence is converted into decisions. This paper proposes a representation--calibration decomposition for temporal classification. We keep a trained native classifier frozen and separate two inference-time interventions: a conservative residual multi-scale branch that adds auxiliary logits to the native prediction, and a post-hoc branch-aware calibrator that recombines native and residual evidence at decision time. This design distinguishes missing temporal evidence from underused decision-level evidence without retraining the backbone. Across FI-2010, PTB-XL, UCI-HAR, MHEALTH, and HARTH, we find that gains are strongly regime-dependent. Residual multi-scale evidence is most useful in noisy or representation-limited settings, especially short-horizon FI-2010 and weaker recurrent backbones, while branch-aware calibration helps when native and auxiliary logits contain complementary evidence not fully exploited by the raw decision rule. Near-saturated settings show limited gains from either intervention. These results suggest that temporal classification should be understood not only as representation learning, but also as the problem of trusting, combining, and calibrating evidence from multiple views.

item.title: Circuit Tracing in Autoregressive Protein Language Models
item.author: Darin Tsui, William Deinzer, Daniel Saeedi, Amirali Aghazadeh
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: ProGenMech是一个用于生成式蛋白质语言模型ProGen3的机制可解释性框架，通过扩展跨层转码器重建层间生成计算，并开发零样本电路发现框架以识别负责蛋白质生成和适应性预测的稀疏潜在电路。该框架在因果生成和零样本适应性估计任务中优于局部转码器基线，在跨度填充任务中匹配原始模型的生成分布，恢复的电路揭示了与保守序列模式和蛋白质适应性景观相关的生物学有意义的基序和功能区域。

背景: 蛋白质语言模型能够生成具有自然界中未见性质的新颖蛋白质序列，但其生成机制尚不清楚。现有的基于稀疏自编码器和转码器的机制可解释性方法主要关注蛋白质表示学习模型，未能捕捉自回归生成所需的计算过程。

目的: 开发一种针对生成式蛋白质语言模型的机制可解释性框架，以理解并重建其生成计算过程，并识别负责蛋白质生成和适应性预测的稀疏潜在电路。

方法: 引入ProGenMech框架，将跨层转码器扩展到ProGen3模型。跨层转码器利用所有前序层的稀疏潜在变量重建每一层，以忠实恢复层间生成计算。同时开发零样本电路发现框架，用于识别稀疏潜在电路。

主要发现: 在因果生成和零样本适应性估计任务中，ProGenMech在恢复ProGen3的概率分布和功能评分行为方面优于局部转码器基线；在跨度填充任务中，其生成分布与原始模型匹配。恢复的电路揭示了与保守序列模式和蛋白质适应性景观相关的生物学有意义的基序和功能区域。

结论: ProGenMech为可解释且可控的蛋白质生成奠定了基础，通过揭示生物学有意义的机制，增强了生成式蛋白质语言模型的可解释性。

翻译: Protein language models (pLMs) can generate novel protein sequences with properties beyond those observed in nature, yet the mechanisms underlying protein generation remain poorly understood. Existing mechanistic interpretability methods based on sparse autoencoders and transcoders primarily focus on protein representation learning models and do not capture the computation required for autoregressive generation. Here, we introduce ProGenMech, a mechanistic interpretability framework for generative protein language models that extends cross-layer transcoders (CLTs) to ProGen3, a sparse Mixture-of-Experts model trained for both causal generation and span infilling. Unlike per-layer approaches, CLTs reconstruct each layer using sparse latent variables from all preceding layers, enabling faithful recovery of inter-layer generative computation. We further develop a zero-shot circuit discovery framework to identify sparse latent circuits responsible for protein generation and fitness prediction. In causal generation and zero-shot fitness estimation tasks, ProGenMech outperforms local transcoder baselines in recovering ProGen3's probability distribution and functional scoring behavior, while matching the original model's generative distribution in span infilling tasks. Moreover, the recovered circuits reveal biologically meaningful motifs and functional regions associated with conserved sequence patterns and protein fitness landscapes, establishing a foundation for interpretable and steerable protein generation.

Abstract

Protein language models (pLMs) can generate novel protein sequences with properties beyond those observed in nature, yet the mechanisms underlying protein generation remain poorly understood. Existing mechanistic interpretability methods based on sparse autoencoders and transcoders primarily focus on protein representation learning models and do not capture the computation required for autoregressive generation. Here, we introduce ProGenMech, a mechanistic interpretability framework for generative protein language models that extends cross-layer transcoders (CLTs) to ProGen3, a sparse Mixture-of-Experts model trained for both causal generation and span infilling. Unlike per-layer approaches, CLTs reconstruct each layer using sparse latent variables from all preceding layers, enabling faithful recovery of inter-layer generative computation. We further develop a zero-shot circuit discovery framework to identify sparse latent circuits responsible for protein generation and fitness prediction. In causal generation and zero-shot fitness estimation tasks, ProGenMech outperforms local transcoder baselines in recovering ProGen3's probability distribution and functional scoring behavior, while matching the original model's generative distribution in span infilling tasks. Moreover, the recovered circuits reveal biologically meaningful motifs and functional regions associated with conserved sequence patterns and protein fitness landscapes, establishing a foundation for interpretable and steerable protein generation.

item.title: Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Visual Grounding for Remote Sensing Images and Videos
item.author: Ke Li, Di Wang, Yongshan Zhu, Ting Wang, Weiping Ni, Tao Lei, Quan Wang, Xinbo Gao
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 遥感视觉定位旨在根据自然语言描述在遥感图像或视频中定位目标。现有方法依赖人工标注，成本高且难以覆盖真实场景的多样性，导致泛化能力不足。本文提出RSVG-ZeroOV框架，利用冻结的通用基础模型实现零样本开放词汇遥感视觉定位。该框架遵循概述-聚焦-演进的范式，结合视觉语言模型和扩散模型的注意力模式，逐步生成精确的定位结果。针对视频输入，还提出了Video RSVG-ZeroOV，通过关键帧选择器和时间传播器实现时空定位。实验表明，该方法在多个基准上优于现有零样本基线，并与弱监督和全监督方法竞争或更优。

背景: 遥感视觉定位旨在根据自然语言描述在遥感图像或视频中定位目标。现有方法依赖人工标注，成本高且难以覆盖真实场景的多样性，导致泛化能力不足。

目的: 提出RSVG-ZeroOV框架，利用冻结的通用基础模型实现零样本开放词汇遥感视觉定位，解决现有方法泛化能力不足的问题。

方法: RSVG-ZeroOV遵循概述-聚焦-演进的范式。概述阶段利用视觉语言模型提取交叉注意力图，捕捉描述与视觉区域的语义关联；聚焦阶段利用扩散模型的细粒度建模先验，补充视觉语言模型忽略的物体结构和形状信息；演进阶段引入注意力演进模块，抑制无关激活，生成纯净的物体掩码。针对视频输入，提出Video RSVG-ZeroOV，通过关键帧选择器和时间传播器实现时空定位。

主要发现: 在六个图像和视频定位基准上的实验表明，RSVG-ZeroOV consistently outperforms existing zero-shot baselines and achieves competitive or superior performance compared with weakly- and fully-supervised methods。

结论: RSVG-ZeroOV框架能够有效实现零样本开放词汇遥感视觉定位，并在多个基准上取得优异性能。

翻译: Remote sensing visual grounding aims to localize a referred target in a remote sensing image or video according to a natural language expression. Existing RSVG methods usually rely on task-specific manual annotations, which are costly to collect and inevitably limited in covering the diversity of real-world geospatial scenarios. As a result, they often struggle to generalize to open-vocabulary queries involving novel objects, fine-grained attributes, complex spatial relationships, and functional semantics. In this paper, we propose RSVG-ZeroOV, a training-free framework that leverages frozen generic foundation models for zero-shot open-vocabulary RSVG. RSVG-ZeroOV follows an Overview-Focus-Evolve paradigm, which exploits the distinct yet complementary attention patterns of vision-language models and diffusion models to progressively generate precise grounding results. Specifically, (i) Overview utilizes a VLM to extract cross-attention maps that capture semantic correlations between the referring expression and visual regions; (ii) Focus leverages the fine-grained modeling priors of a DM to compensate for object structure and shape information often overlooked by VLM attention; and (iii) Evolve introduces a simple yet effective attention evolution module to suppress irrelevant activations, yielding purified object masks. To handle video inputs, we further present Video RSVG-ZeroOV, which extends image-level grounding to spatio-temporal grounding through a query-relevant key-frame selector and a temporal propagator, enabling efficient and temporally coherent video grounding without video annotations or fine-tuning. Extensive experiments on six image and video grounding benchmarks show that RSVG-ZeroOV consistently outperforms existing zero-shot baselines and achieves competitive or superior performance compared with weakly- and fully-supervised methods.

Abstract

Remote sensing visual grounding (RSVG) aims to localize a referred target in a remote sensing image or video according to a natural language expression. Existing RSVG methods usually rely on task-specific manual annotations, which are costly to collect and inevitably limited in covering the diversity of real-world geospatial scenarios. As a result, they often struggle to generalize to open-vocabulary queries involving novel objects, fine-grained attributes, complex spatial relationships, and functional semantics. In this paper, we propose RSVG-ZeroOV, a training-free framework that leverages frozen generic foundation models for zero-shot open-vocabulary RSVG. RSVG-ZeroOV follows an Overview-Focus-Evolve paradigm, which exploits the distinct yet complementary attention patterns of vision-language models (VLMs) and diffusion models (DMs) to progressively generate precise grounding results. Specifically, (i) Overview utilizes a VLM to extract cross-attention maps that capture semantic correlations between the referring expression and visual regions; (ii) Focus leverages the fine-grained modeling priors of a DM to compensate for object structure and shape information often overlooked by VLM attention; and (iii) Evolve introduces a simple yet effective attention evolution module to suppress irrelevant activations, yielding purified object masks. To handle video inputs, we further present Video RSVG-ZeroOV, which extends image-level grounding to spatio-temporal grounding through a query-relevant key-frame selector and a temporal propagator, enabling efficient and temporally coherent video grounding without video annotations or fine-tuning. Extensive experiments on six image and video grounding benchmarks show that RSVG-ZeroOV consistently outperforms existing zero-shot baselines and achieves competitive or superior performance compared with weakly- and fully-supervised methods.

item.title: VibeThinker-3B: Exploring the Frontier of Verifiable Reasoning in Small Language Models
item.author: Xu, Sen, Liu, Shixi, Wang, Wei, Min, Jixin, Dai, Yingwei, Yin, Zhibin, Chen, Yirong, Zhou, Xin, Zhang, Junlin
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 该报告介绍了VibeThinker-3B模型，这是一个拥有三十亿参数的紧凑型密集模型。该模型在严格的小模型范围内探索可验证推理的极限，通过优化的训练流程实现了前沿水平的性能，在多项高难度可验证任务上表现优异，甚至匹敌或超越参数量大得多的旗舰模型。

背景: 当前大模型在推理能力上取得了显著进展，但紧凑型模型在可验证推理方面的潜力尚待深入探索。

目的: 在严格的小模型范围内，探索可验证推理能力的极限。

方法: 基于谱到信号的后训练范式，通过优化的流程系统增强模型，包括基于课程的学习监督微调、多领域强化学习和离线自蒸馏。

主要发现: VibeThinker-3B在AIME26上得分九十四点三（结合声明级测试时扩展可达九十七点一），在LiveCodeBench v6上Pass@1得分为八十点二，在近期未见过的LeetCode竞赛中接受率达百分之九十六点一。在IFEval上得分为九十三点四，证明推理增强未损害指令可控性。其性能与DeepSeek V3.2、GLM-5和Gemini 3 Pro等旗舰模型相当或更优。

结论: 研究结果支持参数压缩覆盖假设，即可验证推理可压缩为紧凑的推理核心，而开放域知识和通用能力需要广泛的参数覆盖。紧凑型模型不仅是部署高效的替代品，更是参数密集能力领域达到前沿性能的一条互补路径。

翻译: This technical report introduces VibeThinker-3B, a compact dense model with 3B parameters developed to investigate how far verifiable reasoning can be pushed within a strictly small-model regime. Building upon the Spectrum-to-Signal post-training paradigm, we systematically enhance the model through an optimized pipeline that includes curriculum-based supervised fine-tuning, multi-domain reinforcement learning, and offline self-distillation. Experimental evaluations demonstrate that VibeThinker-3B achieves frontier-level performance on highly demanding verifiable tasks. Specifically, it attains a score of 94.3 on AIME26 (improving to 97.1 with claim-level test-time scaling), an 80.2 Pass@1 on LiveCodeBench v6, and exhibits strong out-of-distribution generalization with a 96.1% acceptance rate on recent unseen LeetCode contests. This effectively places it in the performance band of first-tier reasoning systems, matching or exceeding flagship models that are orders of magnitude larger, such as DeepSeek V3.2, GLM-5, and Gemini 3 Pro. Furthermore, a score of 93.4 on IFEval confirms that this extreme reasoning enhancement does not compromise strict instruction controllability. Extending our previous 1.5B work, these findings motivate the Parametric Compression-Coverage Hypothesis, which views verifiable reasoning as compressible into compact reasoning cores, while open-domain knowledge and general-purpose competence require broad parameter coverage over facts, concepts, and long-tail scenarios. This perspective suggests that compact models are not merely deployment-efficient substitutes, but a complementary path toward frontier-level performance in parameter-dense capability regimes.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要探讨在仅使用约三十亿参数的极小模型条件下，能否突破传统认知，实现与顶级大模型相匹敌的复杂可验证推理能力。该问题在研究与现实中具有重要意义，因为小模型在部署成本、推理效率和学术普及方面优势明显。证明小模型具备前沿推理能力，不仅能打破只有超大参数模型才能处理高难度任务的固有观念，还为开发高效低成本的专用推理模型提供了新的技术路径和理论依据。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者基于“谱到信号”原则，认为小模型无需盲目扩大参数，而是可以通过系统化训练将复杂推理能力压缩为紧凑核心。他们据此设计了分阶段的后训练流程，先通过课程学习构建广泛的解题思路空间，再利用强化学习放大正确推理信号，最后结合效率优化与指令对齐巩固能力。该方法直接借鉴并扩展了作者团队此前VibeThinker一点五B的研究成果与核心算法，同时以开源的三B基础模型为起点进行迭代升级。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是“谱到信号”范式，即先在监督微调阶段构建覆盖多种有效解法的广泛解空间，再通过强化学习阶段从中筛选并放大正确的推理信号。整体实现流程依次包含四个阶段：首先进行两阶段课程监督微调，从广泛能力覆盖逐步过渡到长链条复杂推理；接着开展多领域强化学习，并加入数学推理压缩步骤以提升效率；随后通过离线自蒸馏整合新能力；最后进行指令强化学习，确保模型严格遵循复杂约束。
