主要发现: 在THINGS-EEG数据集上的零样本实验显示，该方法在单受试者设置下达到了百分之六十六的Top-1准确率和百分之九十一的Top-5准确率，在留一法交叉验证设置下达到了百分之二十四的Top-1准确率和百分之五十二的Top-5准确率，性能超越了现有的最先进方法。

结论: SUP-MCRL框架通过整合语义感知、增强和原型增强机制，有效提升了非侵入式脑机接口在自然视觉体验中的神经视觉解码性能。

翻译: Non-invasive brain-computer interfaces suffer severe fidelity degradation in neural visual decoding when generalizing to natural visual experiences. Conventional multimodal contrastive representation learning solely optimizes geometric distance alignment, neglecting semantic consistency and subject selectivity, causing spurious zero-shot alignment. We propose SUP-MCRL, a unified framework integrating three collaborative mechanisms: (1) Semantic-entity Aware Visual Encoder (SAVE), learning spatial attention to extract semantic content without pre-trained saliency models; (2) Unified EEG Enhancer (UEE), employing multi-scale atrous convolutions and inter-band attention for adaptive cross-subject robustness; and (3) Prototype-based Progressive Augmenter (PPA), maintaining an EMA-updated pseudo-feature pool to prevent representation collapse. Zero-shot experiments on THINGS-EEG achieve 66.0%/91.9% (Top-1/Top-5) intra-subject and 24.0%/52.9% LOSO accuracy, surpassing state-of-the-art methods. Code is available at https://github.com/NZWANG/SUP-MCRL.

Abstract

Non-invasive brain-computer interfaces suffer severe fidelity degradation in neural visual decoding when generalizing to natural visual experiences. Conventional multimodal contrastive representation learning solely optimizes geometric distance alignment, neglecting semantic consistency and subject selectivity, causing spurious zero-shot alignment. We propose SUP-MCRL, a unified framework integrating three collaborative mechanisms: (1) Semantic-entity Aware Visual Encoder (SAVE), learning spatial attention to extract semantic content without pre-trained saliency models; (2 Unified EEG Enhancer (UEE), employing multi-scale atrous convolutions and inter-band attention for adaptive cross-subject robustness; and (3) Prototype-based Progressive Augmenter (PPA), maintaining an EMA-updated pseudo-feature pool to prevent representation collapse. Zero-shot experiments on THINGS-EEG achieve 66.0%/91.9% (Top-1/Top-5) intra-subject and 24.0%/52.9% LOSO accuracy, surpassing state-of-the-art methods. Code is available at https://github.com/NZWANG/SUP-MCRL.

item.title: Harmonizing Semantic and Collaborative in LLMs: Reasoning-based Embedding Generator for Sequential Recommendation
item.author: Qidong Liu, Mingyao Huang, Moranxin Wang, Wenxuan Yang, Haiping Zhu
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为ReaEmb的新型框架，旨在解决顺序推荐系统中因长尾问题导致的性能瓶颈。该框架通过潜在推理增强的对比学习阶段和协作奖励强化学习阶段，充分利用大语言模型的语义理解与推理能力，并显式注入协作信号以优化嵌入对齐。

背景: 顺序推荐系统基于用户交互历史预测下一个感兴趣的项目，但受长尾问题制约。大语言模型具备强大的语义理解和推理能力，可作为嵌入生成器丰富项目语义，但现有方法存在未充分利用模型内部推理能力以及协作信号注入缺乏显式指导的缺陷。

目的: 解决现有基于大语言模型的嵌入方法未能利用模型内部推理能力，以及协作信号注入缺乏显式引导以实现协作嵌入对齐的问题。

方法: 提出ReaEmb框架，包含两个阶段：潜在推理增强的对比学习阶段，通过带有额外注意力模块的双次前向过程利用大语言模型的内部推理能力；协作奖励强化学习阶段，通过定制的强化学习显式地将协作信号注入大语言模型。

主要发现: 在三个真实世界数据集上的广泛实验表明，ReaEmb在多个顺序推荐模型中展现出优越的有效性。

结论: ReaEmb框架有效解决了现有方法的两个根本性差距，提升了推荐系统的性能，并公开了代码以促进可复现性。

翻译: Sequential Recommender Systems (SRS) predict the next item of interest based on users' interaction histories and have been widely deployed, but hindered by long-tail problem. Large Language Models (LLMs), with strong semantic understanding and reasoning capabilities, offer a promising way to enrich item semantics and have recently been used as embedding generators. However, two fundamental gaps remain. First, current LLM-based embedding methods fail to exploit the model's inner reasoning capacity. Second, existing methods often inject collaborative signals implicitly via supervised fine-tuning, lacking explicit guidance for collaborative embedding alignment. In this paper, we introduce ReaEmb, a novel framework that resolves both issues via a Latent Reasoning-enhanced Contrastive Learning (LRCL) stage and a Collaborative Reward Reinforcement Learning (CRRL) stage. LRCL exploits the LLMs' inner reasoning capacity through a two-pass forward process with an additional attention module. CRRL subsequently explicitly injects collaborative signals into the LLM via a tailored reinforcement learning. Extensive experiments on three real-world datasets demonstrate superior effectiveness of ReaEmb across multiple SRS models. To ease reproducibility, we release the code online.

Abstract

Sequential Recommender Systems (SRS) predict the next item of interest based on users' interaction histories and have been widely deployed, but hindered by long-tail problem. Large Language Models (LLMs), with strong semantic understanding and reasoning capabilities, offer a promising way to enrich item semantics and have recently been used as embedding generators. However, two fundamental gaps remain. First, current LLM-based embedding methods fail to exploit the model's inner reasoning capacity. Second, existing methods often inject collaborative signals implicitly via supervised fine-tuning, lacking explicit guidance for collaborative embedding alignment. In this paper, we introduce ReaEmb, a novel framework that resolves both issues via a Latent Reasoning-enhanced Contrastive Learning (LRCL) stage and a Collaborative Reward Reinforcement Learning (CRRL) stage. LRCL exploits the LLMs' inner reasoning capacity through a two-pass forward process with an additional attention module. CRRL subsequently explicitly injects collaborative signals into the LLM via a tailored reinforcement learning. Extensive experiments on three real-world datasets demonstrate superior effectiveness of ReaEmb across multiple SRS models. To ease reproducibility, we release the code online.

item.title: Medical world models: representing medical states, modelling clinical dynamics and guiding intervention policies
item.author: Ke Liu, Mengxuan Li, Yanyi Bao, Tianyun Zhang, Chong Chu, Jiajun Bu, Haishuai Wang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文综述了医疗世界模型的发展，旨在推动医疗人工智能从孤立的诊断和预测向模拟疾病演变并支持干预决策的医疗世界模型转变。

背景: 医疗诊断和治疗是动态过程，患者状态随时间演变，临床干预改变未来结果。当前医疗人工智能系统多返回静态标签或评分，对疾病进展和替代干预措施的影响洞察有限。相关研究分散在基础模型、纵向建模、疾病模拟、治疗效果估计、强化学习和数字孪生等领域。

目的: 弥合现有研究分散的差距，提出推进医疗人工智能发展的路线图，帮助临床医生预测病情恶化、比较治疗条件下的未来情景并个性化护理。

方法: 通过回顾相关文献，概述从孤立诊断和预测向医疗世界模型转变的路线图。该路线图围绕三个耦合能力展开：患者状态构建、临床动态建模和干预决策支持。

主要发现: 通过比较代表性系统，突出了每种能力对构建更成熟的感知-动态-规划系统的贡献，以及部分组件如何整合。

结论: 将合理的模拟结果转化为临床有用的模拟器面临挑战。

翻译: Medical diagnosis and treatment are dynamic processes in which patient states evolve over time and clinical interventions alter future outcomes. Although current medical AI can detect disease, estimate risk and generate reports, many systems still return static labels or scores, offering limited insight into how illness may progress or how alternative interventions may reshape its trajectory. Medical world models adapt the world-model idea from artificial intelligence to healthcare by learning internal simulators of patient-state dynamics. Their long-term goal is to help clinicians anticipate deterioration, compare treatment-conditioned futures and tailor care to individual patients. Yet relevant work remains scattered across foundation models, longitudinal modelling, disease simulation, treatment-effect estimation, reinforcement learning and digital twins. To bridge this gap, this review outlines a roadmap for advancing medical AI from isolated diagnosis and prediction toward medical world models that simulate disease evolution and support intervention decisions. This roadmap is organized around three coupled capabilities: patient-state construction, clinical dynamics modelling and intervention decision support. Across representative systems, the comparison highlights what each capability contributes and how partial components can be integrated into more mature perception--dynamics--planning systems. Finally, we identify the challenges involved in turning plausible rollouts into clinically useful simulators. Related literature is available at https://github.com/1999kevin/awesome_medical_world_models.

Abstract

Medical diagnosis and treatment are dynamic processes in which patient states evolve over time and clinical interventions alter future outcomes. Although current medical AI can detect disease, estimate risk and generate reports, many systems still return static labels or scores, offering limited insight into how illness may progress or how alternative interventions may reshape its trajectory. Medical world models adapt the world-model idea from artificial intelligence to healthcare by learning internal simulators of patient-state dynamics. Their long-term goal is to help clinicians anticipate deterioration, compare treatment-conditioned futures and tailor care to individual patients. Yet relevant work remains scattered across foundation models, longitudinal modelling, disease simulation, treatment-effect estimation, reinforcement learning and digital twins. To bridge this gap, this review outlines a roadmap for advancing medical AI from isolated diagnosis and prediction toward medical world models that simulate disease evolution and support intervention decisions. This roadmap is organized around three coupled capabilities: patient-state construction, clinical dynamics modelling and intervention decision support. Across representative systems, the comparison highlights what each capability contributes and how partial components can be integrated into more mature perception--dynamics--planning systems. Finally, we identify the challenges involved in turning plausible rollouts into clinically useful simulators. Related literature is available at https://github.com/1999kevin/awesome_medical_world_models.

item.title: GD$^2$PO: Mitigating Multi-Reward Conflicts via Group-Dynamic reward-Decoupled Policy Optimization
item.author: Liu, Haotian, Liu, Yihao, Ni, Jingwei, Huang, Siyuan, Liu, Xinpeng, Cheng, Pengyu, Song, Jiajun, Ding, Ruijin, Li, Junfeng, Yu, Zhechao, Zhou, Mengyu, Xu, Hongteng, Jiang, Xiaoxi, Jiang, Guanjun
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种名为GD平方PO的新算法，用于优化大型语言模型在训练过程中面临的多维奖励冲突问题。

背景: 随着大型语言模型的进步，后训练强化学习越来越依赖多维奖励来培养综合能力，这需要能够同时优化多样且可能相互竞争的目标的新算法。

目的: 解决现有方法在聚合奖励时因信号相互抵消而导致的强化学习训练效率低下的问题。

方法: 提出GD平方PO算法，采用冲突感知过滤机制屏蔽存在严重奖励分歧的采样，并引入查询级重加权技术动态调整每个查询的更新强度。

主要发现: 在工具调用和人类偏好对齐等多种多维奖励场景的实验中，GD平方PO consistently and significantly outperforms existing baselines。

结论: GD平方PO通过防止冲突信号相互抵消，有效提升了强化学习的训练效率。

翻译: As LLMs advance, post-training reinforcement learning (RL) increasingly relies on multi-dimensional rewards to cultivate comprehensive capabilities. This shift demands new algorithms capable of optimizing diverse and potentially competing objectives simultaneously. To address this, existing methods such as Group reward-Decoupled Policy Optimization (GDPO) decompose the overall score into independent reward groups, then compute the RL loss separately within each group. However, this strategy still encounters multi-reward conflicts: a single rollout can yield positive advantages on certain reward dimensions but negative ones on others, causing opposing signals to cancel each other out during aggregation, further hindering RL training efficiency. Inspired by Dynamic sAmpling Policy Optimization (DAPO), which improves RL training efficiency by filtering out ineffective rollouts with near-zero advantages, we propose Group-Dynamic reward-Decoupled Policy Optimization (GD$^2$PO). Specifically, GD$^2$PO employs a conflict-aware filtering mechanism to mask out rollouts suffering from severe reward-wise disagreement. By preventing conflicting signals from canceling each other out, this masking strategy preserves and enhances the magnitude of effective RL advantages, thereby significantly accelerating learning efficiency. Furthermore, we introduce query-level reweighting to dynamically adjust the update intensity of each query based on its overall reward consensus. Experiments on various multi-reward scenarios, including tool calling and human preference alignment, demonstrate that GD$^2$PO consistently and significantly outperforms existing baselines. The code is available at this https URL .

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决大语言模型在强化学习训练中，同时优化多个奖励维度时产生的信号冲突问题。当模型生成的回答在某些维度上表现好而在其他维度上表现差时，相反的信号会相互抵消，严重降低训练效率。该问题在现实中至关重要，因为实际应用场景要求模型必须同时满足多种可能相互矛盾的人类偏好与任务需求。有效化解此类冲突不仅能大幅提升训练效率，还能帮助模型更全面、稳定地掌握复杂能力。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者针对多奖励强化学习中不同维度的奖励信号相互抵消、导致训练效率低下的问题，提出在最终聚合前动态识别并过滤存在严重冲突的样本。该方法主要借鉴了现有动态采样工作通过筛选低效样本来提升训练效率的思路，并将其扩展至多奖励优势空间。在此基础上，作者设计了冲突感知过滤机制与查询级动态调整策略，有效保留了强化学习的正向信号，从而显著加速了模型的学习过程。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是在聚合多维权益信号前，通过动态过滤机制识别并剔除存在严重冲突的样本，从而避免正负信号相互抵消，保留有效的学习方向。整体实现流程首先独立计算各维度的优势值，接着在批次层面利用符号一致性或信噪比规则过滤掉冲突严重的生成结果，最后在查询层面根据保留样本的比例动态调整模型更新强度，完成策略优化。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于提出了动态冲突感知过滤机制与查询级动态重加权策略。相比以往仅将多维奖励解耦后直接相加的现有方法，该算法在聚合前主动识别并剔除奖励信号相互冲突的样本，同时根据整体奖励共识程度动态调整每个查询的更新强度。这一设计有效避免了正负优势信号相互抵消的问题，显著提升了多奖励强化学习的训练效率与稳定性。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 该论文提出了一种动态奖励解耦策略，通过过滤存在严重奖励冲突的生成样本并结合查询级别的动态权重调整，有效缓解了大语言模型多奖励强化学习中的信号抵消问题，显著提升了训练效率与综合性能。

Abstract

As LLMs advance, post-training reinforcement learning (RL) increasingly relies on multi-dimensional rewards to cultivate comprehensive capabilities. This shift demands new algorithms capable of optimizing diverse and potentially competing objectives simultaneously. To address this, existing methods such as Group reward-Decoupled Policy Optimization (GDPO) decompose the overall score into independent reward groups, then compute the RL loss separately within each group. However, this strategy still encounters multi-reward conflicts: a single rollout can yield positive advantages on certain reward dimensions but negative ones on others, causing opposing signals to cancel each other out during aggregation, further hindering RL training efficiency. Inspired by Dynamic sAmpling Policy Optimization (DAPO), which improves RL training efficiency by filtering out ineffective rollouts with near-zero advantages, we propose Group-Dynamic reward-Decoupled Policy Optimization (GD$^2$PO). Specifically, GD$^2$PO employs a conflict-aware filtering mechanism to mask out rollouts suffering from severe reward-wise disagreement. By preventing conflicting signals from canceling each other out, this masking strategy preserves and enhances the magnitude of effective RL advantages, thereby significantly accelerating learning efficiency. Furthermore, we introduce query-level reweighting to dynamically adjust the update intensity of each query based on its overall reward consensus. Experiments on various multi-reward scenarios, including tool calling and human preference alignment, demonstrate that GD$^2$PO consistently and significantly outperforms existing baselines. The code is available at this https URL .

item.title: SoK: Security and Privacy of Foundation-Model-Powered Robots
item.author: Xueluan Gong, Chen Chen, Jinxin Liu, Qian Wang, Kwok-Yan Lam
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种用于分析基于基础模型的机器人安全与隐私风险的渐进式F-E-S-G结构边界框架，并基于该框架开发了多层分类法，系统化了九十六篇相关文献，揭示了威胁模式、防御不匹配和评估差距，为未来研究提供了议程。

背景: 基础模型正在通过使机器人能够解释开放式指令、在多模态上下文中推理以及在复杂开放世界环境中运行来重塑机器人技术。然而，其集成也引入了超出基础模型本身的安全与隐私风险，波及具身执行管道、支持生态系统及更广泛的治理影响。现有文献综述通常关注特定的基础模型类型、风险类别、缓解策略或信任边界，缺乏统一的结构来分析风险的来源、在机器人系统中的传播方式以及缓解措施的干预点。

目的: 填补现有研究缺乏统一结构来分析基于基础模型的机器人安全与隐私风险来源、传播路径及缓解干预点的空白，为开发安全、保护隐私且负责任治理的基于基础模型的机器人系统提供研究议程。

方法: 提出渐进式F-E-S-G结构边界框架，包含基础模型层、具身系统层、支持生态系统层和治理影响层四层。基于此框架开发多层分类法，从F-E-S-G信任边界、安全与隐私关注点、风险与缓解视角三个层面组织先前研究，并使用细粒度编码属性（目标、生命周期阶段、机制、系统访问和效果）对每篇研究进行标注，最终系统化分析了九十六篇论文。

主要发现: 分析揭示了从单一边界视角难以识别的多种威胁模式、防御不匹配和评估差距。

结论: 基于分析结果确定了开放挑战和未来方向，为开发安全、保护隐私且负责任治理的基于基础模型的机器人系统提供了研究议程。

翻译: Foundation models are reshaping robotics by enabling robots to interpret open-ended instructions, reason over multimodal contexts, and operate in complex, open-world environments. However, their integration also introduces security and privacy (S&P) risks that extend beyond the FMs themselves to embodied execution pipelines, supporting ecosystems, and broader governance impacts. Existing literature reviews provide valuable insights but often focus on specific FM types, risk categories, mitigation strategies, or trust boundaries. Consequently, the field lacks a unified structure for analyzing where risks originate, how they propagate across robotic systems, and where mitigations should intervene. To address this gap, we propose a progressive F-E-S-G structural boundary framework for analyzing the S&P of FM-powered robots. The framework comprises four layers: the Foundation model layer (F), Embodied system layer (E), Supporting ecosystem layer (S), and Governance impact layer (G). Building on this structure, we develop a multi-level taxonomy that organizes prior studies along three levels: F-E-S-G trust boundary, security-privacy concerns, and risk-mitigation perspectives. We further annotate each study using fine-grained coding attributes, including target, lifecycle stage, mechanism, system access, and effect. Guided by this framework and taxonomy, we systematize 96 papers. Our analysis uncovers multiple threat patterns, defense mismatches, and evaluation gaps that are difficult to identify from a single-boundary perspective. Based on these findings, we identify open challenges and future directions to provide a research agenda for developing secure, privacy-preserving, and responsibly governed FM-powered robotic systems.

Abstract

Foundation models are reshaping robotics by enabling robots to interpret open-ended instructions, reason over multimodal contexts, and operate in complex, open-world environments. However, their integration also introduces security and privacy (S&P) risks that extend beyond the FMs themselves to embodied execution pipelines, supporting ecosystems, and broader governance impacts. Existing literature reviews provide valuable insights but often focus on specific FM types, risk categories, mitigation strategies, or trust boundaries. Consequently, the field lacks a unified structure for analyzing where risks originate, how they propagate across robotic systems, and where mitigations should intervene. To address this gap, we propose a progressive F-E-S-G structural boundary framework for analyzing the S&P of FM-powered robots. The framework comprises four layers: the Foundation model layer (F), Embodied system layer (E), Supporting ecosystem layer (S), and Governance impact layer (G). Building on this structure, we develop a multi-level taxonomy that organizes prior studies along three levels: F-E-S-G trust boundary, security-privacy concerns, and risk-mitigation perspectives. We further annotate each study using fine-grained coding attributes, including target, lifecycle stage, mechanism, system access, and effect. Guided by this framework and taxonomy, we systematize 96 papers. Our analysis uncovers multiple threat patterns, defense mismatches, and evaluation gaps that are difficult to identify from a single-boundary perspective. Based on these findings, we identify open challenges and future directions to provide a research agenda for developing secure, privacy-preserving, and responsibly governed FM-powered robotic systems.

item.title: WaveDINO: Learning-Based Atmospheric Correction of Unwrapped InSAR Interferograms Validated by GNSS: Results at Laguna del Maule and Campi Flegrei Volcanoes
item.author: Robert Popescu, Juliet Biggs, Tianyuan Zhu, Nantheera Anantrasirichai
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种基于学习的去噪方法WaveDINO，用于处理干涉合成孔径雷达（InSAR）解缠干涉图中的噪声，该方法结合了物理启发的合成形变与真实大气噪声进行混合训练。

背景: 干涉合成孔径雷达（InSAR）可有效监测火山形变，但观测信号常受大气相位延迟、季节性地表变化和去相关效应等噪声干扰。现有基于数值天气模型的大气校正方法虽能减轻这些影响，但无法一致地消除大气伪影，且可能引入残余偏差。

目的: 解决现有大气校正方法的局限性，提出一种新颖的学习去噪方法，以去除解缠InSAR干涉图中的噪声。

方法: 提出WaveDINO，一种基于小波的多尺度去噪框架，以冻结的DINOv3基础模型特征和地形信息为条件。训练策略采用混合方式，将合成岩浆源形变叠加到短期干涉图上，使网络接触真实的大气统计特性，同时保留已知的真实标签。

主要发现: 在受控合成数据和来自智利拉古纳德尔马乌莱及意大利坎皮弗莱格雷的长期真实干涉图上的评估显示，WaveDINO consistently优于竞争模型。与GNSS测量结果的一致性提高，在两个站点将平均GNSS拟合误差分别降低了约百分之三和百分之十九，且表现优于基于天气模型的校正方法。

结论: WaveDINO方法能有效去除InSAR干涉图中的噪声，提高与GNSS测量结果的一致性，优于现有大气校正方法。

翻译: Interferometric Synthetic Aperture Radar (InSAR) enables effective monitoring of volcanic deformation; however, the observed signals are often corrupted by atmospheric phase delays, seasonal surface changes, and decorrelation effects. Existing atmospheric correction methods, such as numerical weather model-based methods, can reduce these effects but do not consistently remove atmospheric artefacts and may introduce residual biases. To address these limitations, we propose a novel learning-based method for denoising unwrapped InSAR interferograms, using a hybrid training strategy that combines physically motivated synthetic deformation with real atmospheric noise. Specifically, we introduce WaveDINO, a wavelet-based multi-scale denoising framework conditioned on frozen DINOv3 foundation-model features and terrain information. Training uses synthetic magma-source deformation superimposed on short-term interferograms to expose the network to realistic atmospheric statistics while retaining known ground truth. Performance is evaluated on both controlled synthetic data and long-term real interferograms from Laguna del Maule (Chile) and Campi Flegrei (Italy), with independent GNSS measurements used for validation. WaveDINO consistently outperforms competing models, improving agreement with GNSS measurements, and reducing mean GNSS misfit by approximately 3% and 19% at two sites, respectively, while surpassing weather-model-based corrections.

Abstract

Interferometric Synthetic Aperture Radar (InSAR) enables effective monitoring of volcanic deformation; however, the observed signals are often corrupted by atmospheric phase delays, seasonal surface changes, and decorrelation effects. Existing atmospheric correction methods, such as numerical weather model-based methods, can reduce these effects but do not consistently remove atmospheric artefacts and may introduce residual biases. To address these limitations, we propose a novel learning-based method for denoising unwrapped InSAR interferograms, using a hybrid training strategy that combines physically motivated synthetic deformation with real atmospheric noise. Specifically, we introduce WaveDINO, a wavelet-based multi-scale denoising framework conditioned on frozen DINOv3 foundation-model features and terrain information. Training uses synthetic magma-source deformation superimposed on short-term interferograms to expose the network to realistic atmospheric statistics while retaining known ground truth. Performance is evaluated on both controlled synthetic data and long-term real interferograms from Laguna del Maule (Chile) and Campi Flegrei (Italy), with independent GNSS measurements used for validation. WaveDINO consistently outperforms competing models, improving agreement with GNSS measurements, and reducing mean GNSS misfit by approximately 3% and 19% at two sites, respectively, while surpassing weather-model-based corrections.

item.title: ATOM-Bench: A Real-World Benchmark for Atomic Skills and Compositional Generalization in Manipulation Policies
item.author: Zenan Wu, Bingqing Wei, Lu Liu, Zheqi He, Xi Wang, Jiakang Liu, Zehui Li, Guocai Yao, Jing-Shu Zheng, Xi Yang, Yongtao Wang
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文介绍了ATOM-Bench，一个用于评估机器人操作策略中基础技能获取和组合泛化能力的真实世界基准测试。该基准将桌面操作分解为运动原子和指令原子，包含30个原子任务和24个组合任务。通过收集人类演示数据并对策略进行微调，研究评估了当前策略在技能获取和组合泛化方面的表现。研究发现当前策略在简单指令 grounding 方面表现尚可，但在精细运动原子、计数和逻辑过滤方面存在困难，且强原子性能无法可靠地转移到组合任务中。ATOM-Bench 为诊断失败原因提供了测试平台。

背景: 通用操作策略正日益被视为机器人控制的基础模型，但其在现实世界中的泛化能力难以诊断。策略可能在演示任务上成功，但仍无法执行精细的原子技能或在新的任务结构中重组已学习的技能。

目的: 引入ATOM-Bench基准，用于评估操作策略中的原子技能获取和组合泛化能力，并提供一个诊断测试平台，以研究失败是源于弱的运动执行、差的指令 grounding 还是有限的组合重用。

方法: 将桌面操作分解为运动原子和指令原子，构建包含30个原子任务和24个组合任务的基准测试。收集3000个人类演示数据用于原子微调，并释放演示数据和评估滚动数据以支持可复现的真实世界评估。引入原子得分（AS）和组合失败份额（CFS）来区分由弱原子技能引起的失败和由有限组合重用引起的失败。在五个代表性操作策略上进行了2700次物理滚动测试。

主要发现: 当前策略可以获取简单的指令 grounding 技能，但在精细运动原子、计数和逻辑过滤方面仍存在困难。更重要的是，强的原子性能并不能可靠地转移到未见的组合任务中。

结论: ATOM-Bench 提供了一个诊断测试平台，用于研究机器人操作策略的失败是源于弱的运动执行、差的指令 grounding 还是有限的组合重用。

翻译: 通用操作策略正日益被视为机器人控制的基础模型，但其在现实世界中的泛化能力难以诊断。策略可能在演示任务上成功，但仍无法执行精细的原子技能或在新的任务结构中重组已学习的技能。我们引入了ATOM-Bench，这是一个用于评估操作策略中原子技能和组合泛化能力的真实世界基准。ATOM-Bench 将桌面操作分解为运动原子和指令原子，包含30个原子任务和24个组合任务。我们收集了3000个人类演示数据用于原子微调，并发布了演示数据和评估滚动数据以支持可复现的真实世界评估。策略在原子任务上进行微调，并在原子技能获取和组合任务上进行评估。我们进一步引入了原子得分（AS）和组合失败份额（CFS），以区分由弱原子技能引起的失败和由有限组合重用引起的失败。通过对五个代表性操作策略进行的2700次物理滚动测试，我们发现当前策略可以获取简单的指令 grounding 技能，但在精细运动原子、计数和逻辑过滤方面仍存在困难。更重要的是，强的原子性能并不能可靠地转移到组合任务中。ATOM-Bench 为研究失败是源于弱的运动执行、差的指令 grounding 还是有限的组合重用提供了诊断测试平台。

Abstract

Generalist manipulation policies are increasingly presented as foundation models for robotic control, but their real-world generalization remains difficult to diagnose. A policy may succeed on demonstrated tasks while still failing to execute fine-grained atomic skills or recombine learned skills in new task structures. We introduce \textbf{ATOM-Bench}, a real-world benchmark for evaluating both atomic skills and compositional generalization in manipulation policies. ATOM-Bench factorizes tabletop manipulation into motor atoms and instruction atoms, and contains 30 atomic tasks and 24 held-out compositional tasks across paired single-arm and dual-arm robot tracks. We collect 3,000 human demonstrations for atomic fine-tuning and release both the demonstration data and evaluation rollout data to support reproducible real-world evaluation. Policies are fine-tuned on atomic tasks and evaluated on both atomic skill acquisition and held-out compositional tasks. We further introduce Atomic Score (AS) and Compositional Failure Share (CFS) to distinguish failures caused by weak atomic skills from failures caused by limited compositional reuse. Through 2,700 physical rollouts on five representative manipulation policies, we find that current policies can acquire simple instruction-grounding skills, but still struggle with fine-grained motor atoms, counting, and logical filtering. More importantly, strong atomic performance does not reliably transfer to held-out compositional tasks. ATOM-Bench provides a diagnostic testbed for studying whether failures arise from weak motor execution, poor instruction grounding, or limited compositional reuse.

item.title: Robust Spoofed Speech Detection via Temporal Pyramid Modeling
item.author: Mahtab Masoudi Nezhad, Nima Karimian
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文提出了一种时间金字塔适配器，用于检测欺骗语音，通过并行时间卷积捕获多尺度欺骗线索，并结合自监督XLS-R表示和前端适配器，在多个基准数据集上进行了评估，结果显示该模型在性能上显著优于基线模型，但跨域和跨语言迁移时性能有所下降。

背景: 欺骗语音检测正面临现实合成、语音转换和重放攻击的挑战，跨数据集泛化能力仍是主要限制。

目的: 提出一种时间金字塔适配器，以捕获从局部伪影到全局韵律不规则性的多尺度欺骗线索，并提高检测性能。

方法: 使用具有不同感受野的并行时间卷积来捕获多尺度欺骗线索；结合自监督XLS-R表示与前端适配器（包括Mel、Sinc和时间金字塔设计）进行多尺度时间建模；在ASVspoof 2017、ASVspoof 2021（DF/LA）、PartialSpoof、DiffSSD和HQ-MPSD等多个基准数据集上进行评估。

主要发现: 在PartialSpoof数据库上，该模型取得了99.24%的AUC和3.87%的EER，显著优于基线模型及LCNN-BLSTM和TRACE等最先进基线；多语言评估表明欺骗伪影与语言无关；自监督表示提高了鲁棒性，但在域和语言变化下性能下降。

结论: 虽然自监督表示提高了鲁棒性，但在域和语言变化下性能下降，凸显了需要更好的适应和校准策略。

翻译: Spoofed speech detection is increasingly challenged by realistic synthesis, voice conversion, and replay attacks, with cross-dataset generalization remaining a major limitation. This work we propose a Temporal Pyramid Adapter that utilize parallel temporal convolutions with varying receptive fields to capture multi-scale spoofing cues, ranging from local artifacts to global prosodic irregularities. We also integrated self-supervised XLS-R representations combined with front-end adapters, including Mel, Sinc, and a Temporal Pyramid design for multi-scale temporal modeling. The proposed model is evaluated cross multiple benchmark including ASVspoof 2017, ASVspoof 2021 (DF/LA), PartialSpoof, DiffSSD, and multilingual HQ-MPSD datasets. Experimental results demonstrate that Temporal Pyramid model obtained AUC of 99.24% and a EER of 3.87% on the PartialSpoof database, which is significantly outperforming the base model and several SOTA baseline such as LCNN-BLSTM (9.87% EER) and TRACE (8.08% EER). Additionally, multilingual evaluations confirm that while spoofing artifact are independent from language. While self-supervised representations improve robustness, performance degrades under domain and language shifts, highlighting the need for better adaptation and calibration strategies.

Abstract

Spoofed speech detection is increasingly challenged by realistic synthesis, voice conversion, and replay attacks, with cross-dataset generalization remaining a major limitation. This work we propose a Temporal Pyramid Adapter that utilize parallel temporal convolutions with varying receptive fields to capture multi-scale spoofing cues, ranging from local artifacts to global prosodic irregularities. We also integrated self-supervised XLS-R representations combined with front-end adapters, including Mel, Sinc, and a Temporal Pyramid design for multi-scale temporal modeling. The proposed model is evaluated cross multiple benchmark including ASVspoof 2017, ASVspoof 2021 (DF/LA), PartialSpoof, DiffSSD, and multilingual HQ-MPSD datasets. Experimental results demonstrate that Temporal Pyramid model obtained AUC of 99.24% and a EER of 3.87% on the PartialSpoof database, which is significantly outperforming the base model and several SOTA baseline such as LCNN-BLSTM (9.87% EER) and TRACE (8.08% EER). Additionally, multilingual evaluations confirm that while spoofing artifact are independent from language. While self-supervised representations improve robustness, performance degrades under domain and language shifts, highlighting the need for better adaptation and calibration strategies.

item.title: OneRank: Unified Transformer-Native Ranking Architecture for Multi-Task Recommendation
item.author: Jiakai Tang, Sunhao Dai, Kun Wang, Zhiluohan Guo, Yu Zhao, Cong Fu, Kangle Wu, Yabo Ni, Anxiang Zeng, Xu Chen, Jun Xu
item.description:
来源: arxiv;hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 提出OneRank框架，消除Transformer编码器与预测器的分离，通过任务私有通道实现任务专用学习并减少干扰，在离线和在线实验中显著优于现有基线。

背景: 推荐系统中多任务学习对互补学习至关重要，现代工业实践从深度神经网络转向以Transformer为中心的架构以增强序列建模能力，但现有设计将特征编码与多任务预测解耦，将Transformer视为任务无关的编码器。

目的: 解决现有Transformer架构在多任务学习中因编码器与预测器分离导致的信息瓶颈、梯度干扰和数据流转换问题，实现统一且可扩展的架构范式。

方法: 提出OneRank框架，在正向传播中通过任务条件信息选择、候选感知上下文化和受控跨任务交互自底向上学习任务特定表示；在反向传播中通过跨任务梯度解耦隔离任务私有参数更新；使用基于动态匹配 scoring 替代静态多层感知机评分器。

主要发现: OneRank通过内部化多任务推理于Transformer堆栈中，消除了编码器与预测器的分离，实现了任务专用学习并减少了任务间干扰，在离线和在线实验中显著优于最先进基线，同时保持计算效率。

结论: OneRank建立了一个统一且可扩展的架构范式，通过消除编码器与预测器的分离和引入任务私有通道，有效解决了多任务学习中的关键问题。

翻译: 多任务学习在推荐系统中对于实现不同用户反馈之间的互补学习至关重要。虽然现代工业实践已从深度神经网络转向以Transformer为中心的架构以加强序列建模和扩展能力，但它们仍然将特征编码与多任务预测解耦，将Transformer视为任务无关的编码器。这种设计从根本上限制了性能和可扩展性，原因包括：在异质任务目标下造成信息瓶颈，引发导致跷跷板现象的梯度干扰，以及强制进行数据流转换，将基于注意力、上下文自适应的表示学习转换为具有不兼容信息读写动态的静态前馈任务预测。我们提出了OneRank，一个原生Transformer多任务排序框架，它消除了编码器与预测器的分离，并为正向表示学习和反向优化引入了任务私有通道，从而在减少任务间干扰的同时实现任务专用学习。在正向传播中，OneRank通过任务条件信息选择、候选感知上下文化和受控跨任务交互自底向上学习任务特定表示。在反向传播中，跨任务梯度解耦将任务私有参数更新与共享知识提取模块隔离开来，防止负迁移。我们进一步用基于动态匹配的评分替代了静态任务特定的多层感知机评分器，以实现上下文感知的个性化排序。通过将多任务推理内部化于Transformer堆栈中，OneRank建立了一个统一且可扩展的架构范式。在大规模工业数据集上的离线和在线实验表明，OneRank在保持计算效率的同时显著优于最先进基线。

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要解决现有推荐模型中特征编码与多任务预测分离所导致的信息瓶颈、梯度冲突引发的跷跷板现象，以及前后端计算模式不匹配的问题。该问题在工业界和研究中至关重要，因为多任务学习是捕捉用户多样化反馈的核心手段，而现有架构的缺陷会严重限制模型性能与扩展性，导致不同任务间相互干扰且难以高效训练。通过统一建模，该研究能够显著提升推荐排序的准确性与系统稳定性。

作者是如何思考并设计出这个方法的？是否有借鉴现有工作？: 作者针对现有推荐模型将特征编码与多任务预测分离的缺陷，认为这会导致信息瓶颈、梯度冲突和计算流程断裂。为此，他们提出将多任务推理完全融入变换器网络内部，通过自底向上的方式构建任务专属通道与共享路径，并在前向计算中实现任务特异性表示，在后向优化中通过梯度隔离防止任务间干扰。该方法借鉴了大语言模型中的检索增强生成思想来构建用户偏好锚点，同时以标准变换器架构为基础进行扩展。

这个方法的核心思想是什么？整体实现流程是怎样的？: 该方法的核心思想是打破传统推荐模型中特征编码与多任务预测分离的设计，将多任务推理过程完全内化到核心网络内部，通过构建任务专属通道实现任务特异性学习并减少任务间干扰。整体流程分为前向与反向两个阶段：前向阶段自底向上通过任务条件信息筛选、候选感知上下文聚合及受控跨任务交互来学习任务专属表示；反向阶段利用梯度隔离技术阻断跨任务梯度流动，防止负迁移；最后采用动态匹配机制替代静态评分器，直接计算任务感知全局表示与候选嵌入的相似度完成个性化排序。

论文的关键创新点有哪些？相比之前的工作，有什么不同？: 该论文的关键创新在于提出了一种基于Transformer的多任务排序框架，彻底打破了传统方法中特征编码与任务预测分离的设计。相比以往工作，它通过构建独立的任务专属通道实现了自底向上的任务专属表征学习，并在反向传播时采用梯度隔离机制有效避免了任务间的负迁移与梯度干扰。此外，该框架用动态匹配打分替代了传统的静态多层感知机打分模块，使模型能够在统一的网络结构内完成上下文感知的个性化排序。

如果要用一句话总结这篇论文的贡献，你会怎么说？: 本文提出OneRank架构，通过消除传统编码器与预测器的分离设计并引入任务私有通道，有效缓解了信息瓶颈与梯度干扰问题，在保持计算效率的同时显著提升了多任务推荐排序的效果。

Abstract

Multi-task learning (MTL) is essential in recommender systems to enable complementary learning among diverse user feedback. While modern industrial practices have shifted from DNNs to Transformer-centric architectures to strengthen sequence modeling and scaling capacity, they still decouple feature encoding from multi-task prediction, treating the Transformer as a task-agnostic encoder. This design fundamentally limits the performance and scalability by (1) creating an information bottleneck under heterogeneous task objectives, (2) inducing gradient interference that leads to the seesaw phenomenon, and (3) forcing a dataflow transition in which attention-based, context-adaptive representation learning is converted to static feed-forward task prediction with incompatible information read-write dynamics. We propose OneRank, a Transformer-native multi-task ranking framework that eliminates encoder-predictor separation and introduces task-private channels for forward representation learning and backward optimization, enabling task-specialized learning while reducing inter-task interference. In the forward pass, OneRank learns task-specific representations bottom-up through task-conditioned information selection, candidate-aware contextualization, and controlled cross-task interaction. In the backward pass, cross-task gradient detachment isolates task-private parameter updates from shared knowledge extraction modules, preventing negative transfer. We further replace static task-specific MLP scorers with dynamic matching-based scoring for context-aware personalized ranking. By internalizing multi-task reasoning within the Transformer stack, OneRank establishes a unified and scalable architectural paradigm. Offline and online experiments on large-scale industrial datasets show that OneRank significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines while maintaining computational efficiency.

item.title: Data-Driven Decoding of Russell's Circumplex Model of Affect
item.author: Amdjed Belaref, Samir Sadok, Zineb Noumir, Renaud Seguier
item.description:
来源: arxiv

GPT 基础摘要

总结: 本文研究Transformer嵌入是否恢复Russell环形模型中的几何规律，通过统一文本和语音的互补实验，验证其潜在空间是否编码与效价唤醒一致且再现人类邻域关系的拓扑结构。

背景: 情感计算日益依赖深度学习来表征情感，但潜在空间通常是不透明的高维黑箱。

目的: 检验训练后的模型潜在空间是否编码与效价唤醒一致的拓扑结构并再现人类邻域关系。

方法: 评估基于Transformer的文本编码器RoBERTa和语音编码器wav2vec 2.0提取的深度表示，以及多模态Transformer融合架构，在自然数据集MSP-Podcast和控制LLM生成刺激上进行测试。

主要发现: 多模态融合文本和音频产生与Russell主要情感排序的完美拓扑对齐；在零样本设置中使用通用文本嵌入，细粒度情感术语投影接近其已建立的人类映射坐标。

结论: Russell环形结构内在地编码在这些模态的嵌入中，而非仅仅是人类标签的产物，从而弥合心理理论与表示学习之间的差距。

翻译: Affective computing increasingly relies on deep learning to represent emotions, yet latent spaces often remain opaque, high-dimensional black boxes. This paper investigates whether Transformers' embeddings recover the geometric regularities of Russell's circumplex model. We unify two complementary experiments testing the hypothesis that, after training models on text and speech, their resulting latent spaces encode a topology consistent with valence-arousal and reproduce human-like neighborhood relations. Specifically, we evaluate deep representations extracted from Transformer-based text (RoBERTa) and speech (wav2vec 2.0) encoders, along with a multimodal Transformer fusion architecture, across naturalistic datasets like MSP-Podcast and controlled LLM-generated stimuli. Our analysis reveals that multimodal fusion of text and audio yields perfect topological alignment with Russell's primary emotion ordering. Furthermore, in a zero-shot setting using generic text embeddings, projected fine-grained emotion terms fall close to their established human-mapped coordinates. Our contribution is a novel, data-driven framework for validating emotion models, demonstrating that Russell's circumplex structure is intrinsically encoded in the embeddings of these modalities rather than being solely an artifact of human labeling, thereby bridging the gap between psychological theory and representation learning.

Abstract

Affective computing increasingly relies on deep learning to represent emotions, yet latent spaces often remain opaque, high-dimensional black boxes. This paper investigates whether Transformers' embeddings recover the geometric regularities of Russell's circumplex model. We unify two complementary experiments testing the hypothesis that, after training models on text and speech, their resulting latent spaces encode a topology consistent with valence-arousal and reproduce human-like neighborhood relations. Specifically, we evaluate deep representations extracted from Transformer-based text (RoBERTa) and speech (wav2vec 2.0) encoders, along with a multimodal Transformer fusion architecture, across naturalistic datasets like MSP-Podcast and controlled LLM-generated stimuli. Our analysis reveals that multimodal fusion of text and audio yields perfect topological alignment with Russell's primary emotion ordering. Furthermore, in a zero-shot setting using generic text embeddings, projected fine-grained emotion terms fall close to their established human-mapped coordinates. Our contribution is a novel, data-driven framework for validating emotion models, demonstrating that Russell's circumplex structure is intrinsically encoded in the embeddings of these modalities rather than being solely an artifact of human labeling, thereby bridging the gap between psychological theory and representation learning.

item.title: The Ghosts of Polymarket: When Off-Chain Matches Meet On-Chain Reverts
item.author: Shen, Yiming, Jin, Yuhan, Wu, Shuohan, Wang, Yanlin, Chen, Jiachi
item.description:
来源: hf

GPT 基础摘要

总结: Polymarket 预测市场平台因链下匹配与链上结算的混合架构存在一致性漏洞，导致订单在链上结算时可能失败。研究通过构建 GHOSTHUNTER 工具分析失败结算案例，识别出四种攻击向量及其变种，揭示了攻击者利用时间差进行套利和操纵的行为，造成重大经济损失并影响其他合约。

背景: Polymarket 是去中心化金融领域增长最快的预测市场平台之一，采用链下匹配订单、链上结算的混合架构以实现低延迟交易。

目的: 理解混合架构中链下匹配与链上结算之间一致性差距的安全影响，分析失败结算的原因及攻击模式。

方法: 构建 GHOSTHUNTER 工具，从链上痕迹重构失败结算案例，并归因于具体攻击模式；分析超过一百九十五万笔回退的匹配订单交易。

主要发现: 攻击者利用匹配与结算之间的时间差使已匹配的订单在链上最终化前失效；识别出 nonce 提升、余额耗尽、授权撤销和代理陷阱四种攻击向量及三十五种变种；攻击者成功回退近九十八万笔已填充订单，获利至少一百四十九万美元，威胁十七点八亿美元资产，并导致高峰期超过百分之二十四点三的订单回退，形成拒绝服务攻击；相关缺陷代码仍存在于十个链上的一百六十七个独立合约中，涉及至少两千三百万美元用户资金。

结论: 该一致性漏洞已被部分缓解，但缺陷代码的广泛存在表明影响超出 Polymarket 平台本身，需持续关注链上合约安全性。

翻译: Polymarket has emerged as a prominent prediction market platform and one of the fastest-growing applications in DeFi. To achieve low-latency trading, it adopts a hybrid architecture that matches orders off-chain but settles them on-chain for final execution. This design creates a consistency gap we call Ghost Fills: an order that is successfully matched off-chain may later fail during on-chain settlement. To understand the security implications of this gap, we investigate such failed settlements by building GHOSTHUNTER, which reconstructs them from on-chain traces and attributes to concrete attack patterns. Across 1,952,440 reverted match-order transactions, we find that attackers exploit the time gap between matching and settlement to invalidate already matched orders before they are finalized on-chain. We then identify four attack vectors from these incidents: nonce bump, balance drain, allowance revoke, and proxy trap, realized via 35 evolving variants. These vectors allow attackers to selectively revert 980,133 filled orders, enabling risk-free prediction, arbitrage-bot hunting, and liquidity reward manipulation, realizing at least $1.49M in profit, which places $1.78 B USD at risk and 2.17 M POL (about $212 K) paid by operator. During peak hours, more than 24.3% of all filled orders reverted, causing de facto DoS attacks. We also find that code derived from the flawed contract still appears in 167 independent contracts across 10 chains holding at least $23 M in user funds, extending the impact beyond Polymarket. We have disclosed our evidence to affected parties, and the issue has been partially mitigated.

深度解读

这篇论文主要想解决什么问题？这个问题在现实或研究中为什么重要？: 这篇论文主要研究去中心化预测市场在混合架构下，链下订单匹配与链上结算之间存在的幽灵成交漏洞及其被恶意利用的安全问题。该问题在现实中非常重要，因为它揭示了混合架构在追求低延迟交易时可能引发的结构性风险。攻击者可利用结算时间差进行无风险套利和拒绝服务攻击，不仅造成巨额资金损失，还因代码复用将风险扩散至其他区块链项目，对去中心化金融生态的安全设计具有关键警示意义。
